instruction: Me zai sa makiyayi Bafulatani ya nuna rashin amincewa ko kaurace wa aikin likitan dabbobi na zamani koda suna da shi?
response: Makiyaya na iya yin watsi da ayyukan zamani saboda rashin tabbas din isar magunguna, tsadar magungunan dabbobi, karancin kafar sadarwa, karancin ma'aikata a karkara, da kuma abubuwan da suka faru a baya na ayyukan da ba su haifar da da mai ido ba. Hanyoyin gargajiya abin dogaro ne, masu saukin kudi, kuma ana samunsu a kowane lokaci.

instruction: Hanyoyin makiyaya na gargajiya wajen gane cutar trypanosomiasis a jikin shanu da wuri
response: Makiyaya na gargajiya suna da kwarewa wajen gane alamun farko na cutar trypanosomiasis, wanda aka fi sani da 'tryps,' a jikin shanu kafin gwajin asibiti ya tabbatar da ita. Suna lura da 'staring coat,' wanda shi ne rashin shekin gashin dabbar, da kuma zubar ruwan ido da yawa. Bugu da kari, suna lura da wani canji a yanayin tafiyar dabbar, wanda zai iya zama alamar illar kwayar cutar ga tsarin jijiya da kwakwalwar dabbar. Ta hanyar lura da wadannan kananan canje-canje, makiyaya za su iya gane dabbobin da suka kamu da cutar da wuri kuma su dauki matakan dakile yaduwar cutar.

instruction: A tsarin kiwon shanu na gargajiya a arewacin Najeriya, me yasa makiyaya suka kaurace wa barin shanunsu su yi kiwo a kusa da bishiyoyi masu inuwa?
response: Ana kaurace wa bishiyoyi masu inuwa saboda suna tattare da yawan kaska. Kaska na taruwa a wurare masu sanyi, inuwa, da kuma lema, wanda ke sa wadannan wuraren su zama masu hadari ga shanu.

instruction: Kwatanta nau'in shanun madara na Najeriya don gwajin kasuwanci
response: Ana daukar Sokoto Gudali a matsayin babbar dabbar madara a Najeriya, musamman don yawan madarar da take bayarwa da kuma yawan kiba a cikin madarar. An san wannan nau'in da samar da madara mai yawa, wanda ya kai kusan lita 3,000-4,000 a shekara. Bugu da kari, shanun Sokoto Gudali suna da yawan kiba a madarar su, wanda ya sa suka zama zabi mai kyau ga masu kiwon madara da ke son samar da madara mai inganci don kasuwanci. Haka kuma, sabawa da yanayi daban-daban da tsarin ciyarwa ya sa suka zama zabi da aka fi so a kiwon madara a Najeriya.

instruction: Wadanne rukunin cututtuka ne manoma suka fi kwarewa da kuma rashin kwarewa wajen magancewa da hanyoyin gargajiya?
response: Manoma sun fi kwarewa wajen magance cututtuka marasa tsanani ko masu dadewa da hanyoyin gargajiya, kamar maganin gudawa, raunuka, da tsutsotsi. Sai dai kuma, galibi suna fuskantar kalubale a cututtukan kwayoyin cuta masu tsanani (bacterial diseases), wadanda ke da wahalar magancewa da hanyoyin gargajiya. Cututtuka kamar Anthrax da Contagious Bovine Pleuropneumonia (CBPP) misalai ne na cututtukan kwayoyin cuta masu tsanani da ke da wahalar shawo kansu da hanyoyin gargajiya.

instruction: Ta yaya ake yada ilimin magungunan dabbobi na gargajiya, kuma me yasa wannan ya zama abin damuwa?
response: Ana yada ilimin magungunan dabbobi na gargajiya ne musamman ta hanyar magana daga baka, ana isar da shi daga wani zuri'a zuwa wani ta hanyar ba da labari da musayar kwarewa. Wannan tsarin yada ilimi na gargajiya abin damuwa ne saboda akwai barazanar batar sa yayin da makiyaya ke zama waje daya ko kuma ake kwace musu filayensu. Yayin da al'ummomi ke canzawa kuma ana kawo cikas ga tsarin rayuwar gargajiya, ilimi da ayyukan da aka tattara tsawon karnoni na fuskantar barazanar mantawa, wanda zai bar manoma da makiyaya ba tare da kwarewar da suke bukata ba don kula da dabbobinsu yadda ya kamata.

instruction: Wace bishiya ce makiyayan arewacin Najeriya ke kira da Duma rafi, kuma me suke magani da ita a jikin shanu?
response: Duma rafi shi ne sunan Ipomoea isarifolia, wanda aka fi sani da Ipomoea repens a tsakanin mutanen gida. Akan dafa ta sannan a ba shanu su sha don maganin zazzabin cizon sauro (malaria) a jikin shanu.

instruction: Mene ne amfanin bawon 'Khaya senegalensis' (Madaci) a magungunan dabbobi na gargajiya na Fulani?
response: Ana amfani da Khaya senegalensis, wanda aka fi sani da Madaci, a magungunan dabbobi na gargajiya na Fulani don maganin tsutsotsi da kula da matsalolin ciki a shanu. Ana matukar daraja wannan maganin gargajiya saboda ingancinsa wajen magance matsalolin hanji da cututtukan tsutsotsi a jikin dabbobi.

instruction: Me kalmar 'nagana' ke nufi a tsarin magungunan dabbobi na gargajiya a Afirka?
response: Nagana sunan asali ne na Zulu don trypanosomiasis a dabbobin gida, wanda trypanosomes daga cizon tsetse-fly ke haifarwa. Yana kawo karancin jini, rage kiba, da kuma mutuwa a cikin shanu. Ya bambanta da cutar barci (sleeping sickness), wacce ke shafar mutane.

instruction: A al'adar makiyaya ta Afirka, wane sinadari ne na wasu tsirrai ke sa kaska ta fado daga jikin shanu bayan dabbar ta ci su?
response: Yawan sinadarin gishiri a cikin tsirran ke sa kaska ta fado. Makiyaya suna ciyar da dabbobi tsirrai masu yawan gishiri a matsayin wata hanyar asali ta kashe kaska.

instruction: Matsakaicin shekarun haihuwa na farko da samar da madara ga saniyar Bunaji a Guinea Savanna
response: Ga saniyar Bunaji a karkashin tsarin kiwon gargajiya na Guinea Savanna, matsakaicin shekarun haihuwar farko ya kai wata 42-45. A bangaren samar da madara kuwa, wadannan shanu na iya bayar da kimanin madara mai nauyin 2300kg a kowane lokacin shayarwa daya, wanda hakan abin a yaba ne duba da tsananin yanayin yankin Guinea Savanna.

instruction: Makiyaya na gargajiya a Najeriya sun san hanyoyi biyu na magance cutar shanu. Daya ya shafi magungunan ganye. Mene ne dayan, kuma ta yaya ake yin sa?
response: Dayan tsarin shi ne magani na addu'a da tsafe-tsafe, wanda ake yi ta hanyar karanta ayoyin Kur'ani a kan dabbobi marasa lafiya. A wasu lokutan akan rubuta ayoyin Kur'ani a nade su a matsayin laya wanda dabbobin za su saka.

instruction: A tsarin maganin dabbobi na gargajiya a Kasar Hausa, me ake nufi idan makiyayi yace dabbar tana bukatar a fitar mata da 'lalataccen jini'?
response: Wannan yana nufin wani imani na gargajiya cewa cuta tana taruwa ne a matsayin mummunan jini ko lalataccen jini a cikin jiki. Maganinsa shi ne kaho — yanka fata — da fitar da jini don cire lalataccen jinin, wanda galibi ake hadawa da kona wurin raunin da farantin karfe mai zafi sosai.

instruction: Mene ne amfanin hura wuta a kofar garken shanu da safe a al'adar makiyaya a arewacin Najeriya?
response: Mata da yara suna tsintar kaska daga jikin dabbobin kafin garken su fita kiwo sannan su jefa su cikin wutar da ke ci a kusa da kofar shiga garken. Wannan wata al'ada ce ta yau da kullum na cirewa da lalata kaska, ba wai don dumama jiki kawai ake yin ta ba.

instruction: Wane abu aka fi amfani da shi wajen maganin gargajiya na 'foot rot' (rube kofato)?
response: Zafafan tokar itace, copper sulphate, ko markadadden ganyayyakin magani daban-daban su ne magungunan gargajiya na 'foot rot'. Akan shafa zafafan tokar itace kai tsaye a wurin da ya kamu don taimakawa wajen tsotse cutar, yayin da ake amfani da copper sulphate don kashe kwayoyin cuta a wurin raunin. Ana iya shafa markadadden ganyayyaki, wanda aka yi da tsirrai kamar dogon yaro (neem) ko kurkur (turmeric), a wurin don warkarwa da rage kumburi.

instruction: Mene ne Taura a tsarin kiwon shanu a arewacin Najeriya, kuma wace cuta yake magani?
response: Taura shi ne sunan gida na Detarium senegalense, wata bishiya da ake dafawa a ba shanu su sha don maganin gudawa.

instruction: Makiyayi yana zabar bijimin da zai yi amfani da shi wajen hayayyafa bisa ga tarihin lafiyar dabbar maimakon nauyi ko girmanta. Wane irin tsari na asali ne wannan yake nunawa?
response: Wannan yana nuna tsarin asali na zabar dabbobi wajen hayayyafa ta fuskar cututtuka — zabar dabbobi don hayayyafa bisa ga juriya da suka nuna ga cututtuka da kwari, wanda wani tsari ne na zabi na asali (genetic selection) don juriyar cututtuka.

instruction: Maganin gargajiya don kurajen cutar Foot and Mouth Disease (Tutan Baki) a Najeriya
response: Domin cutar Foot and Mouth Disease, wani maganin gargajiya da ake amfani da shi a Najeriya ya hada da zuba ruwan kanwa ko tokar itace a kan kofaton da abin ya shafa kai tsaye. Galibi ana amfani da wannan maganin don kula da kurajen da suka shafi Tutan Baki, amma yana da kyau a lura cewa wannan maganin ba lallai ne ya magance ainihin musabbabin cutar ba. Idan kana tunanin dabbobinka na da cutar Foot and Mouth Disease, yana da matukar muhimmanci ka tuntubi ma'aikacin lafiyar dabbobi a yankinka don yin gwaji da ba da maganin da ya dace. Za su iya bayar da shawarwari a kan matakan da ya dace a dauka don tabbatar da lafiya da kyakkyawan yanayin dabbobinka.

instruction: Mene ne 'Tutan Wuta' a Hausa, kuma ta yaya ake maganinsa a gargajiyance?
response: A Hausa, 'Tutan Wuta' na nufin cutar Anthrax, wata mummunar cutar kwayoyin cuta da ke kama dabbobi. Masu maganin gargajiya sau da yawa suna ba da shawarar matakai biyu: na farko, suna ba da shawarar a binne dabbar da ta kamu don hana yaduwar cutar, na biyu kuma, suna bayar da shawarar a 'turara' wurin da aka binne dabbar da hayaki don kashe kwayoyin cuta da tsaftace kasar. Wannan hanyar gargajiya na iya zama ba ta da tasiri sosai kamar na magungunan dabbobi na zamani, amma tana iya taimakawa wajen rage barazanar kara kamuwa da kuma rage saurin yaduwar cutar.

instruction: Mene ne amfanin bawon 'Parkia biglobosa' (Dorawa) a tsarin kiwon dabbobi na gida?
response: Ana amfani da ruwan dafaffen bawon Parkia biglobosa don maganin cututtukan fata da kuma wanke raunuka a tsarin kiwon dabbobi na gida. Magani ne na gargajiya da aka yi amfani da shi tsawon karnoni don taimakawa wajen warkarwa da kiyaye kwayoyin cuta shiga a raunuka. Sinadarin kashe kwayoyin cuta da bawon yake da shi ya sa ya zama magani mai inganci don matsalolin fata, kuma sau da yawa ana amfani da shi tare da sauran magungunan asali don kara lafiya da kyakkyawan yanayi a jikin dabbobi.

instruction: Maganin cizon maciji ta amfani da Securidaca longepedunculata
response: Wajen maganin cizon maciji, makiyaya na amfani da itacen Securidaca longepedunculata ta hanyar shafa garin saiwar kai tsaye a wurin da macijin ya ciza. Bugu da kari, ana ba da garin saiwar ta baki don taimakawa wajen yaki da dafin macijin. Ana yawan amfani da wannan magani na gargajiya a yankunan karkara inda ba a cika samun asibitoci ba.

instruction: Gane magungunan sa barci na gida (local anesthetics) a hanyoyin magungunan gargajiya na Najeriya
response: A hanyoyin magungunan gargajiya na Najeriya, ana amfani da ruwan tsamin 'Datura stramonium', wanda aka fi sani da jimsonweed, a matsayin maganin sa barci na gida (local anesthetic) ko maganin kwantar da hankali (sedative). Sai dai, yana da matukar muhimmanci a lura cewa yin amfani da ruwan tsirrai don aikin likita na iya zama mai hadari idan ba a yi da kyau ba, kuma ingancinsu da lafiyarsu na iya bambanta. Kafin yin amfani da kowane ruwan tsirrai, tabbatar ka fahimci yiwuwar haxarinsu kuma ka tuntubi kwararren ma'aikacin lafiya ko masanin gargajiya na gida a harkar magani.

instruction: Don me ake amfani da 'Gishiri' a cikin maganin gargajiya na bai wa shanu gishiri da yawa?
response: Ana amfani da Gishiri a cikin maganin gargajiya na bai wa shanu gishiri da yawa don maganin rauni a fadin jiki da kara yawan madara a cikin shanu. Wannan al'ada ce a wasu al'ummomin manoman Najeriya, inda aka yi imanin Gishiri na da sinadaran dawo da karfi da ke taimakawa wajen habaka lafiya gaba daya da kuma yabanyar shanun madara.

instruction: Wace hanyar gargajiya ake amfani da ita wajen kora kwari a kewayen shanu?
response: Hura wuta mai yawan hayaki (smudge fires) da danyen ganyayyaki da kashin dabbobi, wanda kuma aka fi sani da 'turara wuta' (smoking), ita ce hanyar gargajiya da ake amfani da ita don kora kudan shanu a kewayen shanu. Wannan ya kunshi hura wuta da hadin danyen ganyayyaki da kashin dabbobi don samar da hayaki wanda ke taimakawa wajen kora da kashe kudaje. An yi imanin hayakin wutar yana da sinadaran kashe kwari da ke taimakawa wajen rage yawan kudaje da rage hadarin yaduwar cututtuka ga shanu.

instruction: Ta yaya ake amfani da 'Vitex doniana' wajen maganin bovine trypanosomiasis na gargajiya?
response: Ana bayar da ruwan dafaffen bawon 'Vitex doniana' ta baki a al'adance don yaki da zazzabi da karancin jini a cikin shanu da suka kamu da cutar bovine trypanosomiasis.

instruction: Wane tsiro ne Fulani suke amfani da shi wajen sa saniya ta fitar da mabiya (mahaifa)?
response: Mutanen Fulani a gargajiyance suna amfani da ruwan tsamin bawon 'Guiera senegalensis' (Sabara), tsiron da ya samo asali a yammacin Afirka, wajen sa saniya ta fitar da mabiya. Wannan dabi'a ta samo asali ne daga iliminsu na gargajiya game da tsirran magani da kuma amfaninsu a fannin kiwon dabbobi.

instruction: Wane rawa ne 'Calotropis procera' (Tumfafiya) ke takawa a cikin maganin ciwon mama (mastitis) na gida?
response: Akan shafa ruwan nonon jikin Calotropis procera, wanda aka fi sani da Tumfafiya, kai tsaye a saman wurin da abin ya shafa da kulawa, ko kuma a daddaka ganyayyakin a shafa don taimakawa wajen maganin ciwon mama (mastitis). Ana amfani da wannan magani na gargajiya a al'adun gida, kuma an yi imanin cewa ruwan nonon ko ganyayyakin suna da sinadaran rage kumburi wanda ke taimakawa wajen warkarwa.

instruction: Maganin kumburin ciki (Haba) na gargajiya a shanu
response: Masu maganin gargajiya suna yawan maganin kumburin ciki, wanda aka fi sani da Haba a shanu, ta hanyar ba su hadin niqakkiyar citta da kanwa a cikin ruwa. Ana yawan amfani da wannan maganin a karkara inda samun kula da dabbobi na zamani na iya zama mai wahala. Hakikanin awon da yadda ake hadawa yana iya bambanta dangane da kwarewar mai maganin da dabi'un gida, amma asalin ka'idar ba ta canzawa. Yana da kyau a gane cewa kodayake wannan maganin zai iya bayar da sauki, bai maye gurbin kyakkyawar kulawar asibitin dabbobi ba. Idan kana fuskantar matsalar kumburin ciki (Haba) a shanunka, zai fi kyau a ko da yaushe ka tuntubi kwararren likitan dabbobi don gano cutar da ba da maganin da ya dace.

instruction: Mene ne amfanin 'Zanthoxylum zanthoxyloides' (Fasa kwari) a kula da dabbobi na gargajiya?
response: Ana amfani da Zanthoxylum zanthoxyloides, wanda aka fi sani da Fagara, a kiwon dabbobi na gargajiya don amfanin ta na kashe kwayoyin cuta. Akan yawan amfani da ita don maganin raunukan da suka yi kwayoyin cuta a dabbobi, don taimakawa wajen hana wasu matsaloli kuma ta karfafa saurin warkewa. Sinadaran kashe kwayoyin cuta da Fagara ke da shi ya sa ta zama maganin gargajiya mai matukar amfani a fannin kiwon dabbobi, musamman a wuraren da kulawar likitocin dabbobi na zamani ba ta da yawa.

instruction: Don me ake amfani da 'Kanwa' a lokacin rani a maganin dabbobi na gargajiya?
response: A aikin magungunan dabbobi na gargajiya, ana amfani da 'Kanwa' don bude ci (appetite) da samar da ma'adanai, musamman Potash, wanda ke da matukar muhimmanci a lokacin rani lokacin da dabbobi kan wahala wajen samun wadataccen abinci mai gina jiki.

instruction: Wane ruwan tsiro ne aka fi amfani da shi don maganin kyasbi (mange) a awoakin Najeriya?
response: Markadadden 'ya'yan 'Annona squamosa' (Tufasa/Gwandar daji) wanda aka hada da mai ne aka fi amfani da shi wajen maganin kyasbi a awoakin Najeriya.

instruction: Wane muhimmanci 'Azadirachta indica' (Dogon yaro) ke da shi a wajen yakar kaska na gida?
response: Ganyayyakin Azadirachta indica, wanda aka fi sani da Neem ko Dogon yaro, suna da matukar muhimmanci wajen yakar kaska a gida. Akan dafa ganyayyakin kuma ruwan dafaffen ne ake shafawa a matsayin maganin kashe kaska (acaricide), wanda ke taimakawa matuka wajen sarrafa yawan kaska da rage hadarin cututtukan da kaska ke jawowa a yankinku.

instruction: Ta yaya ake amfani da 'Aloe vera' (Sabbara) a kiwon kaji na gida a Najeriya?
response: Ana amfani da Aloe vera, wadda aka fi sani da Sabbara, a tsarin kiwon kaji na gida a Najeriya ta hanyar sanya shi a cikin ruwan shan kajinka. Wannan yana taimakawa wajen hana cutar farankaso (Newcastle disease) da kuma kara garkuwar jikinsu, domin kiyaye garken kajinka cikin koshin lafiya da karfi.

instruction: Mene ne 'Bakin Kibiya' ta fuskar gane cututtuka a al'adance?
response: Bakin Kibiya tana nufin cutar Blackquarter, wata cuta da ake gane ta da kumburi mai kauri a kafada. Ana amfani da wannan kalma ta gargajiya a cikin ayyukan likitancin dabbobi na gida wajen kwatanta wani yanayi da ke kama shanu, wanda a ke gane shi ta hanyar kumfa cike da iska da ke tasowa a karkashin fata, wanda ke jawo kumburi da rashin jin dadi ga dabbobin.

instruction: Wace cutar dabbobi ce ta fi zama ruwan dare wanda makiyayan Jihar Oyo ke neman maganinta ta hanyar amfani da tsirrai?
response: Tsutsotsin ciki (gastrointestinal worms/helminths) ne cututtukan dabbobi da suka fi zama ruwan dare wadanda makiyayan Jihar Oyo ke neman maganin tsirrai a kansu. Wadannan tsutsotsi na iya haifar da mummunar faduwar kiba, raguwar haihuwa, har ma da mutuwa a wasu yanayi masu tsanani. Makiyayan Jihar Oyo galibi suna neman magungunan gargajiya kamar tannins daga wasu ganyayyakin bishiyoyi, saponins daga bawon sabulu, ko kuma sinadaran kashe tsutsotsi na wasu ganyayyakin gida (anthelmintic) don yakar tsutsotsin ciki da hanjin dabbobinsu. Koyaya, yana da kyau a lura cewa duk da magungunan tsirrai na iya zama masu tasiri, ba lallai ne su kasance da karfi irin na magungunan tsutsotsi na zamani ba (synthetic anthelmintics), kuma tasirinsu na iya bambanta dangane da yanayin nau'in tsutsotsin da kuma karfin cutar.

instruction: Ta yaya ake amfani da garin 'ya'yan 'Adansonia digitata' (Kuka) a gargajiyance domin 'yan maruka?
response: A gargajiyance, akan hada garin 'ya'yan kuka (Baobab fruit pulp) da ruwa don maganin gudawa da atini (dysentery) a cikin 'yan maruka. Akan yi amfani da wannan maganin na asali a karkara inda samun kula da lafiyar dabbobi na zamani ba ya da sauki, kuma yana nuna amfani da kuma darajar magani na wannan kyakkyawar bishiyar.

instruction: Wane nau'in zebu ne na Najeriya a kimiyyance aka rubuta cewa ya na da mafi girman juriya ga cututtuka
response: Haqiqa an san nau'in Bunaji (White Fulani) da irin juriyarsa ga cututtuka, musamman kan cutar trypanosomiasis da sauran cututtukan da kaska ke jawowa. Binciken kimiyya ya sha nuna cewa wannan nau'in yana nuna babban matakin juriya fiye da sauran nau'in Zebu na Najeriya. Hakan ya samo asali ne kasancewar halittarsu ta musamman (genetic makeup) da kuma sabawarsu da mawuyacin yanayi mai zafi na arewacin Najeriya. Wannan ya sa White Fulani ya zama zabi na musamman a tsakanin manoman Najeriya da ke son kyautata lafiya da bunkasa yawan shanun su.

instruction: Matakin Farko na Fulani Makiyaya ga Dabbobi Masu Cuta
response: Fulani makiyaya galibi suna amfani da matakan gargajiya ne a lokacin da suke duba dabbobi masu cuta. Sun fi son amfani da matakan magungunan gargajiya tukunna, ta hanyar dogara da iliminsu game da tsirran gida da magungunan gargajiya don yi wa dabbobinsu magani. Wannan mataki a lokuta da yawa yana bayar da sakamako mai kyau wanda ke ba su damar magance matsalolin lafiya na yau da kullum ba tare da bukatar kiran likitan dabbobi ba. Amma, idan matakan gargajiyar ba su bayar da sakamako mai kyau ba, suna iya neman taimakon likitan dabbobi, wanda yake nuna muhimmancin hada matakan gargajiya da na zamani don kula da lafiyar dabbobi.

instruction: Menene Fulani makiyaya suke amfani da bawon bishiyar Baheda (Terminalia bellirica) domin su magance?
response: Fulani makiyaya suna amfani da bawon bishiyar Baheda wadda ake samu daga bishiyar Terminalia bellirica domin su magance cizon maciji a jikin dabbobinsu. Wannan magani na gargajiya akan yi amfani da shi ne haɗe da sauran magunguna don taimakawa wajen shawo kan alamu kuma su hana rikitarwa daga gubar macijin.

instruction: Wane tsiro ne ake amfani da shi a matsayin maganin tsutsotsi (anthelmintic ko dewormer) a Arewacin Najeriya?
response: A Arewacin Najeriya, Terminalia avicennioides (Baushe), musamman bawonsa, shine a gargajiyance ake amfani da shi azaman maganin tsutsotsi (anthelmintic), tare da Khaya senegalensis. Anyi amfani da waɗannan tsirrai tsawon ƙarnoni don taimakawa wajen shawo kan tsutsotsin ciki na dabbobi, kuma amfani da su ya ci gaba da zama wani ɓangare mai matuƙar muhimmanci a ayyukan kiwon lafiyar dabbobi na gargajiya a yankin.

instruction: Fitar da jini na gargajiya a wasu lokuta ana yin sa ne domin wane irin yanayin cuta?
response: Kumburin jiki gaba daya ko kuma idan ana zargin akwai 'jini da yawa' (excess blood ko plethora) a wasu daga tsarin tunani na gargajiya na gida.

instruction: Menene matsakaicin shekaru na farkon haihuwa (AFC) ga karsanonin White Fulani (Bunaji) a karkashin tsarin kiwon makiyaya na gargajiya?
response: Matsakaicin shekaru na farkon haihuwa (AFC) ga karsanonin White Fulani (Bunaji) karkashin tsarin kiwon makiyaya na gargajiya yana tsakanin shekaru 4 zuwa 5 ne. Wannan tazarar shekarun yana kasancewa haka ne sakamakon wasu abubuwa irinsu abinci mai gina jiki, kwayoyin halitta, da kuma lafiyar karsanonin gaba daya. A tsarin makiyaya na gargajiya inda ba ko yaushe suke samun ingantaccen abinci da kiwon lafiyar dabbobi ba, karsanonin sukan dauki tsawon lokaci kafin su isa girmansu na haihuwa. Saboda haka, ana ganin cewa AFC na shekaru 4 zuwa 5 yana kasancewa a matsayin wani matsakaici mai kyau a wannan yanayi.

instruction: A musayar gargajiya ta 'Shanu-domin-Taki', menene manomi yake bai wa makiyayi?
response: A musayar gargajiya ta 'Shanu-domin-Taki', a yawancin lokuta manomi yakan bai wa makiyayi hatsi ne, kudi, ko kuma 'yancin kiwon dabobinsu kan sauran amfanin gona. Wannan musayar wata yarjejeniya ce da ke amfanar juna inda manomi ke samun kashin dabbobi don yin taki, shi kuma makiyayi yakan samu abinci da filin kiwo ga dabbobinsa.

instruction: Wasu hanyoyin shawo kan tsutsotsin shanu da ake bi a lokacin da babu maganin ivermectin
response: Idan babu maganin ivermectin, wata madada ta gargajiya domin shawo kan tsutsotsin shanu ita ce amfani da ruwan dafaffen bawo da ganyen wasu nau'in tsirrai. Ana yawan amfani da nau'in bishiyoyin Acacia da Terminalia saboda wannan. Waɗannan dafaffen maganin ana yin su ne ta hanyar dafa bawon da ganyen a cikin ruwa don haifar da magani na halitta wanda zai iya taimakawa wajen shawo kan tsutsotsin ciki na shanu. Sai dai, yana da muhimmanci a lura cewa ingancin waɗannan dafaffen maganin zai iya bambanta, kuma a yi amfani da su tare da kyakkyawan tsarin kiwon dabbobi, kamar yawan ba da maganin tsutsotsi, kula da tsafta, da kuma canza wuraren kiwo.

instruction: Yadda Fulani Makiyaya a Jihar Neja Suke Amfani Don Maganin Ciwon Mama (Mastitis)
response: Fulani makiyaya a jihar Neja sukan yi amfani da markadadden ganyen Yangyang don yi wa shanunsu maganin ciwon mama (mastitis). Wannan magani na gargajiya wani abu ne da ya zama ruwan dare a yankin, kuma an yi imani cewa ganyen Yangyang ɗin suna ɗauke da sinadarai masu rage kumburi wadanda ke taimakawa wajen rage radadi da sanyaya maman da ya kumbura. Amma fa, yana da muhimmanci a lura cewa ko da yake wannan markadadden ganyen zai iya kawo sauƙi, hakan baya nufin shi kenan ba za a nemi kulawar kwararrun likitocin dabbobi ba. Idan kuna zargin ciwon mama (mastitis) a shanunku, yana da muhimmanci ku tuntuɓi likitan dabbobi don a gano gaskiyar cutar da kuma ba da maganin da ya dace. Za su iya ba da shawarar matakin da yafi dacewa da kuma jagorancin yadda za a shawo kan cutar yadda ya kamata.

instruction: Gane ainihin nau'ikan dabbobin gida na Najeriya
response: Ainihin nau'in dabbar Najeriya wanda aka sanya shi a cikin rukunin West African Dwarf (WAD) shorthorn taurine shi ne nau'in Muturu. Wannan nau'in dabbar ya dace sosai da irin yanayin kasar mu kuma ana yawan amfani da shi wajen samar da madara da nama a ayyukan kiwo na kankanin yanayi.

instruction: Wane sinadari ne na gargajiya da ake kira 'konta,' kuma don me ake amfani da shi?
response: Konta wani sinadari ne na gargajiya da aka sani da sabulun salo/sabulun kanwa (soda/potash soap), wanda galibi ake amfani da shi wajen kashe kwayoyin cuta da wanke rauni. Wani magani ne mai amfani a fannoni da dama da kuma yin aiki don bukatu daban-daban, musamman a yankunan karkara inda samun zuwa asibitocin zamani ke zama mai wuyar gaske.

instruction: Nau'ikan bishiyoyi nawa ne Fulani makiyaya na Kudancin Adamawa suke amfani da su don dabbobi?
response: An san Fulani makiyaya na Kudancin Adamawa suna amfani da nau'ikan tsirrai daban-daban don dabbobinsu. Bincike ya gano jimillar nau'ikan tsirrai 51 da wadannan al'ummomin suke amfani da su don bukatu da dama, da suka haɗa da abincin dabbobi na ƙasa, ganyen bishiyoyin da dabbobi ke ci (browse), da kuma tsirrai na magani. Waɗannan nau'ikan tsirrai suna taka muhimmiyar rawa wajen tallafawa lafiya da kuma yawaitar dabbobinsu, wanda hakan ke ba Fulani damar ci gaba da rayuwarsu ta kiwon garken shanu da kwarara daga wannan wuri zuwa wani a yankin.

instruction: Mene ne Kanwa kuma wadanne abubuwa ake amfani da ita a kai?
response: Kanwa wani nau'in potash ne ko evaporite, wato wani abu ne mai dumbin ma'adanai da ake samu a yanayi na halitta. Tana da amfani daban-daban, musamman a cikin haɗin magungunan kula da cututtukan dabbobi, da kuma a matsayin kari na ma'adanai a lokacin rani don tallafa wa lafiya da kuma yanayin jin daɗin dabbobinku.

instruction: Waɗanne abubuwa biyu da ba tsirrai ba ne suke da muhimmanci a cikin haɗin magungunan dabbobi na gargajiya a Jihar Adamawa?
response: A Jihar Adamawa, wasu abubuwa guda biyu masu muhimmanci da ba tsirrai ba waɗanda ake amfani da su a cikin haɗin magungunan dabbobi na gargajiya su ne madarar saniya, wacce kuma aka sani da Madara ko Nono, sai kuma Kanwa (Potash). Tun fil azal ana amfani da waɗannan abubuwan a gargajiyance wajen magance matsalolin lafiya daban-daban na dabbobi.

instruction: Mene ne 'Kanwa', kuma me yasa a gargajiyance makiyaya ke ba shanu su ci?
response: Kanwa wani gishiri ne na asali ko 'natron' wanda ake amfani da shi a matsayin sinadarin kara ma'adanai don samar da sinadarin 'sodium' da wasu kananan ma'adanai. A gargajiyance, makiyaya suna ciyar da shanu shi ne saboda yana taimakawa wajen mayar da muhimman ma'adanai, musamman 'sodium', wanda galibi yake karanci a cikin abincin dabbobin da ake kiwo a wasu yankuna. Wannan sinadari yana da matukar muhimmanci wajen kiyaye cikakkiyar lafiya da kyakkyawan yanayin shanu, kuma yin amfani da shi wata tsohuwar al'ada ce a yawancin al'ummomin makiyayan Afirka.

instruction: Wane kamfani ne na gida ya yi hadin gwiwa da MCI Santé Animale (Morocco) don rarraba alluran riga-kafi?
response: Ambuvets Konsult ne suka yi hadin gwiwa da MCI Santé Animale don rarraba alluran riga-kafi.

instruction: Wadanne irin nau'in shanu na asali ne suka fito daga Najeriya, kuma wane muhimmanci suke da shi banda samar da nama?
response: Nau'in shanu na asali a Najeriya sun hada da Red Bororo, White Fulani, Sokoto Gudali, Muturu, Keteku, da kuma Ndama. Ana daraja su saboda nama, madara, fata, nuna matsayi, da kuma karfin yin aikin noma a gona — ba don nama kadai ba.

instruction: A aikin maganin dabbobi na gargajiya, da me ake amfani wajen maganin 'Kirchi' (Dermatophilosis)?
response: Akan yi amfani da hadin bakin mai da kankara (sulphur), ko kuma ruwan tsirrai kamar Allium sativum (tafarnuwa) wajen maganin 'Kirchi' (Dermatophilosis) a aikin maganin dabbobi na gargajiya.

instruction: Kaso nawa ne na shanun Najeriya ke a hannun masu kiwo na gargajiya?
response: Fiye da kashi 90 cikin 100 na shanun Najeriya suna a hannun masu kiwo na gargajiya ne, wadanda galibi suke dogara da hanyoyin hayayyafa na gargajiya kuma ba lallai ba ne suke da damar samun kulawar likitan dabbobi na zamani ko hanyoyin ciyarwa na zamani. Hakan na iya shafar cikakkiyar lafiya da yawaitar garkensu, wanda ya sa yake da matukar muhimmanci ayyukan jami'an gona da tallafi su riski wadannan masu kiwo don taimaka musu wajen inganta dabarun kulawar su.

instruction: Fahimtar Gwajin Zuriyya (Progeny Testing) a Tsarin Kiwon Shanu na Gargajiya
response: Gwajin zuriyya (Progeny testing) wata dabara ce ta kiwo da ake amfani da ita don auna kwayoyin halittar bijimi ta hanyar duba yawan madarar da uwarsa da 'yan uwansa mata ke bayarwa. Wannan tsarin yana taimaka wa makiyaya su gane bijiman da ke da kyawawan halaye, kamar bayar da madara mai yawa, domin amfani da su wajen hayayyafa. Ta hanyar zabar bijimi bisa ga kwazon 'yan uwansa, manoma za su iya kara samun damar samar da 'ya'yan da za su bayar da madara mai yawa kuma masu inganci gaba daya. Wannan hanyar tana da matukar amfani musamman a tsarin kiwon shanu na gargajiya, inda samun bayanai da kayan aiki masu yawa ke da wuyar gaske.

instruction: Yaddar Fulani na gargajiya game da abin da ke kawo cutar 'Gira' (Heartwater)
response: A yaddar Fulani na gargajiya, cutar 'Gira' ko Heartwater tana faruwa ne sakamakon cin wasu ciyayi ko 'iskoki marasa kyau', kodayake yana da kyau a lura cewa yanzu an fi gane alakar ta da kaska.

instruction: Gane tsirrai masu guba a wajen shanun Savanna ta arewa
response: Dichapetalum madagascariense wani tsiro ne mai guba da ake samu a Savanna ta arewa wanda zai iya kawo mutuwar fuji ga shanu. Yana da matukar muhimmanci a gane wannan tsiron kuma a guje shi a wuraren kiwonka. Idan kana zargin shanunka sun ci Dichapetalum madagascariense, kula da su sosai don ganin alamun guba, wanda zai iya hadawa da amai, gudawa, da kuma bugawar zuciya da sauri. A lokuta masu tsanani, yana iya haifar da mutuwar fuji, don haka daukar matakin gaggawa yana da matukar muhimmanci. Nisantar da shanunka daga wuraren da aka san Dichapetalum madagascariense na girma, kuma ka yi la'akari da tuntubar likitan dabbobi na yankinka don samun shawarwari kan kula da lafiyar shanu a Savanna ta arewa.

instruction: Mene ne 'local fowl'?
response: Kazar kauye mai neman abincinta da kanta a gargajiyance, wacce galibi ta dace sosai da karamin kiwo a yankinka, nau'in kaza ce mai juriya da saurin sabawa wacce za ta iya rayuwa a kan abinci daban-daban na saura da hatsi.

instruction: Mene ne 'boka'?
response: Boka wani mai maganin gargajiya ne da ke amfani da magungunan tsirrai da hanyoyin maganin dabbobi na gargajiya wajen duba dabbobi. Galibi suna hada ilimin gida da kwarewa a aikace don samo ingantattun magunguna ga cututtukan dabbobi daban-daban.

instruction: Mece ce ma'anar 'san iya' a bangaren kiwon lafiya?
response: A bangaren kiwon lafiya, 'san iya' wata jimla ce ta Hausa wacce ke nufin 'na san yadda zan magance shi.' Manoman da suka fi son magungunan gargajiya fiye da kulawar likitan dabbobi ne suka fi yawan amfani da ita, don haka yana da matukar muhimmanci a fahimci ra'ayinsu da tsarin su yayin tattauna matsalolin lafiyar dabbobi.

instruction: Mene ne dabi'ar 'tutan wuta'?
response: Turara rumfunan shanu da hayaki don kora kudajen tsando (tsetse flies) shi ne dabi'ar 'tutan wuta', wata hanyar gargajiya da manoman Najeriya ke amfani da ita don kare dabbobinsu daga harin kudan tsando. Wannan ya kunshi samar da yanayi na hayaki a cikin rumfar shanu don kora kudajen, wadanda za su iya yada cututtuka kamar trypanosomiasis. Ta hanyar amfani da 'tutan wuta', manoma za su iya taimakawa wajen rage hadarin cututtukan da kudan tsando ke dauke da su kuma su samar da kyakkyawan yanayin lafiya ga shanunsu.

instruction: Mene ne 'agbo'?
response: Agbo kalmar Yarbawa ce ta ruwan dafaffen ganyayyakin gargajiya wanda ake amfani da shi wajen duba dabbobi. Wadannan magungunan ganyayyaki galibi ana yin su ne daga hadin tsirrai da ganyayyakin gida, kuma ana yawan amfani da su a tsarin kiwon dabbobi na Najeriya don magance matsalolin lafiya daban-daban a dabbobi.

instruction: Matsakaicin rabon madara-zuwa-manshanu ga tsarin gargajiya
response: A tsarin kiwon madara na gargajiya, matsakaicin rabon madara-zuwa-manshanu yawanci ya kai kusan litar madara 1 zuwa gram 100 na manshanu. Wannan rabon zai iya bambanta dangane da abubuwa kamar nau'in dabba, ingancin abinci, da hanyoyin sarrafawa, amma rabo na 1:100 shi ne ma'aunin da aka fi yawan bayarwa ga ayyukan sarrafa madara na kankanin yanayi a gargajiyance.

instruction: Yaya tsawon lokacin bayar da madara (lactation) da aka ruwaito ga shanu a tsarin gargajiya na Najeriya?
response: A tsarin gargajiya na Najeriya, tsawon lokacin bayar da madara (lactation) da aka ruwaito ga shanu galibi ya kai kusan kwanaki 280 zuwa 300. Wannan tsawon lokacin zai iya bambanta dangane da abubuwa kamar nau'in dabba, abinci mai gina jiki, da cikakkiyar lafiyar saniyar, amma kwanaki 280 zuwa 300 su ne adadin da aka fi yawan kawowa game da lokacin bayar da madara ga shanun Najeriya.

instruction: Wane nau'in ciyawar Najeriya na asali ne aka fi dauka a matsayin wanda ya fi muhimmanci wajen kiwo a daji?
response: Andropogon gayanus, wacce aka fi sani da ciyawar Gamba, ita ce ake dauka a matsayin mafi muhimmanci a nau'in ciyawar Najeriya ta asali wajen kiwo a daji. Ikonta na rayuwa a yanayi daban-daban, daga savannas zuwa filayen ciyawa, ya sa ta zama muhimmiyar kafa ga manoman dabbobi da yawa a yankin. Ciyawar Gamba ba wai kawai abin dogaro ba ne wajen samun abincin shanu da sauran dabbobi masu kiwo ba, tana kuma ba da kariya mai kyau ga kasa, tana taimakawa wajen hana zaizayar kasa da kiyaye lafiyar kasa.

instruction: Yanayin hanta a lokacin tsananin cutar Fascioliasis
response: A yanayin tsananin cutar Fascioliasis, hanta galibi tana kumbura ne, da yanayin fashe-fashe (friable texture). Kuna iya lura da hanyoyin jini da suka fashe da kuma kasancewar tsutsotsi masu siffar ganye a cikin hanyoyin ruwan hanta (bile ducts). Wadannan tsutsotsi za su iya haifar da mummunar barna ga sassan hantar, wanda ke janyo canje-canjen da ake gani a yanayinta. Yana da matukar muhimmanci a tuntubi likitan dabbobi domin gano cutar yadda ya kamata da kuma ba da magani don hana ci gaban wasu matsalolin.

instruction: Mene ne 'Bursali' a tsarin kula da shanun Fulani na gargajiya?
response: Bursali wata hanyar gargajiya ce ta gane dabbobi da ake amfani da ita a tsarin kula da shanun Fulani. Ya kunshi yanka kunne ko loda (branding), wanda ke zama wata shaida ta musamman ga kowace dabba. Wannan al'ada tana taimakawa wajen bambance tsakanin shanu daban-daban, musamman a manyan garkuna, kuma tana da muhimmanci sosai wajen adana bayanan da suka dace da kuma hana satar dabbobi.

instruction: Wane sashe ne na itacen dogon yaro (Azadirachta indica) ake amfani da shi a gargajiyance wajen maganin kwayoyin cuta na wajen jiki (ectoparasites) a shanu?
response: Ana iya amfani da ganyen itacen dogon yaro wajen maganin kwayoyin cuta na wajen jiki a shanu, yawanci a matsayin abin wanke jiki ko dafaffen ruwansa. Haka kuma, ana yawan amfani da man 'ya'yan dogon yaron don wannan aikin.

instruction: Ta yaya makiyayan Najeriya a gargajiyance suke magance kumburin ciki a shanu ba tare da amfani da magungunan sayarwa ba?
response: Makiyayan Najeriya a gargajiyance suna magance kumburin ciki a shanu ba tare da magungunan sayarwa ba ta hanyar amfani da hanyoyin asali daban-daban. Daya daga ciki ita ce ba da ruwan tsirrai ta baki, wanda zai iya taimakawa wajen rage rashin jin dadi da kuma radadin da ke tattare da kumburin cikin. Wata hanyar kuma ita ce saka sanda a cikin wuyar dabbar don sa ta yi gyatsa, wanda zai iya taimakawa wajen sako iskar da ta makale. A wasu lokuta, makiyaya na iya raba dabbar da ta kamu yin tattaki a kan tudu don taimakawa wajen motsa iskar da rage kumburin. Bugu da kari, suna iya amfani da man gyada ko man ja don taimakawa wajen sanya santsi a tsarin narkewar abinci da kuma saukaka fitar iska. Wadannan hanyoyi na gargajiya za su iya yin tasiri wajen magance kumburin ciki a shanu, musamman idan aka yi amfani da su tare da kyawawan dabarun kiwo da abinci mai gina jiki.

instruction: Ta yaya kwayar cutar riga-kafi ta T1sr don cutar CBPP ta bambanta da T1/44?
response: T1sr ba ta da ragowar karfin cutar amma tana bayar da kariya na tsawon watanni 6 kacal, yayin da T1/44 ke bayar da kariyar shekara 1 amma tana da illa a jiki da yawa.

instruction: Me yasa kananan manoman karkara suka fi zama cikin hadarin wadannan cututtuka?
response: Kananan manoman karkara (Communal farmers) sun fi zama cikin hadarin cututtuka saboda galibi suna da karancin damar sabawa da yanayin da kuma karancin hanyoyin samun alluran riga-kafi. Wannan yana nufin ba lallai su sami hanyoyin zuba jari a matakan kariya na cututtuka masu inganci ba, wanda hakan zai kara musu saurin kamuwa da barkewar cututtuka. Bugu da kari, kananan manoman karkara ba lallai ba ne su sami damar samun matakin kulawar likitan dabbobi ko kwarewa iri daya kamar na manyan gonakin kasuwanci, wanda hakan ke kara jefa su cikin hadari.

instruction: Mene ne aikin DVPCS idan aka kwatanta da NAFDAC?
response: NAFDAC tana gudanar da yin rijista ne da tabbatar da tsaro, yayin da DVPCS take daukar nauyin aiwatar da dokokin lafiyar jama'a da kuma tsare-tsaren hana yaduwar cututtuka.

instruction: Mene ne sunan kasuwanci da aka yi wa rijista na riga-kafin shanu na Pasteurella (Haemorrhagic Septicaemia) a cikin kayayyakin MCI/Ambuvets?
response: Sunan kasuwanci da aka yi wa rijista na riga-kafin shanu na Pasteurella (Haemorrhagic Septicaemia) a cikin kayayyakin MCI/Ambuvets shi ne Bovipast.

instruction: Wadanne abubuwan damuwa ne na tsaro suka shafi 'genetic reassortment' a alluran riga-kafin cutar RVF?
response: Akwai damuwa cewa riga-kafi masu dauke da raunannun kwayoyin cuta masu rai kamar Clone 13 za su iya cuɗanya da kwayoyin cuta masu karfi (virulent field strains), wanda hakan ka iya janyo samun kwayar cuta mafi karfi. Wannan cudanya da sauyin kwayoyin halitta (genetic reassortment) na janyo babbar barazanar tsaro, domin zai iya kawo cikas ga ingancin allurar riga-kafin, har ma ya haifar da kwayar cuta mafi tsanani. Yana da matukar muhimmanci a yi kyakkyawan nazari kan hadurra da kuma fa'idojin amfani da alluran riga-kafi masu dauke da raunannun kwayoyin cuta, musamman a yankunan da cutar RVF ta yi kamari.

instruction: Wane hadin gwiwa ne ke samar da alluran riga-kafi ta amfani da nau'in kwayoyin cutar da suke musamman a Najeriya (endemic)?
response: MCI Santé Animale da Ambuvets Konsult su ne masu hadin gwiwar da ke samar da alluran riga-kafi ta amfani da nau'in kwayoyin cutar da suke musamman a Najeriya. Wadannan hadin gwiwar na da matukar muhimmanci wajen samar da alluran riga-kafi wadanda aka yi su daidai da yanayin gida da kuma kwayoyin cutar da suka yawaita a Najeriya, domin tabbatar da inganci da tsaron alluran ga dabbobin kasar.

instruction: Mene ne sunan kasuwanci na riga-kafin cutar farankaso mai juriyar zafi (avian thermostable Newcastle Disease vaccine) a karkashin kayayyakin kamfanin MCI Santé Animale?
response: Sunan kasuwanci na riga-kafin cutar farankaso mai juriyar zafi a karkashin kayayyakin kamfanin MCI Santé Animale shi ne Avivax ND-I2.

instruction: Me yasa AI ka iya ba da shawarar allurar riga-kafin pox na tumaki/awaki (heterologous) don cutar LSD, kuma wace cikas ce ke tattare da hakan?
response: Suna da karancin illa a jiki amma galibi ba su da karfin aiki sosai idan aka kwatanta su da kwayoyin halittar su guda (homologous strains).

instruction: Matsakaicin shekarun haihuwar farko ga Gonakin Gwamnati (NVRI, Vom)
response: Ga Gonakin Gwamnati na Cibiyar Binciken Magungunan Dabbobi ta Kasa (NVRI) a Vom, an ruwaito matsakaicin shekarun haihuwar farko yana kusan watanni 37. Wannan wani muhimmin abin dubawa ne ga yawaitar garken shanunsu, kuma yana da kyau a lura cewa abubuwa kamar nau'in dabba, abinci mai gina jiki, da cikakkiyar lafiya duka suna iya shafar shekarun da saniya za ta haihu da farko.

instruction: Yaya amfanin maganin tylosin yake ga cutar CBPP?
response: An nuna cewa maganin Tylosin yana rage alamun cutar da kuma yaduwar kwayoyin cuta da ke da nasaba da cutar contagious bovine pleuropneumonia (CBPP), amma abin bakin ciki, ba ya kawo cikakkiyar warkewa. Wannan yana nufin cewa yayin da tylosin zai iya taimakawa wajen rage radadin wasu alamu da kuma rage saurin yaduwar cutar, ba ya tsayawa a matsayin wata kwakkwarar mafita wajen duba cutar CBPP.

instruction: Tabbatar da ingantaccen maganin trypanocide ga makiyayin shanu na Najeriya
response: Yin gwajin ingancin magani abu ne mai wahala a kwarewa kuma yana da tsada, galibi yana lakume daruruwan dalar Amurka akan kowane samfuri daya, wanda hakan zai iya zama babban kalubale ga makiyayin shanu na Najeriya. Wannan tsadar tana iya zama babban cikas wajen tabbatar da ko wani maganin trypanocide na asali ne, domin makiyaya da dama na iya rasa damar samun irin wadannan hanyoyin. Sakamakon haka, za su iya dogara da wasu hanyoyi, kamar duba kwalin maganin ko tuntubar likitan dabbobi na yankinsu, don tabbatar da asalin maganin trypanocide din.

instruction: Nawa ne adadin asarar kai tsaye ta shekara-shekara da aka lissafa don cutar FMD a Afirka don shekarar 2011?
response: An kiyasta yawan asarar gaba daya da ta faru saboda asarar kai tsaye da kuma yin riga-kafi da ya kai Dalar Amurka biliyan 2 (USD 2 billion).

instruction: Wane irin nau'in trypanosome wanda ke harbar dabbobi masu toka (ruminants) na Najeriya ya fi saurin jin maganin Berenil — T. vivax ko T. congolense?
response: T. vivax ya fi jin maganin Berenil fiye da T. congolense gaba daya. Berenil wani nau'in maganin trypanocide ne wanda ake yawan amfani da shi wajen maganin African trypanosomiasis ga dabbobi masu toka na Najeriya, kuma ingancin sa yana bambanta a tsakanin nau'ikan trypanosome daban-daban. Yayin da za a iya amfani da Berenil don magance duka biyun T. vivax da T. congolense, T. vivax ta fi jin maganin sosai, wanda ke sanya ta zama zabin magani a yankunan da wannan nau'in ya fi yawa.

instruction: Wane magani ne na trypanocidal aka fi samunsa a shagunan sayar da kayan gona da magungunan dabbobi da kuma kasuwannin bude a Najeriya, kuma wane ne sinadarin dake cikinsa wanda yake gudanar da aiki (active ingredient)?
response: Berenil, wanda sinadarinsa wanda yake gudanar da aiki shi ne diminazene aceturate, shi ne maganin trypanocide wanda aka fi sayarwa a kasuwannin dabbobi na Najeriya tun daga 1955.

instruction: Wace kungiya ta kwararru ce ta fara matsawa NAFDAC a hukumance domin ta tsara dokokin kasuwar magungunan dabbobi a Najeriya?
response: Kungiyar Likitocin Dabbobi Ta Najeriya (NVMA) ita ce kungiyar kwararru wacce ta fara matsawa NAFDAC lambar a hukumance don ta tsara dokokin kasuwar magungunan dabbobi a Najeriya. Ya zuwa shekarar 2011, NVMA ta bukaci a fili cewa NAFDAC ta saka baki domin magance wannan al'amari.

instruction: Ta yaya ake bayar da riga-kafin IBD (Gumboro) ga kajin da ake kiwo a karkara?
response: Yawanci ana bayar da riga-kafin IBD (Gumboro) ta baki ne ta cikin ruwan sha, kuma mafi kyau shi ne a yi hakan da sassafe. Wannan hanya ana yawan amfani da ita a wuraren kiwon kaji a karkara saboda saukinta da kuma ingancinta.

instruction: Wace ka'idar ajiya ce NAFDAC ta dora akan alluran riga-kafi da ake shigo da su daga kasashen waje?
response: NAFDAC tana bukatar shaidar na'urar adana sanyi mai aiki don riga-kafin da ake shigo da su daga kasashen waje, tare da tabbatar da cewa ana adanawa tare da safarar riga-kafin a cikin ma'aunin sanyi da ya dace domin su ci gaba da kasancewa da karfi da kuma ingancinsu.

instruction: Me yasa likitocin dabbobi ke jaddada cewa a auna nauyi wajen bayar da maganin Berenil?
response: Likitocin dabbobi suna jaddada auna nauyi wajen bayar da Berenil saboda tazarar nauyin shanu yana da girma sosai, tun daga kilogiram 250 zuwa 665. Idan aka yi amfani da gwargwado daya ga kowace, hakan yana tattare da hadarin hana maganin aiki ko kuma kasancewarsa guba, wanda zai iya lalata kwakwalwa ko hanta. Shi ya sa likitocin dabbobi suka fi son tsara gwargwadon maganin daidai da nauyin kowace dabba, domin tabbatar da cewa maganin yayi aiki yadda ya kamata yayin da ake rage hadarin illar da zai iya haifarwa.

instruction: Wadanne alluran riga-kafi ne sashen Bacterial Vaccine Division na NVRI ke samarwa?
response: Sashen Bacterial Vaccine Division na NVRI tana samar da alluran riga-kafi da dama masu muhimmanci, da suka hada da riga-kafin Anthrax, Black Quarter, CBPP, da kuma Haemorrhagic Septicaemia. Wadannan alluran riga-kafi suna da matukar muhimmanci wajen kare dabbobi daga cututtukan kwayoyin cuta daban-daban kuma wani muhimmin bangare ne don tabbatar da kyakkyawan lafiya da amfanin gonarka.

instruction: Wace cibiya ce ta fi samar da alluran riga-kafin dabbobi na gida, kuma a ina take?
response: Cibiyar Binciken Magungunan Dabbobi ta Kasa (NVRI) ita ce babbar cibiyar samar da alluran riga-kafin dabbobi a gida, kuma tana nan a Vom, cikin Jihar Filato.

instruction: Ta yaya samun kwayoyin halitta daban-daban na cutar FMD a Afirka ke sanya bukatar amfani da riga-kafin quadrivalent?
response: Samun banbanci mai yawa yana bukatar amfani da riga-kafi na quadrivalent wanda aka tsarawa nau'ikan kwayoyin cutar na yanki (misali, A, O, SAT1, SAT2) don tabbatar da samun kariya.

instruction: Wadanne takamaiman hadura ne suke tattare da allurar riga-kafin 'Smithburn' ta RVF?
response: Allurar riga-kafin Smithburn ta RVF tana da yiwuwar komawa ta zama mai karfin cutarwa, wato tana iya komawa asalin yadda take da take cutarwa. Bugu da kari, tana iya haifar da yawan zubar da ciki ga dabbobi masu ciki, wanda hakan ke zama babban abin damuwa ga masu kiwon dabbobi da manoma.

instruction: Wadanne alluran riga-kafi na wasu cututtukan kwayoyin cuta na virus ne cibiyar NVRI dake Vom take samarwa bayan PPR da ND?
response: Baya ga cutar Poultry Pox da farankaso (Newcastle disease), NVRI Vom tana samar da alluran riga-kafin Fowl Pox, Rabies, da kuma Infectious Bursal Disease, wacce aka fi sani da cutar Gumboro, wacce ke kama kananan kaji kuma tana iya janyo asara mai yawa idan aka bar ta ba tare da an bayar da magani ba.

instruction: Mene ne sunan kasuwanci da aka yi wa rijista na hadadden riga-kafin shanu na bivalent don cutar CBPP da LSD?
response: Sunan kasuwanci da aka yi wa rijista na hadadden riga-kafin shanu na bivalent don cutar CBPP da LSD shi ne Bovivax CBPP + LSD.

instruction: Mene ne sunan kasuwanci da aka yi wa rijista na riga-kafin CBPP da ake samu a Najeriya?
response: Sunan kasuwanci da aka yi wa rijista na riga-kafin CBPP da ake samu a Najeriya shi ne Bovivax CBPP.

instruction: Ta yaya tsarin AgResults FMD Vaccine Challenge ke magance gibin da ke kasuwa?
response: Tsarin AgResults FMD Vaccine Challenge tana samar da tallafin kudi ga kamfanoni masu zaman kansu domin su kirkiri ingantattun alluran riga-kafi na quadrivalent wadanda aka tsara su musamman domin Gabashin Afirka, wanda hakan zai toshe gurbin kasuwa a wannan muhimmin bangare na kiwon lafiyar dabbobi.

instruction: Ta yaya makiyayan Fulani suke amfani da kulla alaka a tsakanin juna a matsayin wata kafa ta magungunan dabbobi?
response: Makiyayan Fulani suna dogara da kulla alaka a tsakanin su, ciki har da 'yan uwa da mutanen gari, a matsayin wata muhimmiyar kafa ta kula da lafiyar dabbobi. Suna amfani da wannan kulla alaka domin raba garken dabbobi a lokutan gaggawa da cututtuka, hakan na ba su damar hada karfi da karfe wajen kula da dabbobin juna. Bugu da kari, wadannan alaka tana taimakawa wajen musayar ilimi akan aukuwar kwari da cututtuka a yankuna daban-daban, inda hakan ke bai wa makiyaya damar sanin abin da ke faruwa kuma su canza yadda suke tsarin aikin su yadda ya dace. Har ila yau, kulla alaka yana matsayin wata kafa ta bayar da gargadi da wuri ba a hukumance ba, wanda yake ba wa makiyaya damar daukar matakin gaggawa kan sababbin barazana. 'Yan uwa a wasu yankuna kuma suna zama masu karbar dabbobin da suka rasa matsuguni, inda suke zama wani tallafi ga masu bukata. Wannan dogaro da kulla alaka shaida ne na muhimmancin zaman tare da hadin kai a rayuwar makiyayan Fulani.

instruction: Wace hukuma ta gwamnati a Najeriya ke tsara dokokin magungunan dabbobi, kuma yaushe aka kirkiri sashin kula da lafiyar dabbobin ta?
response: NAFDAC (National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control) ita ce hukumar gwamnati a Najeriya wacce ke tsara dokokin magungunan dabbobi. An kirkiri sashin ta na VMAP, wanda aka kebe musamman don harkokin dabbobi ne a ranar 11 ga watan Afrilu 2013.

instruction: Wadanne irin alluran riga-kafi ne na farankaso (Newcastle Disease) ake samarwa a NVRI Vom?
response: A NVRI Vom, wasu irin alluran riga-kafin farankaso (Newcastle Disease) da ake samarwa sune na Intraocular, Lasota strain, da kuma Komarov strain.

instruction: Lissafa yawan gwargwadon maganin Berenil na gaba daya domin saniyar White Fulani
response: Domin samo yawan gwargwadon Berenil na gaba daya ga saniyar White Fulani, da farko yi lissafin ninka nauyin saniyar na kilogiram da gwargwadon da aka bayar da shawara a kai na 3.5 mg/kg. Saniyar tana da nauyin 300 kg, don haka lissafin zai kasance 300 kg * 3.5 mg/kg = 1,050 mg na diminazene aceturate, wanda yake daidai da gram 1.05.

instruction: Mene ne sakamakon bayar da bayanan karya a lokacin yin rijistar NAFDAC?
response: Bayar da bayanan karya a lokacin yin rijistar NAFDAC yana da munanan sakamako. Kuna iya fuskantar hukuncin laifi, wanda zai iya haifar da cin tara ko ma daurin kurkuku. Bugu da kari, ana iya soke rijistar kamfanin ku, wanda hakan zai dakatar da ayyukan ku gaba daya. Har ila yau, za a bukaci ku biya NAFDAC diyyar asara, wanda ke nufin za ku biya hukumar diyyar duk wata asara ko barna da ta faru sakamakon bayanan karyar da kuka bayar.

instruction: Ta yaya tsawon lokacin da kwayar cutar LSD ke dauka kafin ta nuna alamu (incubation phase) yake haifar da rahotannin 'vaccine breakdown' (rashin aikin riga-kafi)?
response: Sau da yawa rashin aikin riga-kafi yana faruwa ne saboda dabbobin sun riga sun dauki kwayar cutar wato suna cikin 'incubation phase' a lokacin da aka yi musu riga-kafin, wanda zai iya sa riga-kafin ya kasa yin aiki wajen hana cutar. Hakan ya faru ne saboda kwayar cutar (virus) ta riga ta fara yawaita a jiki kuma ta fara kawo alamu, wanda ke sa ya yi wuya riga-kafin ya yi tasiri kuma ya ba da kariya.

instruction: Me yasa ruɗani tsakanin 'hanta' da 'huhu' ya zama babban kuskuren likitanci (clinical error) mai tsanani?
response: Jin 'hanta' maimakon 'huhu' zai iya haifar da babban kuskuren likitanci saboda hakan yana sa 'yan kasuwa su sayar da maganin tsutsar hanta (liver fluke medicine), alhali dabbar cutar CBPP ke damunta. Wannan magani da ba shi ba ne ba wai kawai ya gaza magance ainihin matsalar ba ne, har ma yana ba wa cutar damar yaduwa da kara kawo yawan mace-mace.

instruction: Wace doka ta rubutun jikin magani da tsawon lokacin amfani (labeling/shelf-life) ke aiki akan magungunan dabbobi da ake shigo da su a tashar ruwa?
response: A game da magungunan dabbobi da ake shigo da su daga waje wadanda suka iso tashar ruwa, akwai wata muhimmiyar doka ta rubutun jiki da tsawon lokacin amfani da ake amfani da ita. Magungunan dole ne su kasance suna da aƙalla rabin lokacin amfanin su wanda ya rage. Wannan yana tabbatar da cewa magungunan suna da inganci da amincin amfani a lokacin da suka isa gonar ku ko asibitin dabbobi.

instruction: Me yasa Kewayen Shinge na Dabbobi (Veterinary Cordon Fence) a Namibia yake da muhimmanci?
response: Kewayen Shinge na Dabbobi a Namibia yana da muhimmanci saboda yana raba yankin da babu cutar FMD a kudanci daga yankunan da cutar ta yi katutu a arewaci, wanda hakan ke zama wani shamaki na hana yaduwar cutar foot-and-mouth disease tsakanin wadannan yankuna biyu.

instruction: Ta yaya yawan saurin canza launin (mutation rate) kwayar cutar FMD zuwa 'topotypes' yake shafar ingancin riga-kafi musamman a Gabashin Afirka?
response: Yawan saurin canza launi yana haifar da nau'ikan 'intra-serotypic topotypes' da yawa wadanda ba lallai ne su bayar da cikakkiyar kariya a tsakaninsu ba, wanda hakan zai iya shafar ingancin riga-kafin FMD matuka a Gabashin Afirka. Wannan yana nufin cewa ko da riga-kafin ya bayar da wani matakin kariya ga wani takamaiman nau'in kwayar cutar, ba lallai ne ya bayar da cikakkiyar kariya daga dukkanin nau'ikan topotypes daban-daban wadanda za su iya tasowa sakamakon saurin canza launi ba. Saboda haka, manoma a Gabashin Afirka za su iya bukatar yin la'akari da yawaita yin allurar riga-kafi da kuma yiwuwar amfani da alluran riga-kafin da aka tsara su musamman domin yakar topotypes da dama a lokaci guda.

instruction: Me yasa aka san riga-kafin CBPP na 'T1/44' da haifar da mummunan illa a wurin da aka yi shi a jiki?
response: An san riga-kafin CBPP na 'T1/44' da haifar da mummunar illa a wurin da aka yi allurar a jiki saboda an samar da shi ne daga kwayar cutar da aka raunana wacce take da ragowar guba mai illa (residual virulence), wanda ke haifar da babban zazzabi (systemic) ko kumburi a wurin da aka yi allurar (local reactions).

instruction: Yi lissafin yawan ruwan maganin 1% ivermectin da ake bukata ga ragon Yankasa mai nauyin 30 kg akan gwargwadon 0.2 mg/kg
response: Don gano yawan ruwan maganin 1% ivermectin da ake bukata ga ragonka na Yankasa mai nauyin 30 kg akan gwargwadon 0.2 mg/kg, da farko ka lissafa jimillar gwargwadon da ake bukata a awo na milligrams. Ninka nauyin ragon a awo na kilograms da gwargwadon da ake bukata: 30 kg x 0.2 mg/kg = 6 mg. Kasancewar ruwan maganin ivermectin din 1% ne wato 10 mg/mL, raba jimillar gwargwadon maganin da yawan kaurin (concentration) domin samun yawan ruwan maganin da ake bukata: 6 mg ÷ 10 mg/mL = 0.6 mL.

instruction: Me yasa kimanta ainihin nauyin jiki yake da matukar muhimmanci ga magungunan anthelmintics (magungunan tsutsotsi/dewormers)?
response: Kimanta ainihin nauyin jiki yana da matukar muhimmanci ga magungunan anthelmintics saboda bayar da magani wanda bai kai gwargwadon da ya kamata ba shi ne babban abin da ke kawo juriyar magani (drug resistance) a tsakanin tsutsotsi. Idan ba ka bayar da ainihin gwargwadon da ya kamata ba bisa ainihin nauyin dabbar, ba lallai ne a kashe tsutsotsin gaba daya ba, wanda hakan zai ba wa tsutsotsi masu juriya damar haɓaka da yaduwa. Wannan zai iya sa maganin tsutsotsin ya zama ba ya aiki da shigewar lokaci, wanda zai sa ya yi wuya a iya magance matsalar kwayoyin cuta masu tsotse jini (parasite infestations) a cikin garken ku. Domin gujewa hakan, yana da matukar muhimmanci ku rika auna nauyin dabbobinku akai-akai tare da daidaita gwargwadon maganin tsutsotsin yadda ya dace.

instruction: Ta yaya faduwar kiba a lokacin rani a jikin awakin Red Sokoto yake shafar gwargwadon shan magani?
response: Faduwar kiba a lokacin rani a jikin awakin Red Sokoto zai iya zama mai yawa sosai, wanda yawanci yake farawa daga 28 kg zuwa 23 kg. Wannan babban raguwar nauyi zai iya yin tasiri kai tsaye akan gwargwadon magani, domin amfani da tsohon awo na nauyinsu zai iya haifar da shan magani fiye da kima (overdosing). Domin gujewa hakan, yana da matukar muhimmanci a rika lura da nauyin awakinku akai-akai tare da daidaita gwargwadon maganin yadda ya kamata, tare da yin la'akari da nauyinsu na yanzu don tabbatar da cewa sun sami adadin magani ko sinadaran da suka dace.

instruction: Wane irin riga-kafin bivalent wanda ya hada cututtuka biyu NAFDAC ta yi wa rijista a Najeriya domin tumaki da awaki?
response: Riga-kafin LYOPOX + PPR wani riga-kafi ne na bivalent wanda hukumar NAFDAC ta yi wa rijista a Najeriya domin amfani a tumaki da awaki. Ya hada bada kariya akan cutar Sheep/Goat Pox da PPR, wanda ya sa ya zama wani muhimmin makami ga manoman da ke neman kare garkensu daga wadannan cututtuka.

instruction: Mene ne sunan kasuwanci da aka yi wa rijista na riga-kafin Clostridium (Black Quarter) a cikin kayayyakin kamfanin MCI?
response: Sunan kasuwanci da aka yi wa rijista na riga-kafin Clostridium (Black Quarter) a cikin kayayyakin kamfanin MCI shi ne SYMPTOMUNE.

instruction: Saniyar da take zubar majina kuma tana tari
response: Idan hancin saniya yana zubar majina kuma tana tari, ya kamata likitan dabbobi ya yi zargin CBPP (wadda aka fi sani da hanta ko huhu) ko Haemorrhagic Septicaemia, wanda cutar Pasteurellosis ke haifarwa. Duk wadannan cututtuka biyu suna iya kawo matsalar numfashi a shanu, don haka yana da matukar muhimmanci a yi wasu gwaje-gwaje don gano ainihin abin da ke kawo wadannan alamu. CBPP cuta ce mai saurin yaduwa da ke shafar shanu a sassa da dama na Najeriya, yayin da Haemorrhagic Septicaemia wata cuta ce ta kwayoyin cuta wacce za ta iya janyo zubar jini mai tsanani da gaza aikin wasu sassan jiki idan ba a yi maganinta ba. Cikakken bincike, har da duba jiki gaba daya, gwajin jini, da kuma yiwuwar diban samfurin huhu don gwaji (lung biopsy), za su iya zama dole don tabbatar da cutar da kuma tsara ingantaccen shirin jiyya.

instruction: Ta yaya ka'idojin WOAH akan maganin kashe kwayoyin cuta (antibiotics) ke cin karo da gaskiyar abin da ke faruwa a zahiri (field reality)?
response: WOAH tana ba da shawarar yin taka-tsantsan wajen amfani da su idan ba zai yiwu a yanka ba, amma yawan mace-mace a lokacin ɓullar cututtuka yana sanya ba da magani cikin gaggawa ya zama kan gaba wajen warware matsalar a zahiri.

instruction: Rage tasirin matsalolin da ke shafar fatar dabba a lokacin bayar da maganin Berenil
response: Don rage yawan matsalolin fatar dabbar (local tissue reactions), hanyar da aka fi ba da shawara wajen yin maganin Berenil ita ce yin allura mai zurfi a cikin tsoka (deep intramuscular injection). Idan adadin Berenil din yana da yawa, zai fi kyau a raba allurar a sassa daban-daban na jiki don gudun hana ciwo mai yawa a waje guda.

instruction: Lissafa yawan gwargwadon maganin Berenil na gaba daya domin bijimin Red Bororo
response: Domin samo yawan gwargwadon Berenil na gaba daya ga bijimin Red Bororo, ninka nauyin bijimin a kilogiram da gwargwadon da aka bayar da shawara a kai na 3.5 mg/kg. Bijimin yana da nauyin 450 kg, don haka lissafin zai kasance 450 kg * 3.5 mg/kg = 1,575 mg ko 1.575 g na diminazene aceturate.

instruction: Ma'aunin gwargwadon maganin Berenil ga shanu a Najeriya
response: Domin shanu a Najeriya, ma'aunin gwargwadon maganin Berenil, wanda kuma aka sani da diminazene aceturate, shi ne 3.5 mg ga kowane kilogiram guda daya na nauyin jikin dabbar wanda ake bayarwa ta hanyar yin allura mai zurfi a cikin tsoka.

instruction: Wadanne magungunan dabbobi ne NAFDAC ta hana karara a yi amfani da su ga dabbobin da ake ci a Najeriya?
response: Chloramphenicol, Malachite green, Carbadox, Ronidazole, da rukunin Nitrofuran (wadanda suka hada da Furazolidone, Nitrofurantoin, da Furataldone) duk NAFDAC ta hana yin amfani da su karara ga dabbobin da ake ci a Najeriya. Wadannan sinadarai da aka haramta za su iya haifar da mummunan hadari ga lafiyar masu amfani da su, saboda haka an haramta su gaba daya domin tabbatar da amincin samar da abincin Najeriya.

instruction: Makiyayi Bafulatani na kauracewa wuraren da ke da magungunan dabbobi
response: Makiyaya suna kaurace wa irin wadannan wuraren ne saboda gudun matsalolin da ke biyo bayan bayar da magani ba bisa ka'ida ba — ciki har da shan magani fiye da kima, maganin da ba shi ba, da kuma amfani da shi ba daidai ba — wanda zai iya cutar da garken da ya zo ziyara ko kuma ya jefa dabbobin cikin hadarin kamuwa da kwayoyin cuta masu juriyar magani.

instruction: Mene ne kiyasin adadin dabbobin da ke cikin hadarin kamuwa da cutar trypanosomiasis a Afirka wadanda a tarihi suka sami magani?
response: Kimanin dabba 1 a cikin 10 daga cikin dabbobin da ke cikin hadarin kamuwa da cutar trypanosomiasis a Afirka ne suka sami magani a tarihi, wanda hakan ya bar wani babban adadi ba tare da magani ba kuma cikin hatsarin wannan muguwar cuta.

instruction: Me yasa riga-kafin kwayar cutar 'Smithburn' da ake amfani da shi don cutar Rift Valley Fever (RVF) ya takaita ne ga dabbobin da ba su da ciki kawai?
response: An takaita amfani da riga-kafin kwayar cutar 'Smithburn' don cutar Rift Valley Fever (RVF) ga dabbobin da ba su da ciki kawai saboda yana iya janyo zubewar ciki da kuma nakasar jarirai masu zuwa ga shanu masu ciki. Wannan wani muhimmin abin lura ne ga duk wani manomin dabbobi, musamman wadanda ke kiwon shanu, domin hakan yana iya haifar da munanan sakamako akan lafiya da kuma amfanin garken su.

instruction: Me yasa samun kariya tsakanin nau'ikan kwayoyin cutar FMD (serotypes) ya zama wani babban cikas ga tsarin aiwatar da allurar riga-kafi da AI ke gudanarwa?
response: Kariyar jiki (immunity) akan nau'in kwayar cutar Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD serotype) guda daya ba ya ba da kariya daga sauran nau'ikan, kuma sabbin nau'ikan suna yawan bullowa wadanda suke guje wa kariyar da riga-kafi ya bayar.

instruction: Wane kayan masarufi/magani ne ke yakar cutar Brucellosis a cikin shanun Najeriya?
response: Brucella S.19, musamman Brucella abortus Strain 19, wani riga-kafi ne da Cibiyar Binciken Magungunan Dabbobi ta Kasa (NVRI) da ke Vom, Najeriya ta samar. An tsara wannan riga-kafi ne don yakar cutar Brucellosis a shanun Najeriya, don taimakawa wajen kare su daga wannan babbar barazanar cuta.

instruction: Kaso nawa ne na manoma a yankin Eastern Guinea Savanna suka dogara ga riga-kafi?
response: Riga-kafi yana taka muhimmiyar rawa wajen hana yaduwar cututtuka ga manoma da yawa a yankin Eastern Guinea Savanna, inda wani kaso mai yawa da ya kai 56.9% suke dogara da wannan hanya domin kare dabbobinsu. Sai dai, yana da kyau a lura cewa adadin wadanda suke yin riga-kafin zai iya bambanta sosai dangane da kowane yanki, inda Jihar Enugu ke da mafi karancin adadi na 17.8%. Wannan yana nuna muhimmancin tsare-tsaren riga-kafi da shirye-shiryen fadakarwa na musamman don tabbatar da cewa dukkan manoma sun sami damar amfani da ingantattun hanyoyin hana yaduwar cututtuka.

instruction: Mene ne sunan kasuwanci da aka yi wa rijista na riga-kafin PPR wanda aka hada ta amfani da kwayoyin cutar da suka fi shafar Najeriya (strains endemic to Nigeria)?
response: Sunan kasuwanci da aka yi wa rijista na riga-kafin PPR wanda aka hada ta amfani da kwayoyin cutar da suka fi shafar Najeriya shi ne Ovivax PPR.

instruction: Me yasa wuraren kiwon shanu a Afirka ke yawan jinkirta alluran riga-kafi na tsawon mako 1 zuwa 3 bayan dabbobin sun iso?
response: Jinkirin gudanar da riga-kafi ga sabbin dabbobin da suka iso a wuraren kiwo na Afirka galibi ya samo asali ne daga ka'idojin rijista, wadanda ke bukatar a bada tazarar lokaci wanda hakan ke bayar da damar yaduwar cututtuka a tsakanin dabbobin. Wannan jinkiri na iya zama wani hatsari ga cututtuka su yi tasiri, wanda hakan ya sa yake da matukar muhimmanci ga masu lura da wuraren kiwo su daidaita tsakanin bukatun rijista da kuma kulawa da lafiyar dabbobin.

instruction: Wace matsala ta likitanci ke tattare da yi wa saniya mai shayarwa maganin Berenil?
response: Ragowar magani na fita ta cikin madara har tsawon kwanaki 21, wanda ke janyo hadari ga 'yan marukan da suke shan nono da kuma mutanen da ke amfani da madarar.

instruction: Wadanne sinadarai guda uku (active ingredients) manoma suka fi amfani da su don shawo kan cutar trypanosomiasis a fadin Yammacin Afirka?
response: Diminazene aceturate (Berenil), Isometamidium chloride (Samorin), da kuma Homidium bromide (Ethidium) su ne sinadaran da manoma suka fi amfani da su wajen maganin cutar trypanosomiasis a fadin Yammacin Afirka.

instruction: Mene ne 'ogwu ahu' a fannin kiwon dabbobi na Igbo?
response: A harshen Igbo, 'ogwu ahu' wata kalma ce wadda ke nufin 'maganin jiki'. A fannin kiwon dabbobi, galibi ana amfani da ita ne wajen nufin maganin zazzabi a dabbobi. Wannan zai iya hadawa da bayar da magunguna ko amfani da wasu hanyoyin magani don taimakawa wajen kula da zazzabi a dabbobi marasa lafiya.

instruction: Wace cuta makiyayan Fulani na Najeriya suke nufi a lokacin da suka ce saniya tana da 'hanta'?
response: Suna nufin cutar Contagious Bovine Pleuropneumonia (CBPP) ne. Ko da yake 'hanta' na nufin 'liver' a Hausa, makiyaya suna amfani da ita don kwatanta alamun cutar numfashi ta CBPP. Wannan galibi yana haifar da kuskuren gane cutar gami da bayar da maganin da ba shi ba, kasancewar ana amfani da maganin tsutsotsi (anthelmintics) maimakon maganin kashe kwayoyin cuta (antibiotics).

instruction: Me yasa amfani da kwayoyin cutar da suka fi shafar yanki (locally endemic strains) a alluran riga-kafi (kamar Ovivax PPR) yake da muhimmanci?
response: Amfani da kwayoyin cutar da suka fi shafar yanki a alluran riga-kafi, kamar Ovivax PPR, yana da muhimmanci domin kwayoyin cutar na kasashen waje (international strains) ba lallai su yi daidai da na gida ba, wanda hakan zai haifar da samun karancin kariya. Wannan rashin daidaito zai iya rage ingancin riga-kafin, inda zai bar dabbobinka cikin hatsarin kamuwa da cuta. Ta hanyar amfani da riga-kafin da aka tsara daidai da na yankinku, za ku iya tabbatar da cewa dabbobinku sun sami kariya mafi inganci akan takamaiman kwayar cutar da ta yi katutu a yankinku.

instruction: Akwai wani magani na ainihin musabbabin cutar LSD (causal treatment) kuwa?
response: LSD wata cuta ce ta virus, kuma a halin yanzu babu wani takamaiman magani na musabbabin cutar. A fannin kiwon dabbobi na Najeriya, muna mayar da hankali ne kan rage radadin alamun cutar da kuma hana yaduwar ta ta hanyar bin kyawawan hanyoyin tsafta, ware dabbobin da suka kamu da cutar, da kuma gudanar da riga-kafi idan hakan zai yiwu. A gonarka, yana da matukar muhimmanci ka yi aiki kafada-da-kafada tare da likitan dabbobi na gida don tsara cikakken shirin tunkarar barkewar cutar LSD.

instruction: Wadanne wasu kayayyakin dabbobi hukumar NAFDAC ta bangaren VMAP take kula da su?
response: Hukumar NAFDAC a bangaren VMAP tana kula da abincin dabbobin gida (pet food) da cikakken abincin dabbobi (animal feed), wanda ya hada da na gwangwani, abubuwan kara sinadirai, da magunguna masu gina jiki. Wannan yana nufin cewa duk wani abincin dabbobi ko kayayyakin abincin dabbobin gida da ake sayarwa a Najeriya dole ne ya cika ka'idojin da NAFDAC ta gindaya don tabbatar da cewa suna da aminci domin amfani kuma ba su da wasu sinadarai masu illa.

instruction: Ta yaya bukatar adana magunguna a 'cikakken kankara' (strict cold chain) ke kawo cikas wajen karbar riga-kafi a yankunan karkara na Afirka ta Kudu da Saharar (SSA)?
response: Ana bata alluran riga-kafi da dama a lokacin yin allurar sakamakon rashin adana su a cikin kankara mai kyau, wanda hakan ke rage karfin maganin. A yankunan karkara na Sub-Saharan Africa, tabbatar da cikakken sanyin kankara yana da wahala sosai sakamakon rashin samun isasshen na'urar sanyaya magunguna da kuma ababen hawa. Wannan yana iya sanya alluran riga-kafin fuskantar yanayi mai zafi har na wani lokaci mai tsawo, wanda hakan zai kawo nakasu ga karfinsu da ingancinsu. Hakan zai sa, ba lallai a iya yi wa dabbobin wadannan alluran riga-kafi ba a wadannan yankunan, wanda zai iyakance adadin wadanda za a yi wa riga-kafin kuma zai iya jefa su cikin hadarin kamuwa da cututtuka.

instruction: Mene ne sunan kasuwanci da aka yi wa rijista na riga-kafin Sheep and Goat Pox mai dauke da nau'in kwayar cuta daya (monovalent)?
response: Sunan kasuwanci da aka yi wa rijista na riga-kafin Sheep and Goat Pox mai dauke da kwayar cuta daya (monovalent) shi ne LYOPOX.

instruction: Wace lasisin kwarewa ake bukata domin yin rijistar maganin dabbobi a Najeriya?
response: Domin yin rijistar maganin dabbobi a Najeriya, za ku bukaci lasisi daga likitan dabbobi da kuma masanin magunguna (pharmacist). Bugu da kari, za ku bukaci lasisin wurin aiki daga Majalisar Likitocin Dabbobi ta Najeriya (VCN) ko kuma Majalisar Masana Magunguna ta Najeriya (PCN).

instruction: Rikicin Jihar Filato da tasirinsa akan samun riga-kafi
response: Rikice-rikicen kabilanci da addini a Jihar Filato ya sanya ba shi da tsaro ga makiyayan Fulani su samu isa Cibiyar Binciken Magungunan Dabbobi ta Kasa (NVRI) a Vom, wanda hakan ya tilasta musu neman alluran riga-kafi a kasuwannin da ba a tsara su ba a maimakon haka.

instruction: Wace dokar Najeriya ce ta baiwa NAFDAC ikon tsara magungunan dabbobi tare da hana sayar da su ba tare da lasisi ba?
response: Dokar NAFDAC Act CAP N1 LFN 2004 ita ce ta bai wa NAFDAC ikon tsara tsarin magungunan dabbobi tare da haramta sayar da su ba tare da lasisi ba. Wannan dokar ta bai wa NAFDAC karfin gudanarwa da kulawa akan shigo da magungunan dabbobi, rarrabawa, da kuma sayarwa a Najeriya, don tabbatar da cewa sun cika sharudan kariya da nagarta.

instruction: Me yasa makiyayan Fulani a Najeriya da yawa ba su amince da maganin Berenil da aka saya a wajen 'yan bumburutu da ke bakin hanya ba?
response: Makiyayan Fulani a Najeriya da yawa ba su amince da maganin Berenil wanda aka saya a wajen masu sayarwa a bakin titi ba saboda jabu da gurbatattun nau'ikan diminazene aceturate sun cika kasuwar sosai. Hadahadar kasuwancin jabu da gurbatattun magunguna a Afirka an kiyasta cewa ya kai sama da dalar Amurka miliyan 400 a kowace shekara, wanda hakan ke bayyana dalilin rashin amincewa ga wadannan wuraren da ba a tabbatar da su ba.

instruction: Mene ne sunan kafar intanet (online portal) domin yin rijistar magunguna ta NAFDAC?
response: Kafar intanet ta yin rijistar magani ta NAFDAC ita ce NAPAMS, wanda ke nufin Tsarin NAFDAC na Kula Da Lura Da Kayayyaki na Na'ura (NAFDAC Automated Product Administration and Monitoring System).

instruction: Mene ne ake nufi da 'go lean' a fannin kiwon dabbobi?
response: A fannin kiwon dabbobi, 'going lean' (ta-rabe ko rame) yana nufin lalacewa a hankali ko rasa kiba a jikin dabba. Wannan yana nufin dabbar tana asarar kiba da kuma namanta, wanda a galibi yake faruwa sakamakon rashin isasshen abinci, cuta, ko wasu matsalolin lafiya. A matsayin ka na manomi, yana da matukar muhimmanci a rika lura da yanayin kiba da lafiyar dabbobinku akai-akai don gano alamun ramewa da wuri, sannan a dauki matakan gyara don tabbatar da sun sami kulawar da ta dace da abinci mai gina jiki domin su kiyaye lafiyar jikinsu da kuma lafiyarsu gaba daya.

instruction: Mene ne shanun Mbororo?
response: Shanun Mbororo wani suna ne na nau'in Red Bororo ko Rahaji. An fi sanin sa da Fellata a kasar Chadi da kuma Djafoun a Kamaru.

instruction: Wadanne ne mafi kyawun nau'ikan shanu don karamar gona a Najeriya?
response: Ga karamar gona a Najeriya, wasu daga cikin mafi kyawun nau'in shanun da za a iya la'akari da su sun hada da Boran, Sahiwal, da kuma West African Dwarf (Muturu). An san Boran da juriya ga zafi da yawan bayar da madara, wanda ya sanya shi zama zabi mai kyau ga kiwon masu samar da madara. Sahiwal wani sanannen nau'in shanu ne, wanda ake darajawa saboda yawan madarar da yake bayarwa da kuma kudurcinsa na rayuwa a yanayi mai zafi. A daya bangaren kuma, West African Dwarf (Muturu) karamin nau'in ne wanda ya fi dacewa da karamar gona kuma zai iya samar da madara daidai gwargwado. Lokacin da kake zabar nau'in dabba, yana da matukar muhimmanci ka duba wasu abubuwa kamar yanayi, wadataccen abinci, da kuma ainihin abin da gonarka ke bukata. Bugu da kari, tabbatar kana yin aiki da kwararren mai kiwo ko mai sayarwa domin tabbatar da cewa kana samun lafiyayyu kuma ingantattun dabbobi.

instruction: Mene ne tubalin urea-molasses blocks ke samarwa kwayoyin halittar da ke cikin aljihu na farkon cikin dabba (rumen microbes)?
response: Ana amfani da tubalin urea-molasses blocks asali domin samar da sinadarin non-protein nitrogen (NPN) domin ya taimaka wajen narkar da abinci maras inganci a ciki.

instruction: Mene ne sunan da aka fi kiran Infectious Bursal Disease (IBD) a wajen jama'a?
response: Sunan da aka fi kiran Infectious Bursal Disease (IBD) a wajen jama'a shi ne cutar 'Gumboro'.

instruction: Wace cuta makiyayan Fulani na Najeriya ke nufi da 'boro'?
response: Makiyayan Fulani na Najeriya suna kiran cutar Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD) da 'boro'. Ana iya gane ta cikin sauki ta dalilin kuraje da miki na musamman da ta ke fitarwa a baki da kuma kofato.

instruction: Matsakaicin tsawon kafada (withers height) ga manyan shanun White Fulani (Bunaji) a cikin garkunan makiyaya
response: Matsakaicin tsawon kafada da aka ruwaito ga manyan shanun White Fulani a cikin garkunan makiyaya ya kai kimanin 130–135 cm.

instruction: Mene ne kalmar 'kumbura ta mutu da sauri da sauri' (blow up and die quick quick) take bayyanawa?
response: Mutuwar fuji daga cututtukan Blackquarter, Anthrax, ko mummunan ciwon gubar jini (acute septicaemia) shi ne abin da ake bayyanawa da 'kumbura ta mutu da sauri da sauri'. Wannan kalma akan yi amfani da ita ne wajen bayyana mugun faɗuwar lafiya ta saniya cikin gaggawa, wanda ya kan janyo mutuwar fuji. Wannan mummunan yanayi ne da ke bukatar kulawar likitancin dabbobi cikin gaggawa don hana yaduwar cutar kuma a tabbatar da lafiyar ragowar dabbobin garken.

instruction: Mene ne ake nufi idan saniya tana nuna tsananin zafi 'showing pepper' ko tana zafi 'dey hot'?
response: Dabbar tana da matsanancin zazzabi (pyrexia). Wannan wani mawuyacin hali ne da ke bukatar kulawar likitan dabbobi cikin gaggawa. Idan kana zargin cewa saniyarka tana nuna alamun zazzabi, lura da wasu alamun irinsu rashin cin abinci, yawan gajiya, ko shakar numfashi da kyar. A yanayi masu tsanani, matsanancin zazzabi zai iya janyo munanan matsaloli irinsu cutar mastitis ko kuma ma karshe ya jawo mutuwa, don haka yana da matukar muhimmanci a nemi taimakon kwararru ba tare da bata lokaci ba.

instruction: Mene ne sunan gida 'Muturu' ake amfani da shi domin kwatantawa?
response: West African Dwarf Shorthorn—wani karamin nau'in shanu, wanda ba shi da tozo, yana da juriya ga cutar tsando (trypanotolerant) kuma ana samunsu a dazuzzuka masu dausayi na kudancin Najeriya.

instruction: Mene ne babbar hanyar da cutar RVF ke yaduwa?
response: Cutar RVF tana yaduwa ne musamman ta hanyar kwari masu cutar, inda nau'in sauro fiye da 65 suke taka muhimmiyar rawa wajen yaduwar ta. Wadannan sauro sune manyan masu daukar kwayar cutar, inda suke harbar dabbobi da sauran halittu ta hanyar cizo.

instruction: Wane shekaru ne galibi bijimai a garken makiyaya suke isa lokacin haihuwa?
response: Bijimai a garken makiyaya galibi suna isa shekarun haihuwa a tsakanin shekaru 4 zuwa 5, amma wasu nau'in suna iya girma da wuri ko kuma da gima. Abubuwa kamar nau'in dabba, abinci mai gina jiki, da cikakkiyar lafiya suna iya shafar girmansu. Gaba daya, ana daukar bijimi a matsayin wanda ya shirya don haihuwa lokacin da ya kai matakin girmansa gaba daya kuma yana da kyakkyawan yanayin girma, karfi, da kuma iya hayayyafa. Wannan galibi yana faruwa ne a tsakanin shekaru 4 zuwa 5, amma yana da matukar muhimmanci a tuntubi masanin gida ko likitan dabbobi domin tantance mafi kyawun shekarun haihuwa ga ainihin garkenka.

instruction: Ta yaya matsanancin canjin yanayin zafi yake zama abin kawo damuwa (stressor)?
response: Matsanancin canjin yanayin zafi yana iya zama babban abin damuwa ga dabbobi. Canjin zafi da lema na gaggawa yana raunana garkuwar jikin dabba, wanda hakan ke sa su fi saurin kamuwa da cututtuka da kwayoyin cuta. Hakan yana faruwa ne saboda matsanancin zafi na iya kawo cikas ga tsarin tafiyar da ayyukan jikin dabba na asali, ciki har da narkar da abinci, sarrafa sinadarai a jiki (metabolism), da kuma hayayyafa. Lokacin da dabbobi suka fuskanci matsanancin zafi, jikinsu dole ya kara yin aiki tukuru don daidaita yanayin zafinsa na ciki, wanda zai iya haifar da munanan illoli da dama, ciki har da raguwar saurin girma, karancin haihuwa, da kuma karuwar yawan mace-mace.

instruction: Wace cuta ce makiyaya ke kwatantawa ta amfani da kalmar Fulatanci 'gortowel'?
response: Makiyaya suna kwatanta cutar tsutsar hanta, wadda aka fi sani da hepatic fasciolosis, ta amfani da kalmar Fulatanci 'gortowel'. Wannan cuta takan kasance tana da nasaba da alamu kamar kumburin wuya da kasan baki (bottle jaw) da kuma ramewa ga dabbobin da suka kamu.

instruction: Wace cuta makiyayan Fulani na Najeriya ke nufi da 'susa'?
response: Makiyayan Fulani na Najeriya suna kiran cutar parasitic gastroenteritis, wadda aka fi sani da PGE, da 'susa'. Wannan wata cutar tsutsar ciki ce ta gaba daya wadda galibi take zuwa da alamun gudawa wadda ba ta da jini. Yana da matukar muhimmanci a gano tare da yi wa cutar PGE magani cikin gaggawa domin hana gushewar ruwa a jiki da kuma sauran matsaloli ga dabbobinka.

instruction: Mene ne 'Kupe'?
response: Kalmar Hausa ta kaska, wadda ita ce ke yada cututtuka kamar heartwater da kuma redwater.

instruction: Mene ne kalmar Hausa ta cutar CBPP wadda take kiran ainihin sassan jikin da ta shafa?
response: Kalmar Hausa ta CBPP ita ce 'Huhu,' wadda take kiran ainihin sassan jikin da abin ya shafa daidai, musamman huhu.

instruction: Sunan gida na kamuwa da tsutsar kudan Tumbu (Tumbu fly larval infestation)
response: A yankin ku, galibi ana kiran sunan gida na kamuwa da tsutsar kudan Tumbu da 'Mango worm' ko tsutsar fata ('skin worm').

instruction: Mene ne sunan gida na nau'in shanun Sokoto Gudali?
response: Sunan gida na nau'in shanun Sokoto Gudali shi ne 'Bokolooji', ko kuma 'Bokoloji'.

instruction: Mene ne manoman kaji suke nufi da 'kaji suna cin junan su' (birds dey chop each other)?
response: Cin juna ko cire fuka-fukai sakamakon damuwa (stress) ko karancin abinci mai gina jiki. Wannan wata matsala ce da ta zama ruwan dare a kiwon kaji, wadda galibi karancin abinci mai gina jiki, cunkoso, ko damuwa (stress) ke kawowa. Idan kaji ba su samun isasshen sinadarin protein ko wasu muhimman sinadirai, za su iya fara sarar fuka-fukai ko naman juna, wanda zai haifar da munanan matsalolin lafiya. Domin hana wannan, manoman kaji suna buƙatar tabbatar da cewa kajinsu suna samun ingantaccen abinci (balanced diet) kuma ana ajiye su a wuri mai tsafta, maras damuwa.

instruction: Mene ne 'catarrh' tare da gyambon baki da gudawa a cikin awaki?
response: Cutar Peste des Petits Ruminants (PPR), wadda aka fi sani da 'annobar awaki' (goat plague), wata babbar damuwa ce a kiwon awaki a Najeriya. Ana gane ta da alamu kamar catarrh (majina), gyambon baki, da kuma gudawa, wanda zai iya haifar da mummunar faduwar kiba har ma da mutuwa idan ba a yi maganinta ba. Cutar PPR tana da saurin yaduwa sosai kuma za ta iya yaduwa da sauri ta hanyar kusanci tsakanin awaki masu cutar da masu lafiya, wanda ya sa gane ta da wuri da bayar da rahoto ke da matukar muhimmanci don hana barkewarta.

instruction: Mene ne ke bayyana 'custom feedlot' a tsarin Yankin Kudu da Saharar Afirka (SSA)?
response: A tsarin SSA, custom feedlot yana nufin inda mai gudanarwa yake bayar da hayar gurin kiwon ga masu dabbobi daga waje. Wadannan masu dabbobin suna biyan kudin amfani da gurin kuma su suke daukar dukkan asarar da ta shafi kulawa da sayar da dabbobin su. Wannan tsari yana baiwa masu dabbobin damar samun cikakken iko akan ciyarwa, kulawa, da sayar da dabbobinsu, yayin da shi mai gudanarwa yake samar da fili da kuma gine-gine kawai.

instruction: Wadanne fannoni daban-daban ne na nau'in shanu suke a Najeriya?
response: Najeriya tana da fannoni daban-daban na nau'in shanu, wadanda suka hada da West African Dwarf, West African Shorthorn, da kuma Boran. West African Dwarf wani sanannen nau'i ne ga kananan manoma, wanda aka sani da yawan haihuwa da kuma kudurcin rayuwa a yanayi mai zafi da lema. West African Shorthorn wani nau'in dabba ne da ake yawan kiwonsa, wanda ake darajawa saboda juriyarsa da sabawa da yanayi daban-daban. A daya bangaren kuma, Boran wani nau'i ne mai jure zafi daga Gabashin Afirka wanda aka kawo shi Najeriya saboda yawan madarar da yake bayarwa da kuma juriyarsa ga cututtuka. Lokacin da kake zabar nau'in da za ka kiwata a gonarka, yi la'akari da abubuwa kamar yanayin gari, wadataccen abinci, da abin da kake son samarwa domin zabar wanda ya fi dacewa da yankinka.

instruction: Fahimtar Illar Cutar CBPP ga Huhu (CBPP Lung Pathology)
response: A bangaren nazarin cutar Contagious Bovine Pleuropneumonia (CBPP), 'marbling' na huhu yana nufin kaurin fatun da ke raba sassan huhun (interlobular septa) sakamakon taruwar fibrin da ruwa. Wannan wata alama ce ta musamman ta cutar, inda siraran fatun dake tsakanin sassan huhun suke yin kauri kuma su kumbura, wanda hakan a galibi ya faru ne saboda taruwar fibrin da ruwa sakamakon kwayoyin cutar.

instruction: Fahimtar zazzabin cizon sauro (malaria) a shanu a Arewacin Najeriya
