response: Makiyayan Arewacin Najeriya suna amfani da kalmar malaria (zazzabin cizon sauro) ne don bayyana cutar zazzabi a shanu da ake yi wa magani da Duma rafi (Ipomoea isarifolia). A kimiyyance, ainihin malaria (Plasmodium) ba ta cika kama shanu ba — kalmar ta gida tana iya nufin zazzabin da kaska ke kawowa kamar anaplasmosis ko theileriosis wanda suke kawo alamu iri daya.

instruction: Mene ne kalmar 'Rugga' take nufi a tsarin kiwon dabbobin Najeriya?
response: Rugga tana nufin matsugunin makiyayan Fulani ko rugarsu, wanda shi ne wurin zama na al'umma a gargajiyance na makiyayan Fulani da dabbobinsu a Najeriya. Wadannan matsugunan a galibi masu sauya wuri ne kuma suna bin tsarin kwararar makiyaya, wanda yake ba su damar kula da shanun su da sauran dabbobin yadda ya kamata.

instruction: Fahimtar Cutar Aladu (Swine Fever) a Aladu
response: African Swine Fever, wadda aka fi sani da swine fever, wata cuta ce mai saurin yaduwa da ke kashe aladu. Ana gane ta da yawan mace-mace, wanda ya sanya ta zama babbar barazana ga kiwon aladu. Galibi cutar tana zuwa da alamu kamar zazzabi, amai, da gudawa, sannan kuma uwa-uba gaggawar tabarbarewar lafiyar aladun da suka kamu. Idan kana zargin akwai ASF a gonarka, yana da matukar muhimmanci ka tuntubi likitan dabbobi na yankin nan take domin hana kara yaduwar cutar da rage asara.

instruction: Me yasa karancin ruwa ya zama babban cikas ga masu gudanarwa a kasar Habasha (Ethiopia)?
response: Ciyarwa mai tsanani tana bukatar samun isasshen ruwa a kowane lokaci; karancin ruwa yana kawo cikas ga tsarin kuma yana kara sa dabbobi shiga cikin wani hali na damuwa (stress).

instruction: Me yasa barkewar cutar RVF take faruwa a tazarar lokacin da bai tsaya wuri daya ba na shekaru 5 zuwa 20?
response: Barkewar cutar RVF tana faruwa a tazarar lokacin da ba a kai-a-kai ba na shekaru 5 zuwa 20 saboda ambaliyar ruwa za ta iya janyo barkewar cutar. Wannan yana faruwa ne a lokacin da ambaliyar ruwa ta kyankyashe kwayayen sauro wadanda suka dade a kwance a busassun ramuka, wanda ke bai wa sauron damar hayayyafa da yada cutar ga dabbobi.

instruction: Mene ne manomi yake nufi da 'blowing up' (kumbura) ko kuma 'the belly don swell' (ciki ya kumbura)?
response: Manomi zai iya cewa saniya tana 'kumbura' ko 'cikinta ya kumbura' a lokacin da take fama da ruminal tympany, wanda aka fi sani da kumburin ciki (bloat). Wannan shi ne taruwar iska fiye da kima a cikin kwayar cikin dabbar, wanda zai iya zama hadari ga rayuwarta idan ba a yi magani ba. Yana da matukar muhimmanci a gane alamun cutar, kamar kumburin ciki, rashin natsuwa, da shakar numfashi da kyar, kuma a dauki matakin gaggawa don rage matsalar ta hanyar sanya bututu a cikin cikin dabbar don sako iskar da ta makale.

instruction: Mene ne matsakaicin tsawon shanun Kuri?
response: Shanun Kuri wani nau'i ne mai wuyar samu kuma tsohon nau'i na asali a New Zealand. A matsakaita, suna kai tsawon kusan mita 1.5 (kafafu 4.9) a kafada, wanda shine wurin da wuya yake haduwa da baya. Wannan ya sa su zama dabba mai jikin tsaka-tsaki amma mai karfi, wadanda suka dace da ainihin manufar halittarsu a matsayin dabbobin masu amfanin kashi biyu domin samar da madara da nama.

instruction: Mene ne ake nufi idan garken shanu ya 'fuskanci mutuwar fuji' (experienced sudden death) a tsarin yanke shawara na Fulani?
response: Mutuwar fuji ta shanu maras dalili tana kawo daukar matakai guda biyu: tashi — kwashe garken daga yankin nan take, da kuma addu'o'i na asiri — gabatar da al'adu don shawo kan abin da suke gani a matsayin tsafi ko maita (supernatural cause) a lokacin da ba a sami wani bayani na asali game da mutuwar ba.

instruction: Mene ne sunan 'transhumance' (kwararar makiyaya) a gida?
response: A Najeriya, yawanci ana kiran transhumance da 'Fulani suna bin ruwan sama' – wata kwarara ce ta makiyaya da shanunsu dangane da canjin yanayi da kuma samun wurin kiwo.

instruction: Wace matsalar narkewar abinci a ciki (metabolic issue) take da nasaba da abinci mai yawan hatsi a wuraren kiwon kiba (feedlots)?
response: Rumen acidosis wata babbar illa ce ta abinci mai yawan hatsi, domin yawan sinadarin starch da kuma karancin sinadarin fiber a cikin wadannan abincin na iya haifar da yawaitar asid din tsoka (volatile fatty acids) a cikin kwayar ciki (rumen), wanda yake kawo raguwar matakin pH kuma yana iya haifar da cutar laminitis, ciwon kofato (hoof abscesses), da wasu matsalolin lafiya a shanu.

instruction: Wace rawa 'yan kasuwar da aka kulla kwangila da su suke takawa a tsarin hada-hadar kayayyaki na kasar Kenya (Kenyan supply chain)?
response: 'Yan kasuwar da aka kulla kwangila da su suna taka muhimmiyar rawa a tsarin hada-hadar kayayyaki na Kenya ta hanyar kai zababbun tubalai daga kasuwannin makiyaya zuwa ga masu wuraren kiwon kiba (feedlot operators). Wannan ya kunshi nemo shanu masu kyau daga yankunan karkara da jigilar su zuwa wuraren kiwon kiba inda ake ba su abinci su yi kiba don kasuwa. Kwarewarsu wajen ratsa rikitattun hanyoyin kasuwannin makiyaya da wuraren kiwon kiba tana taimakawa wajen tabbatar da samun shanu akai-akai domin biyan bukatun kamfanonin sarrafa nama.

instruction: Me yasa dabbobin da ake shigar da su wuraren kiwon kiba (feedlots) na Habasha galibi suke da shekaru 4–6?
response: Dabbobin da ake shigar da su wuraren kiwon kiba na Habasha galibi suna da shekaru 4–6 saboda dabbobin suna fitowa ne daga wajen makiyaya da kananan manoma wadanda suke ajiye dabbobin tsawon shekaru da dama, wanda hakan a yawancin lokaci yana faruwa ne sakamakon kalubale da tsadar gudanar da babban kasuwancin kiwon dabbobi a yankunan karkara.

instruction: Mene ne 'blanket prophylaxis' a tsarin wuraren kiwon kiba?
response: Blanket prophylaxis a tsarin wuraren kiwon kiba yana nufin yin amfani da magungunan tetracyclines masu dadewa suna aiki akan duk dabbobin da zarar sun iso ko a lokacin duba su domin hana barkewar kwayoyin cuta. Wannan aikin ya kunshi yi wa dukkan dabbobin maganin kashe kwayoyin cuta (antibiotics) a lokaci daya, ba tare da la'akari da lafiyar kowace dabba daban ba, domin samar da kariya ga kwayoyin cuta. Ta yin hakan, masu kula da wuraren kiwon kibar suna da burin rage hadarin barkewar cututtuka sannan su kiyaye garken dabbobinsu cikin lafiya da kuzari.

instruction: Wace kwayar cutar anaerobic ce take kawo cutar Blackquarter (Blackleg)?
response: Cutar Blackquarter, wadda aka fi sani da Blackleg, tana faruwa ne sakamakon kwayar cutar anaerobic da ake kira Clostridium chauvoei. Wannan kwayar cuta tana rayuwa ne a wuraren da babu isasshen iskar shaka (oxygen), wanda galibi ake samu a hanjin shanu, kuma za ta iya kawo mummunar barna ga tsoka tare da kashe sassan jiki idan ba a yi magani ba. Yana da matukar muhimmanci a rika yi wa shanunka riga-kafi akai-akai, musamman a lokacin matsanancin damuwa (stress) ko a lokacin da ake shigo da sabbin dabbobi cikin garkenka, domin hana yaduwar wannan cuta.

instruction: Mene ne kalmar da ake amfani da ita don jima'i (castration) a tsarin Fulani?
response: A tsarin Fulani, galibi ana kiran cire gwaye da 'yanke', wanda kalmar Hausa ce dake nufin yankawa ('to cut').

instruction: Ta yaya cutar RVF take shiga tsarin abincin mutane?
response: Cutar RVF tana iya shiga tsarin abincin mutane ta hanyar cin danyen ko maras dahuwar kayan abincin dabba daga dabbobin da suka kamu da cutar. Wannan yana nufin cewa idan kana taba ko cin nama, madara, ko wasu kayayyaki daga dabbobin da suka kamu da cutar RVF, kana cikin hadarin kamuwa da ita. Yana da matukar muhimmanci ka kula kuma ka dafa kayan abincin dabba sosai da sosai domin hana yaduwar cutar RVF, musamman a yankunan da cutar ta zama ruwan dare.

instruction: Mene ne makiyayan Fulani a Kano suke kira da cijiciji kuma a wane wuri na jikin dabbar yake zama?
response: Cijiciji wani sunan gida ne na Hausa/Fulani wanda yake nufin wani nau'in kaska na musamman da yake zama a tsakanin kofaton shanu, wanda yake janyo gurgunta.

instruction: Wane nau'in tumaki ne ake kira da 'Ouda' ko 'Uda'?
response: Nau'in tumakin da kake magana a kai shi ne Ouda ko Uda, wani babban rago/tunkiya mai gashin da ya bambanta da saura: mai launin ruwan kasa (brown) ko baki a rabin jikinsa na gaba da kuma fari a rabin jikinsa na baya.

instruction: Wane nau'in shanu ne aka fi sani da 'Bunaji'?
response: Nau'in shanun White Fulani sune kusan kashi 37% na garkunan shanun kasar nan kuma ana yawan kiran su da 'Bunaji'.

instruction: Ta yaya rashin ingantattun tsare-tsaren kasuwanci a kasar Kenya ke shafar lafiyar dabbobi?
response: Rashin ingantattun tsare-tsaren kasuwanci a kasar Kenya yana shafar kyan dabbobi domin masu gudanarwa dole su sayi duk dabbobin da suke da akwai a kasuwannin makiyaya, wadanda a mafi yawan lokuta sun tsufa kuma suna cikin wani mummunan hali. Wannan zai iya haifar da karancin kyan dabbobin da ake kawowa gona gaba daya, wanda zai sa samun kyakkyawan yanayin kiwo da girman garkunan ya yi wahala.

instruction: Wace cuta makiyayan Fulani na Najeriya suke kira da 'sammore'?
response: Cutar Trypanosomiasis, wadda aka fi sani da African Animal Trypanosomiasis ko AAT, ita ce cutar da makiyayan Fulani na Najeriya ke kira da 'sammore'. Ana gane ta ta hanyar ramewa da rashin jini, kuma tana iya yin mummunan tasiri ga lafiya da yabanyar shanu.

instruction: Gane White Fulani da Red Bororo a tsarin sunayen makiyayan Arewacin Najeriya
response: A tsarin kiran dabbobi na makiyayan Arewacin Najeriya, yawanci ana kiran shanun White Fulani da 'bunaji', yayin da shanun Red Bororo kuma aka san su da 'rahaji'. Wadannan sunaye sun shahara sosai a tsakanin Hausawa wajen gane wadannan nau'in shanu na musamman.

instruction: Sunan gida na cutar Contagious Ecthyma (Orf) a tumaki
response: A Najeriya, cutar Contagious Ecthyma (Orf) a tumaki, yawanci ana kiranta da 'Sore mouth' ko ciwon bakin tumaki ('mouth disease of sheep').

instruction: Mene ne sunan kudan tsando, wanda shi ne kan gaba wajen yada cutar trypanosomiasis a Hausa?
response: Sunan Hausa na kudan tsando, wanda shi ne kan gaba wajen yada cutar trypanosomiasis, shi ne 'Kizo' ko 'kizoo'.

instruction: Mene ne 'rago' da 'tunkiya' a Hausa?
response: Rago shi ne 'ram', wanda yake nufin namijin dabbar, yayin da tunkiya ita ce 'ewe' ko sheep, wanda za ta iya zama namiji ko mace, amma galibi tana nufin macen dabbar.

instruction: Mene ne cizon hakori ko cizon bakin kansa yake nunawa ga shanu?
response: Cizon hakori (Bruxism), wanda alama ce ta ciwon ciki ko matsalar sarrafa abinci a ciki (metabolic issues) kamar ruminal acidosis, yawanci yana bayyana ne a shanu idan suna cin hakora ko cizon bakinsu. Wannan dabi'a na iya zama sakamakon rashin jin dadi ko radadi a cikin hanji, wanda zai iya zama ruminal acidosis ne ya janyo shi saboda abubuwa kamar karancin ingancin abinci, rashin isasshen ruwan sha, ko kuma rashin daidaiton kwayoyin halittar ciki. Idan ka lura da wannan dabi'a a shanunka, yana da matukar muhimmanci ka bincika ainihin musabbabin kuma ka dauki matakan gyara don magance matsalar, wanda zai iya hadawa da canza tsarin abincinsu, samar da ruwa mai tsafta, ko kuma bayar da magunguna don rage raɗaɗin alamun.

instruction: Tambayar Manomin Kaji
response: A lokacin da manoman kaji suka ce 'kaji suna ta faduwa babu gaira babu dalili' ('falling down anyhow'), galibi suna bayyana faduwa ko mutuwar fuji ne a cikin kajinsu ba tare da wani bayani ba. Wannan na iya zama alamar wata mummunar cuta ce, kamar velogenic Newcastle Disease, Gumboro, ko cutar Marek. Wadannan cututtuka suna iya yaduwa cikin sauri a garken kaji, don haka yana da matukar muhimmanci a gano musabbabin cutar kuma a dauki matakin gaggawa don hana ci gaban asara.

instruction: Manomi ya ba da rahoton saniya ba ta ci
response: Idan aka ce saniya 'ta ki cin abinci' ('she no want chop'), wata alamar hadari ce dake nuna akwai matsala. Rashin cin abinci (Anorexia) ita ce alama ta farko na wata cuta ta musamman da ta shafi duka jikin (systemic illness) a cikin shanu. Yana iya zama alamar cutar kwayoyin cuta (bacterial infection), kwayoyin cuta masu tsotse jini (parasites), ko ma rashin daidaiton sinadaran gina jiki. Idan ka lura cewa saniyarka ba ta cin abinci, yana da matukar muhimmanci ka gano musabbabin kuma ka magance shi da sauri don hana janyo wasu matsaloli. Duba alamun rashin lafiya, kamar gudawa, amai, ko kasala, kuma ka tuntubi likitan dabbobi idan ba ka tabbatar da ainihin abin da ke kawo matsalar ba.

instruction: Ta yaya kwangilan ruwan sha wanda dabbobi ke raba juna (shared water troughs) yake haifar da yaduwar IBR?
response: Kwayoyin cutar virus za su iya yaduwa ta hanyar shakar iska ko kuma taba juna lokacin da dabbobi daga sassa daban-daban suke raba gurbin ruwa guda daya.

instruction: Mene ne ma'anar kalmar 'Gudali' a Hausa?
response: A Hausa, kalmar 'Gudali' tana nufin shanu masu gajerun kaho, da gajerun kafafu. Akwai manyan nau'o'i biyu da ake samu a Najeriya: Sokoto Gudali da kuma Adamawa Gudali.

instruction: Me yasa riga-kafin kara karfin garkuwa (booster) na shekara-shekara ya zama dole ga riga-kafin kwayar cutar Neethling LSD?
response: Samun ingantacciyar kariya yana bukatar yin riga-kafin kara karfin garkuwa kowace shekara domin ci gaba da yin aiki yadda ya dace, wanda zai tabbatar da cewa riga-kafin kwayar cutar Neethling LSD na cutar farankaso (Newcastle disease vaccine) ya ci gaba da ba da kariya ta musamman ga garkenka.

instruction: Mene ne ake nufi idan aka ce 'kizo ya ciji saniya' ('kizo don chop the cow')?
response: Furucin nan 'kizo don chop the cow' (kizo ya ciji saniya) sananniyar hanya ce ta bayyana cewa saniya ta kamu da cutar trypanosomiasis, wata mummunar cuta ce da cizon kudan tsando yake jawowa. Wannan yanayin yana iya janyo raguwar kiba, karancin jini, har ma da mutuwa idan ba a yi maganinsa ba. Idan kana zargin cewa saniyarka tana da cutar trypanosomiasis, yana da matukar muhimmanci ka gaggauta neman kulawar likitan dabbobi, domin yin magani da wuri zai iya taimakawa sosai wajen kara damar warkewa.

instruction: Wace cuta makiyaya suke kwatantawa ta amfani da kalmar Fulatanci 'dauda'?
response: Makiyaya suna kwatanta Haemorrhagic PGE, wadda aka fi sani da tsutsar ciki mai kawo gudawa da jini (parasitic gastroenteritis with bloody diarrhea), ta amfani da kalmar Fulatanci 'dauda'.

instruction: Mene ne 'Kadangare'?
response: Kadangare wata kalmar Hausa ce da take bayyana kasala a hankali-a-hankali da kuma ramewa ga dabbobi, wanda galibi cutar trypanosomiasis ko cutar tsutsotsin ciki (helminthiasis) ke kawowa.

instruction: Wane nau'in tumaki ne aka fi sani da 'Balami' a arewa maso gabashin Najeriya?
response: Tunkiyar Balami wani katon nau'in dabba ne da ke saurin girma wanda aka sani a arewa maso gabashin Najeriya. A wasu lokutan akan yi rudi a tsakaninta da akuyar Sahel (Sahelian goat) wadda take da sunan gida daya, don haka ka tabbata ka tantance sifofin dabbar kafin ka yanke kowane irin hukunci dangane da garkenka.

instruction: Mene ne yake nufi idan aka ce shanu 'suna asarar jini' (dey lose blood) alhali babu wani rauni a fili?
response: Idan ka lura cewa shanunka suna fuskantar karancin jini (asarar jini) ba tare da wasu raunuka a fili ba, galibi hakan alama ce ta matsanancin karancin jini (clinical anemia) wanda kwayoyin cutar ciki kamar trypanosomiasis ko babesiosis ke kawowa. Wadannan kwayoyin cutar na iya raunana garkuwar jikin shanunka, wanda zai haifar da raguwar kwayoyin halittar jan jini da kuma rage karfinsu na daukar iskar shaka zuwa muhimman sassan jiki. Wannan zai iya zama babbar matsala, saboda haka yana da matukar muhimmanci ka yi aiki tare da likitan dabbobi don gano ainihin musabbabin kuma ka tsara hanyar jiyya don magance yaduwar cutar tare da dawo da lafiyar shanunka.

instruction: Me sunan Maradi yake nufi?
response: Maradi yana nufin akuyar Red Sokoto, musamman a kasuwancin tsakanin kasashe.

instruction: Mene ne ake nufi da 'kaza tana rera waka da hancinta' ('singing with its nose') a kiwon kaji?
response: A fannin kiwon kaji, 'kaza tana rera waka da hancinta' wata alama ce da ke nuna matsalolin numfashi. Yawanci tana da alaka da cututtukan Chronic Respiratory Disease (CRD), Infectious Laryngotracheitis (ILT), ko kuma cutar farankaso (Newcastle Disease) da ta yi tsanani. Wadannan cututtukan suna iya sa a rika jin kukan gurnani (gurgling sounds) ko kara mara dadi, wadanda ba su da kyau ga numfashi a lokacin da kazar ke fama da wahalar numfasawa. Idan ka lura da wannan alama, yana da matukar muhimmanci ka tuntubi likitan dabbobi don tabbatar da ainihin matsalar kuma a yi magani don hana yaduwar cutar tare da kare lafiyar garkenka.

instruction: Tsarin Kariyar Kwayoyin Cuta (Biosecurity) a wuraren kiwon kiba (feedlots) don fitar da kayayyaki na Habasha (Ethiopia)
response: Galibi ana bayar da rahoton cewa tsarin kariyar kwayoyin cuta (biosecurity) yana da karanci a wuraren kiwon kiba domin fitarwa (export feedlots) a Habasha, tare da rashin kyakkyawan tsarin tsafta ga ma'aikata da kuma masu ziyara gaba daya. Wannan rashin ingantaccen tsarin kariya yana iya janyo yaduwar cututtuka da kwayoyin cuta (parasites) tsakanin dabbobi, wanda hakan zai kawo nakasu ga lafiya da kuma yawan amfanin garken. Don inganta kariya daga cututtuka, wuraren kiwon kibar ya kamata su bullo da tsauraran matakan tsafta, wanda ya hada da tsaftacewa da kuma kashe kwayoyin cuta na wuraren akai-akai, kyakkyawan tsarin wanke hannu da tsafta ga ma'aikata da masu ziyara, sannan da kuma tsauraran matakai kan shiga da ficen dabbobi da mutane a cikin wurin.

instruction: Mene ne babbar alamar asali (hallmark) ta barkewar cutar RVF?
response: Bullar mummunar asarar ciki da ba a zata ba ga dabbobi masu toka wanda ke zuwa tare da mace-macen kananan dabbobi da kuma rahotannin shafar mutane.

instruction: Mene ne furucin 'fata tana barewa' ko 'fata tana zubewa' (skin dey fall) yake nufi?
response: Cutar Dermatophilosis, wadda kuma aka fi sani da Streptothricosis ko Kirchi (Rain Rot), wata kwayar cuta ce ta fata da take sa fata barewa ko kuma ta zube. Wannan cuta tana da yawa a cikin shanu, musamman a wuraren da ake yawan samun lema da ruwan sama mai yawa.

instruction: Mene ne 'karkataccen wuya' ('twisted neck') ko 'wuya ya karkata' ('neck dey turn') yake nufi a kiwon kaji?
response: Karkatar wuya (Torticollis), wadda aka fi sani da 'neck dey turn', alama ce ta raunin kwayoyin jijiyoyi da kwakwalwa na cutar velogenic Newcastle Disease (farankaso), wata cutar virus mai saurin yaduwa da kashe kaji. Idan ka lura da wuyan kaza ya karkata ko ya karkata zuwa wani gefe, wata babbar alama ce da ke nuna cewa garken kajinka zai iya kasancewa ya kamu da cutar farankaso. Wannan yanayin zai iya jawo mutuwa idan ba a yi magani ba, don haka yana da matukar muhimmanci ka dauki matakin gaggawa kuma ka tuntubi likitan dabbobi na yankin domin gano cutar yadda ya kamata da kuma maganinta.

instruction: Wace hukuma ce ke da alhakin tabbatar da dokokin tsafta na dabbobi a kan iyakokin kasa?
response: Hukumar da ke da alhakin tabbatar da dokokin tsafta ga dabbobi a kan iyakoki ita ce NAQS, wadda ke nufin Nigerian Agricultural Quarantine Service. Suna taka muhimmiyar rawa wajen hana yaduwar cututtukan dabbobi da kwari ta hanyar tabbatar da cewa dabbobin da ke shigowa ko fita daga kasar sun cika tsauraran ka'idojin lafiya.

instruction: Wace cuta ce makiyayan Fulani na Najeriya ke kira da 'bakale'?
response: Makiyayan Fulani na Najeriya suna kiran cutar Brucellosis da 'bakale', wata cuta da ke da matukar alaka da rashin haihuwa da kuma yawan zubar da ciki (abortion storms) a shanun su.

instruction: Wace irin bishiyar ganye mai ba da amfanin gona ce ake yawan habakawa don yin 'katangar bishiya' ('living fences') da kuma karin sinadarin gina jiki (protein) a Najeriya?
response: Bishiyar Leucaena leucocephala da kuma Gliricidia sepium duka zabukan da suka shahara ne wajen yin 'katangar bishiya' (living fences) da karin sinadarin gina jiki a Najeriya. Wadannan bishiyoyi masu ganye ana matukar daraja su saboda karfinsu na samar da ainihin sinadarin gina jiki ga dabbobi, kuma suna zama wani zabi mai kyau ga muhalli don yin shinge. An san bishiyar Leucaena leucocephala da yawan sinadarin gina jiki (protein), wanda ke sa ta zama zabi mai kyau ga shanun madara da sauran dabbobi masu toka (ruminants), yayin da ake yawan amfani da Gliricidia sepium saboda karfinta na sanya sinadarin nitrogen a cikin kasa da kuma samar da inuwa ga dabbobi.

instruction: Wane maganin kashe kwayoyin cuta ne (antimicrobial) aka fi amfani da shi a wuraren kiwon kiba (feedlots) a Yankin Kudu da Saharar Afirka (SSA)?
response: Maganin Oxytetracycline shi ne jigon magance cututtukan da suka biyo bayan FMD (FMD secondary infections), CBPP, da kuma BRD.

instruction: Ta yaya kura ke rage aikin fidda kwayoyin cuta daga huhu (mucociliary clearance) a cikin shanun kiwon kiba?
response: Kwayoyin kura a aikace suna toshewa kuma su gajiyar da tsarin halittar da ke da alhakin kwashe kwayoyin cuta daga cikin hanyar numfashi. Wannan yana iya kawo taruwar kwayoyin cuta (pathogens) da guba (toxins) a cikin tsarin numfashi, wanda hakan zai sa shanun wuraren kiwon kiba su fi saurin kamuwa da cututtukan numfashi. Tsarin kwashe kwayoyin cuta (mucociliary clearance system) wani muhimmin tsarin kariya ne wanda ke taimakawa wajen cire kura, kwayoyin cuta (bacteria), da wasu abubuwan waje daga cikin huhu, amma idan tsarin ya yi rauni, hakan na iya janyo munanan sakamako akan lafiya da walwalar shanun.

instruction: Me yasa siyan bijimai daga kasuwannin Borena a Habasha ya zama wata barazana ga tsarin kariyar kwayoyin cuta (biosecurity)?
response: Wadannan kasuwanni suna da tarihin cututtukan dabbobi masu yaduwa tsakanin kasashe, kamar cutar Foot and Mouth Disease, Lumpy Skin Disease, da Contagious Bovine Pleuropneumonia, sannan kuma galibi ana siyan bijiman ne ba tare da wani bayani kan yanayin lafiyarsu ba, wanda hakan ya sa siyan bijimai daga kasuwannin Borena ya zama wata babbar barazana ta shigar cututtuka (biosecurity risk) ga gonarku.

instruction: Alamun Cuta ga Shanu - kumburarren kafa da dingishi
response: Kumburarren kafa da dingishi ga shanu yana iya zama alamar cututtuka da yawa, wadanda suka hada da Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD), rube kofato (Foot Rot), ko kuma mummunar inuwar kaska (severe tick paralysis). Cutar Foot Rot ita ce wata cuta ta kwayoyin cuta da ke haifar da kumburi da radadi a kafafu, yayin da cutar FMD kuma wata cutar virus ce mai saurin yaduwa da ke shafar baki, kafafu, da nonuwan shanu. A daya bangaren kuma, cutar tick paralysis mai tsanani tana faruwa ne lokacin da kaska ta manne jikin fata ta kuma yi allurar miyau mai guba da zai iya kawo alamun matsalar jijiyoyi (neurological symptoms), wanda ya hada da dingishi. Yana da matukar muhimmanci likitan dabbobi ya duba dabbar domin gano ainihin musabbabin alamun kuma ya bayar da maganin da ya dace.

instruction: Ta yaya yawan faruwar cutar BRD (Bovine Respiratory Disease) mara nuna alamu (subclinical BRD) a wuraren kiwon kiba (feedlots) a Afirka ke kawo cikas ga lissafin 'Karin Kibar Yau da Kullum' (ADG)?
response: Cutar Bovine Respiratory Disease (BRD) mai nuna alamu da mara nuna alamu suna rage adadin Karin Kibar Yau da Kullum (ADG), wanda yake haifar da koma-baya akan karin kiba (growth performance) gaba daya. Cutar BRD wacce ba ta nuna alamu (Subclinical BRD) musamman, za ta iya zama wani babban kalubale a wuraren kiwon kiba na Afirka, saboda sau da yawa tana ci gaba ne ba tare da an gane ta ba har sai ta makara, wanda ke haifar da tabarbarewa a hankali a lafiyar dabbar da kuma tasirinta. Wannan zai iya haifar da raguwar tasirin abinci (feed efficiency), karuwar mace-mace, wanda a karshe yake sanya karancin ADG. Domin samun cikakken lissafin ADG, yana da matukar muhimmanci a samar da tsauraran tsare-tsare da kulawa don gano tare da shawo kan cutar BRD, wanda zai hada da gwaje-gwajen lafiya akai-akai, tsare-tsaren riga-kafi, da kuma matakan kare gona daga kwayoyin cuta (biosecurity) domin hana yaduwar cutar.

instruction: Ta yaya ci gaba da wanzuwar cutar CBPP a Kudu da Saharar Afirka (SSA) ta sha bamban da yanayin da take a Turai ko Amurka?
response: An kusan kawar da cutar CBPP gaba daya a yawancin sassan duniya in banda Afirka, inda take ci gaba da wanzuwa a mafi yawan kasashen Yankin Kudu da Saharar Afirka (SSA).

instruction: Wane nau'i ne makiyaya suke yabo wajen kasancewarsa nagari a fannin jure cututtuka?
response: Nau'in White Fulani, wanda aka fi sani da Bunaji, nau'i ne mai matukar daraja a tsakanin makiyaya saboda irin juriyarsa ta musamman ga cututtuka. An jinjinawa wannan nau'in bisa karfinsa na jurewa kalubalen kiwon lafiya daban-daban, wanda hakan ya sanya ya zama zabi na musamman ga wadanda ke harkar kiwon dabbobi. Garkuwar jikinsa mai karfi da kuma juriyarsa su ne manyan abubuwan da ke sa shi samun nagartacciyar kariya daga cututtuka.

instruction: Mene ne raba garken dabbobi (herd sharing) a tsarin makiyayan Afirka kuma a karkashin wane yanayi ne ake aikata hakan?
response: Raba garke wata dabi'a ce ta rarraba shanu tsakanin 'yan uwa da yaran da suka girma masu zama a yankuna daban-daban a lokacin da wata cuta ko yaduwar kwari (pest invasion) ta yi barazana ga garken. Ana yin wannan ne a lokacin gaggawa don rage yawan asara ta hanyar rarraba dabbobin zuwa wurare daban-daban.

instruction: Fahimtar Masu Dauke da Cutar CBPP
response: Dabbobin da suke dauke da cutar na dogon lokaci (carriers with chronic infection) suna killace kwayoyin cutar masu rai a cikin ramukan da ke huhu (lung lesions) kuma suna zama wata babbar kafa ta yada cutar. Wadannan dabbobi masu dauke da cutar CBPP wadanda ba su nuna alamar ciwo ba suna taka muhimmiyar rawa wajen yada cutar Contagious Bovine Pleuropneumonia ta hanyar boye kwayoyin cutar a cikin huhun su, ko da suna kama da masu lafiya. Wannan yana nufin cewa za su iya yada cutar ga sauran shanun ba tare da an sani ba, suna ci gaba da yada cutar ta CBPP a cikin garke ko kuma yanki.

instruction: Wane irin zabin asali ne na zahiri ake amfani da shi domin kaska da kyasbi (mange) a lokacin da babu magungunan acaricides?
response: A lokacin da ba a samun maganin acaricides, wata tabbatacciyar hanyar canji wajen kula da kaska da kuma kyasbi (mange) ita ce amfani da tsohon man inji (used engine oil) ko kuma kananzir. Sai dai, yana da matukar muhimmanci a lura cewa wadannan hanyoyin suna tattare da matsaloli masu yawa, ciki har da taruwar datti ko daskarewar magani (residue buildup) da kuma hadarin cutar kansa. Duk da wadannan hadurran, wasu manoma sun ga amfaninsu a lokutan gaggawa. Haka zalika, yana da matukar muhimmanci a duba hanyoyin da suka fi aminci da karko duk lokacin da hakan ta samu.

instruction: Me yasa AI zai iya tsammanin cewa tazarar da cutar CBPP (Contagious Bovine Pleuropneumonia) za ta iya yaduwa a karkashin wasu yanayin canjin yanayi na Afirka ba zai yi nisa ba?
response: Ko da yake galibi ana bukatar kasancewa kusa-da-kusa, cutar za ta iya yaduwa har zuwa tazarar mita 200 (200m) a karkashin yanayi mai kyau wanda zai iya sanya AI ta kimanta tazarar yaduwar cutar Contagious Bovine Pleuropneumonia (CBPP) idan ta dogara ne kawai akan hasashe na cewa yaduwar cutar tana bukatar kasancewa kusa da kusa ne kawai.

instruction: Me yasa ciwon gabobi a sassa daban-daban na jiki (polyarthritis) ga 'yan maruka yake zama wata babbar alama wajen gano cutar CBPP wadda AI zai iya mantawa da ita?
response: Ciwon gabobi (polyarthritis) ga 'yan maruka wata babbar alama ce ta gano cutar CBPP saboda kwayar halittar Mmm wacce ke kawo cutar tana da wata alaka (tropism) wajen shiga cikin gabobin 'yan maruka wadanda shekarunsu bai wuce watanni 6 ba, inda a galibi ta fi shafar gabobin carpal da tarsal. Wannan yana nufin cewa kwayoyin cutar suna kai hari kuma su kama gabobin kananan maruka, wanda hakan ke janyo ciwon gabobi mai raɗaɗi da nakasa. Idan har AI ya kasa kula da wannan alama, yana iya haifar da jinkiri ko kuskure wajen gano cutar, wanda zai iya kawo mummunar illa ga lafiya da walwalar dabbobin da abin ya shafa.

instruction: Me yasa gano cutar CBPP ga kowace dabba daya bayan daya ta amfani da gwaje-gwajen jini (serological tests) galibi ba ya yin tasiri?
response: Gwajin jini (Serological analyses) suna da matukar amfani wajen bincike a matakin garken dabbobi amma ba don duba kowace dabba daban ba, inda aka fi son amfani da PCR.

instruction: Ta yaya yanayin da ke zuwa da zamani (seasonal nature) na cututtuka ke shafar tsarin sanya musu idanu (tracking)?
response: Barkewar cuta tana da nasaba da yanayi mai lema/zafi gami da lokacin da kwari ke yawaita, wanda hakan ke sanya yake zama wajibi a sa ido sosai akan wadannan yanayi domin bibiyar yaduwar cutar cikin nasara. Yayin da zafi ke yawaita kuma lema ta karu, hadarin yaduwar cuta ma yana karuwa, wanda a galibi yakan yi daidai da lokacin da kwari masu dauke da cuta, kamar sauro da kaska suke yawaita. Ta hanyar fahimtar wadannan sauye-sauyen yanayi, za ka iya yin kyakkyawan tsari kuma ka shirya don fuskantar barkewar cututtuka, sannan ka dauki matakan kariya domin kare shanunka da hana yaduwar cutar.

instruction: A tsarin kiwon shanu na arewacin Najeriya, wane irin yanayi ake magancewa a gargajiyance ta hanyar kona dazukan da ke kewaye, kuma ta yaya hakan ke kawo tasiri?
response: Ana amfani da kona daji don hana yaduwar kaska. Yana aiki ne ta hanyar lalata kwayayen kaska da kashe kaskar a matakan girma nata a cikin ciyayi (vegetation), ta yadda za a katse kwararowar kaska ga garken (tick's off-host life cycle) kuma a rage barnar da suke wa garken shanun.

instruction: Me yasa wayar da kan jama'a game da lafiya ke da matukar muhimmanci a lokacin barkewar cutar RVF?
response: Wayar da kan jama'a game da lafiya yana da matukar muhimmanci a lokacin barkewar cutar Rift Valley Fever (RVF) saboda yana taimakawa wajen kiyaye mutane daga kamuwa da ita. Wannan ya fi muhimmanci musamman a yayin da ake taba dabbobin da suka kamu, kamar a lokacin haihuwa, fijewa, ko yanka. Idan ba a dauki matakan da suka dace ba, kwayar cutar za ta iya yaduwa zuwa ga mutane ta hanyar taba naman dabbobin da suka kamu (infected animal tissues) ko ruwan jikinsu (bodily fluids), wanda zai iya janyo matsanancin ciwo ko ma mutuwa. Don haka, koyar da jama'a yadda za su yi amfani da kuma jefar da dabbobin da suka kamu lafiya yana da matukar muhimmanci wajen kiyaye yaduwar cutar RVF ga mutane.

instruction: Ta yaya wanzuwar cutar FMD (FMD endemicity) ke shafar saka hannun jari a Zambiya?
response: Ana tunanin cewa wanzuwar cutar FMD ce ke sanya rashin samun kyakkyawan zuba jari a fannin kiwon dabbobi na kasar, kasancewar masu zuba jari galibi suna ganin cewa fuskantar barazanar barkewar cutar yana da yawa idan an kwatanta da tsadar shigar ta. Wannan tunani zai iya haifar da rashin zuba jari a bangaren, wanda zai kawo cikas ga bunkasarsa da ci gabansa. Sakamakon haka, masana'antar kiwon dabbobi a Zambiya za ta iya fuskantar wahala wajen kaiwa ga cikakken karfinta, wanda zai yi tasiri ga tattalin arzikin kasar gaba daya da kuma wadataccen abinci (food security).

instruction: Cutar CBPP tana kama mutane (Zoonotic)?
response: Babu wata shaida da ke nuna cewa cutar CBPP na shafar mutane, wanda ke nufin cewa ba cuta ba ce da ke iya shiga daga shanu zuwa ga mutane. Cutar CBPP, ko Contagious Bovine Pleuro-pneumonia, musamman tana shafar shanu ne kuma babbar barazana ce ga masana'antar kiwon dabbobi a Najeriya, musamman a yankunan da cutar ta zama ruwan dare.

instruction: Matsalolin gano cutar Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD) a lokacin da take boye tana girma (incubation phase)
response: A lokacin da kake kokarin gano cutar Lumpy Skin Disease a matakinta na farko, daya daga cikin manyan kalubale shi ne cewa alamun farko kamar zazzabi da zubar hawaye a galibi ba su fito karara ba, wanda za a iya samun rudani cikin sauki da sauran cututtuka. Har sai bayan makonni 2-5 da kamuwa da cutar kafin kumbura masu kuraje (nodular lesions) su fara fitowa, wanda hakan ke nuna cewa ya kamata a rika sanya wa shanun ku ido a wannan lokacin sannan a yi la'akari da wasu matakan bincike kamar gwajin jini ko PCR domin tabbatar da kasancewar cutar LSD.

instruction: Gane kaskar dake yada cutar Heartwater (Heartwater tick vector) a Najeriya
response: A Najeriya, nau'in kaskar da ya fi kowacce yada cutar Heartwater, wadda aka fi sani da Cowdriosis, ita ce Amblyomma variegatum. Wannan kaskar ita ce babbar hanyar yada cutar, wacce take shafar shanu da sauran dabbobi. Yana da matukar muhimmanci ku rika duba Amblyomma variegatum a yankinku sannan kuma ku dauki matakan da suka dace don kiyaye kai daga kaska da kuma rage yiwuwar yaduwar cutar Heartwater.

instruction: Mene ne sunan Hausa na gida na Contagious Bovine Pleuropneumonia (CBPP) wanda yake kwatanta 'kaki na tari' (hacking cough)?
response: Sunan Hausa na gida na Contagious Bovine Pleuropneumonia (CBPP) shi ne Huhu, wanda yawanci ana alaka shi da wani yanayi na 'kaki na tari' a cikin shanun da suka kamu. Wannan cuta ita ce babbar abin damuwa a cikin mafi yawan garkunan shanun Najeriya, kuma gane alamunta da wuri na da matukar muhimmanci domin kula da ita da hana yaduwarta.

instruction: Me yasa galibi ake samun jinkirin gano cutar RVF a dabbobi?
response: Galibi ana gane barkewar cutar a tsakanin dabbobi ne kawai bayan an gano ta a cikin jama'ar yankin, wanda hakan zai iya kawo jinkiri wajen gane da kuma magance matsalar a dabbobi. Wannan yana faruwa ne saboda cutar RVF za ta iya bayyana kanta daban a jikin mutane da dabbobi, kuma alamun a dabbobi na iya zama ba masu tsanani ba ne ko ba su da takamaiman alamu, wanda zai sanya gane cutar da wuri ya kasance da wahala. Saboda haka, yana da matukar muhimmanci a kula sosai sannan a kafa ka'idojin bincike da gwaje-gwaje akai-akai domin gano cutar RVF a dabbobi kafin ta fara yaduwa.

instruction: Mene ne ake nufi da 'gudawa' (toilet run ko watery stool) a kaji?
response: Gudawa wacce ke da alaka da cutar Newcastle Disease, Gumboro, ko coccidiosis, ana yawan kiranta da 'gudawar ruwa' ('watery stool/toilet run') a cikin kaji. Wadannan cututtukan suna iya jawo manyan matsalolin lafiya ko ma mutuwa a kaji, don haka yana da matukar muhimmanci ka gano ainihin musabbabin sannan ka dauki mataki da wuri domin hana yaduwar cutar.

instruction: Tasirin haramcin kasuwanci na Masar da Habasha a 2005/2006
response: Haramcin kasuwanci na Masar a 2005/2006 ya yi tasiri mai girma a kan Habasha, wanda hakan ya jawo wa kasar asarar kudaden shiga sama da Dalar Amurka miliyan 14 (USD 14 million). An yi haramcin ne sakamakon fargabar yaduwar cututtuka, wanda hakan ya jawo tsayawar kasuwanci tsakanin kasashen biyu.

instruction: Me yasa aka dauki matsalar shiga kasuwa a matsayin babban cikas fiye da matsalar cututtuka?
response: Masu masana'antu sun fi mayar da hankali ga kalubalen kudi na gaggawa kamar matsalar shiga kasuwa da kuma tsadar abincin dabbobi sama da barazanar cututtuka saboda wadannan kalubalen suna shafar ayyukansu na yau da kullum da kuma riba kai tsaye. Matsalar shiga kasuwa, musamman ma, ita ce babban abin damuwa saboda tana shafar damar su ta sayar da hajarsu tare da samun farashi mai kyau, wanda ya sa ta zama matsala da ta fi ba da damuwa fiye da barazanar cututtuka, wanda ko da yake yana da muhimmanci, a galibi ana ganinsa a matsayin matsalar da ke daukar lokaci (longer-term problem).

instruction: Wadanne asarori ne ba na kai-tsaye ba (indirect losses) na FMD?
response: Wadannan sun hada da kudaden daukar matakan kariya, gwaje-gwaje, da kuma tasirin asarar kudi sakamakon hana samun shiga kasuwannin kasashen waje.

instruction: Ta yaya kasancewa a matsayin dabba mai kwayoyin cutar Infectious Bovine Rhinotracheitis (IBR) marasa alamu (latent carrier status) yake kawo cikas ga kasuwanci?
response: Shanun da suke dauke da cutar da ba ta bayyana ba (latently infected cattle) suna zama wata kafa da aka sani wacce take kawo cikas a harkar kasuwancin kasa-da-kasa. Wannan kuwa ya faru ne saboda wadannan dabbobi da ba sa nuna alama za su iya yada kwayar cutar ga sauran dabbobi ba tare da an sani ba, wanda zai iya kawo barkewar cututtuka a sabbin yankuna ko kasashe. Sakamakon haka, kasashe suna iya sanya takunkumi wajen hana shigowa da shanu daga yankunan da cutar IBR ta yi katutu, domin su kare nasu shanun da kuma ci gaba da kiyaye matsayinsu na zama masu 'yanci daga cutar (disease-free status). Wannan yana da tasiri mai girma a fuskar tattalin arziki ga manoma da masana'antar kiwon dabbobi gaba daya.

instruction: Bayyanar alamun RVF ga mutane da kuma 'yan maruka (neonatal calves)
response: A jikin mutane, yawanci RVF tana bayyana ne da alamu masu kama da mura (influenza-like symptoms), amma ga 'yan maruka (neonatal calves), tana jawo mummunan yanayi mai barazana ga rayuwa, wanda ya hada da zazzabi, shawara (jaundice), da kuma rashin sa'a, yawan mace-mace da ya kai har 100%. Wannan yana nuna matukar muhimmancin kiyaye lafiyar dabbobi (veterinary care) cikin gaggawa da kuma matakan kariya daga kwayoyin cuta don hana yaduwar RVF a wuraren da ake fuskantar barazana mai yawa, musamman a yankunan da cutar ta yi katutu.

instruction: Shin FMD cuta ce dake kama mutane (zoonotic)?
response: FMD, ko Foot and Mouth Disease, ana kallonta a matsayin wata yar karamar barazana ce dake iya kama mutane. Wannan na nufin kodayake ainihin tana shafar dabbobi ne, akwai yiwuwar ta shafi mutane amma kankani ne sosai. Duk da haka, har yanzu yana da matukar muhimmanci a kula da dabbobin da suka kamu da cutar tare da guje wa kusanci sosai da su don rage duk wani barazana da zai iya yiwuwa.

instruction: Me gyambon baki ('mouth sore') da na kafa ('leg sore') a lokaci daya ke nufi ga awaki/tumaki?
response: Su ne manyan alamun cutar Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD). Wannan mummunar cuta mai yaduwa ta virus tana shafar dabbobi masu tsakewar kofato (cloven-hoofed animals) irinsu awaki da tumaki, inda suke kawo kuraje ko miki a bakinsu da kofatonsu, wanda yake janyo musu gurgunta da kuma rashin natsuwa. Idan ka lura da wadannan alamun, yana da matukar muhimmanci ka gaggauta ware dabbobin da suka kamu daga saura sannan ka nemi kulawar likitan dabbobi don hana yaduwar cutar ga sauran dabbobin garkenka.

instruction: Me yasa ma'aikatan ririta dabbobi suke share maganar cuta a matsayin matsala a bincikensu?
response: Ma'aikatan sau da yawa suna ba da fifiko kan samun shiga kasuwanni, farashin abinci, da karancin ruwa a matsayin wasu muhimman kalubale, inda suke rufe gaskiyar cewa cuta wani matsala ne a yayin binciken su.

instruction: Ta yaya yin mu'amala da 'jariran da suka zube' ke sanya ma'aikata cikin hadari?
response: Tabawa kai tsaye da tsokar dabbar da ta kamu da cuta a lokacin da ambaliyar zubar da ciki (abortion storms) ta faru wani babban abin barazana ne da ke jefa mutane cikin hatsarin kamuwa da cuta. Lokacin da ake daukar jariran da suka zube, ma'aikata suna fuskantar hatsarin kamuwa da cututtuka kamar brucellosis, leptospirosis, da zazzabin Q (Q fever), wadanda za a iya dauka ta hanyar haduwa da tsokar da ta kamu, ruwayen da ke fita a jiki, ko wuraren da suka gurbata. Yana da matukar muhimmanci ga ma'aikata su sanya kayan kariya (PPE), wanda ya hada da safar hannu, abin rufe fuska, da abin kare ido, kuma su bi tsarin kariya da lafiya (biosecurity protocols) don rage hatsarin kamuwa da cutar.

instruction: Mene ne bambanci tsakanin 'koyon ido' (dull eye) da 'hasken ido' (shine eye)?
response: Hasken ido alama ce ta lafiya da kuzarin dabba, yayin da koyon ido ke nuna wata matsalar lafiya da ta shafi duka jikin, gushewar ruwa, ko kuma ciwo a jikin dabbar.

instruction: Wace rawa yakar kwari (vector control) ke takawa wajen rigakafin RVF?
response: Yakar kwari na taka muhimmiyar rawa wajen rigakafin cutar Rift Valley Fever (RVF), amma yana iya kasancewa mai wahala saboda dabi'o'i daban-daban da sarkakiya na sauron da ke yada cutar. Wadannan sauro suna da yanayin rayuwa da ya sha banban, wanda ke kawo wahalar daukar matakan da suka fi dacewa. Duk da haka, ana iya cimma burin yakar sauron ta hanyar hada wasu matakai kamar kawar da wuraren hayayyasar sauro, yin amfani da magungunan kashe kwari, da kuma bullo da masu cin tsutsar sauron. Ta hanyar rage yawan sauron, ana iya rage hadarin yada RVF, amma yana da matukar muhimmanci a lura cewa yakar kwari ya fi tasiri ne idan aka hada da wasu matakan kariya kamar riga-kafi da kuma gano cutar da wuri.

instruction: Ta yaya 'rasa motsin cikin dabba' (rumen atony) yake aiki a matsayin alama ta BRD ga dabbobin garken kiwo?
response: Rashin motsin cikin dabba wata muhimmiyar alama ce ta Bovine Respiratory Disease (BRD) a garken kiwon shanu. Yana nuna cewa cikin dabba ya fada ne, wanda hakan kyakkyawar alama ce ta cutar. Idan cikin dabbar ya kamu da cutar, hakan zai iya haifar da raguwar cin abinci, matsala wajen narkar da abinci, da kuma koma baya ga lafiyar dabbar gaba daya. Wannan yana tare da sauran alamu kamar gajiya, rashin cin abinci, da wahalar numfashi. Ya kamata a tuntubi likitan dabbobi domin ya tabbatar da ganewar cutar da kuma bayar da maganin da ya dace don hana cigaban matsalolin.

instruction: Me yasa AI zai iya fassara ba daidai ba game da kwayoyin necrotic 'sit-fast' a cikin cutar LSD?
response: Kurajen (Nodules) suna bushewa kuma suna rabuwa da fatar da ke kewayensu a matsayin 'sit-fast' cores, wadanda sune ke alamta cutar.

instruction: Fahimtar Rift Valley Fever (RVF) A Dabbobin Kiwo
response: Rift Valley Fever (RVF) a cikin dabbobin kiwo yawanci ana gane ta ne bayan mutane sun kamu da cutar, wanda zai iya zama matsala ga yin riga-kafi da wuri. Zubar ciki mai yawa a lokaci guda (near-simultaneous abortions) ita ce alamar cutar RVF a cikin dabbobi, inda hakan ke zama wani babban jami'in gargaɗi (primary sentinel) ga mutane. A takaice dai, wadannan 'zubar da ciki masu yawa' za su iya nuna alamar kasancewar RVF a yankinku, wanda zai baku damar daukar mataki da wuri don kiyaye lafiyar dabbobinku da na mutane.

instruction: Wace kwayar cuta ce ke jawo cutar Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD)?
response: Kwayar cutar da ke jawo Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD) ita ce kwayar cutar Neethling, wacce take daga cikin dangin Capripoxvirus. Wannan virus ita ce ke da alhakin shinfida munanan kuraje a fata tare da wasu alamun da ke da alaka da LSD a cikin shanu.

instruction: Menene babban bambancin alamun cuta tsakanin FMD da Bovine Ephemeral Fever (BEF)?
response: FMD yana kawo mafitsara (vesicles) ko zaizayar fata na musamman a baki da kofato, yayin da cutar Bovine Ephemeral Fever (BEF) ke zuwa da gurguntan nan-da-nan (sudden lameness), ciwon kafa dake koma wa daga nan zuwa can (shifting leg pain), da kuma matsanancin zazzabi, amma ba tare da alamun mafitsara na musamman da ake gani a FMD ba.

instruction: Menene ainihin yadda ake gane African Animal Trypanosomiasis (AAT) a cikin shanun zebu?
response: Ramewa (Chronic wasting), yawan raguwar jini (progressive anaemia), da kuma zazzabi wanda baya tsayawa (intermittent fever) sune manyan alamun African Animal Trypanosomiasis (AAT) a shanun zebu. Wadannan alamu zasu iya faruwa ne sakamakon illar kwayoyin cutar ga kwayoyin jinin dabba (red blood cells) gami da lafiyar ta gaba daya, wanda hakan zai jawo asarar kiba da rage kuzari idan har ba a yi magani ba.

instruction: Mene ne 'dry cow' (shanyayyiyar saniya) ta fuskar cuta?
response: Saniya mai shayarwa wadda ta daina samar da madara ba-zata (suddenly) sakamakon damuwa (stress), ciwon mama (mastitis), ko wani ciwo. Wannan zai iya zama wani hali na musamman, saboda saniyar da ta daina bayar da madara ta fi shiga hadarin kamuwa da cuta kuma tana buƙatar kyakkyawar kulawa don gujewa wasu matsaloli, kamar ciwon nono ko sauran matsalolin lafiya.

instruction: Mene ne muhimmancin 'tsetse belt'?
response: 'Tsetse belt' wani yanki ne a Tsakiyar Najeriya (Middle Belt) inda kudan tsando (tsetse flies) suka yi katutu. Wannan yanki yana da muhimmanci saboda kudan tsando ne jigon yada cutar trypanosomiasis, wadda kuma aka sani da nagana, wata mummunar cuta da ke shafar shanu da sauran dabbobin gida. Yankin 'tsetse belt' yana zama babbar barazana ga harkar kiwo da kiwon dabbobi a wannan yanki, wanda hakan ya sa ya zama wajibi manoma su dauki matakan kariya da kuma hana yaduwar cutar.

instruction: Mene ne 'fara' ta fuskar lafiyar dabbobi?
response: Cutar tsutsa (Blowfly strike), wadda aka fi sani da myiasis, wani mummunan yanayi ne inda tsutsotsi (maggots) suke shiga cikin raunukan dabbobinku. Wannan yana iya yin matukar barna musamman ga tumaki, awaki, da sauran dabbobi, kasancewar zai iya haifar da mummunan radadi, kwayoyin cuta (infection), har ma da mutuwa idan ba a yi magani ba. Domin hana fara, tabbatar an wanke kuma an daure raunukan dabbobinku ba tare da bata lokaci ba, sannan a yi la'akari da amfani da maganin shafawa don kora kudan.

instruction: Ta yaya cutar Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) ta fi yaduwa a tsakanin shanu a cikin garke?
response: Cutar Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) tana yaduwa ne musamman a tsakanin shanu a cikin garke ta hanyar shakar iska (aerosol transmission) da kuma taba ruwan kurajen kai tsaye. Yaduwa ta hanyar shakar iska tana faruwa ne lokacin da dabbar da ta kamu ta yi tari, atishawa, ko fitar da numfashi, tana fitar da kwayar cutar a cikin iska, wanda kuma wasu dabbobin za su iya shakarsa. Taba ruwan kurajen kai tsaye na faruwa ne lokacin da kuraje ko mikin dabbar da ta kamu suka taba fata ko sashen jikin wata dabbar, wanda hakan ke bai wa kwayar cutar damar shiga sabon gangar jikin. Dukkan wadannan hanyoyin yaduwa biyu za su iya haifar da saurin yaduwar FMD a cikin garke, wanda ya sanya ya zama dole a aiwatar da tsauraran matakan kariya (biosecurity measures) domin hana shigowa da yaduwar cutar.

instruction: Mene ne sunan gida na kamuwa da tsutsotsi a cikin raunuka?
response: A yankinku, kamuwa da tsutsotsi a cikin raunuka galibi ana kiransa da 'Worm dey inside the wound' ko 'maggot wound.' Manoman gida da masu kula da dabbobi suna yawan amfani da wannan kalmar don kwatanta yanayin da tsutsotsi suka shiga cikin rauni, wanda a mafi yawan lokuta yakan janyo wasu rikitarwa da kwayoyin cuta.

instruction: Mene ne ECF?
response: Cutar East Coast Fever tana da matukar hadari ga bakin nau'in shanun madara (exotic dairy breeds) da aka shigo da su. Wata cuta ce da kaska ke yadawa (tick-borne disease) wadda za ta iya yin mummunan tasiri ga shanu, musamman wadanda suka fito daga yankunan da cutar ba ta gida ba ce. Idan kana shirin kawo sababbin nau'ikan dabbobi a gonarka, tabbatar ka dauki matakan da suka dace don hana yaduwar cutar ECF, kamar yin amfani da hanyoyin hana yaduwar kaska da kuma duba garkenka akai-akai.

instruction: Wace cutar shanu ce ake gane ta da 'woody tongue' (taurin harshe)?
response: Cutar Actinobacillosis, wadda kwayar cutar Actinobacillus lignieresii ke kawowa, wata babbar cuta ce a cikin shanu wadda galibi ake gane ta ta hanyar wata kyakkyawar alama ta 'woody tongue' (taurin harshe). Wannan yanayin galibi yana faruwa ne sakamakon kwayoyin cuta da suke kama harshe, yana janyo taurariwa da canza kamannin tsokar harshen, wanda zai iya janyo matukar rashin jin dadi da wahala wajen cin abinci ko shan ruwa ga dabbar. Cutar Actinobacillosis kuma za ta iya shafar wasu sassan jikin, ciki har da huhu, hanta, da gabobi, kuma galibi tana yaduwa ne ta hanyar haduwa kai tsaye da dabbobin da suka kamu ko kuma gurbataccen abinci da ruwa.

instruction: Mene ne sunan gida na post-parturient hypocalcaemia (milk fever)?
response: A Najeriya, sunan gida na post-parturient hypocalcaemia, wanda kuma aka sani da milk fever, shi ne 'The cow don fall' ko a harshen Yarbanci, 'malu wo'. Wannan yanayin yakan faru ne a lokacin da sinadarin calcium na saniya ya yi kasa sosai bayan ta haihu, wanda ke haifar da alamu kamar kasalar tsoka, rawar jiki, da kuma wahalar tsayawa. Yana da matukar muhimmanci a gane alamun sannan a nemi kulawar likitan dabbobi cikin gaggawa domin hana rikitarwa da kuma tabbatar da saniyar ta farfado.

instruction: Wace cuta mai shafar mutane da dabbobi (zoonotic disease) ce ke haifar da undulant fever ga mutane da kuma zubar da ciki a zangon karshe na ciki (third trimester) ga shanu?
response: Cutar Brucellosis, wadda kwayoyin cutar Brucella abortus ke haifarwa, cuta ce da ke shafar mutane da dabbobi (zoonotic) wadda ke kama mutane da shanu gaba daya. A jikin mutane, tana iya haifar da undulant fever (zazzabi mai koma-baya), wanda ake gane shi da zazzabi da ke yawan dawowa, gumi, da ciwon tsoka. A shanu, kwayar cutar Brucella abortus tana iya haifar da zubar da ciki a zangon karshe na ciki (third trimester), wanda hakan ke jawo asarar kudi mai yawa ga manoma. Wannan cuta a galibi tana yaduwa ne ta hanyar tabawa da tsokar dabbobin da suka kamu (infected animal tissues), kamar mabiya ko jariran da suka zube, ko kuma ta hanyar gurbatacciyar madara ko abubuwan da aka yi da madara.

instruction: Mene ne 'babban ciki' (ba ciki ba) a jikin akuya yake nunawa?
response: Kumburin ciki (Bloat), taruwar ruwa a ciki (ascites), ko mummunan ciwon tsutsar ciki, wanda aka fi sani da bottle jaw, duka suna iya zama masu haddasa cikin akuya ya bayyana a kumbure. Kumburin ciki yana faruwa ne idan cikin akuyar ya cika da iska, galibi saboda cin busasshen abinci da yawa ko shan ruwa da yawa. Taruwar ruwa a ciki (Ascites) wani yanayi ne da ruwa ke taruwa a cikin kwayar ciki (abdomen), wanda cutar hanta ko wasu matsalolin lafiya za su iya kawowa. A daya bangaren kuma, matsanancin ciwon tsutsar ciki (severe worm infestation) zai iya haifar da kumburin kasan baki da ciki saboda kasancewar tsutsotsin a cikin jikin akuyar. Yana da matukar muhimmanci a tuntubi likitan dabbobi domin gano ainihin musabbabin sannan a bayar da maganin da ake bukata.

instruction: Mene ne sunan gida na cutar Marek's Disease?
response: Cutar Marek's Disease galibi an fi saninta da sunayen gida na 'Leg paralysis disease' (cutar shanyewar kafa) ko 'wing drop disease' (cutar faduwar fiffike).

instruction: Wace hanya ce galibi cutar Bovine Tuberculosis (Tarin Fuka na Shanu) take bi wajen kama garken makiyaya?
response: Cutar Bovine Tuberculosis galibi tana harbar garkunan makiyaya ne ta hanyar numfashi, musamman ta hanyar shakar iska, a mafi yawan lokuta idan suka tattaru guri guda da daddare lokacin da dabbobin suka fi kasancewa kusa da juna. Wannan kusancin yana bai wa kwayoyin cutar (bacteria) damar yaduwa cikin sauki daga wannan dabba zuwa wancan, wanda ya sa ya zama babbar hanyar yada cutar a cikin tsarin garke.

instruction: Da me irin kwayoyin 'sit-fast' wadanda suka bambanta suke da alaka?
response: Kwayoyin 'sit-fast' lesions wadanda suka bambanta suna da alaka ne da cibiyar mutuwar tsoka ta kurajen (Necrotic centers of nodules) cutar Lumpy Skin Disease wadanda daga karshe suke barewa su fadi.

instruction: Mene ne amfanin flunixin meglumine wajen yin maganin cutar FMD?
response: Akan yawan amfani da Flunixin meglumine tare da maganin kashe kwayoyin cuta (antibiotics) don taimakawa wajen kula da cutar Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD). An bayar da rahoton cewa yana da kyakkyawan tasiri a jiki gaba daya idan aka yi amfani da shi tare da maganin kashe kwayoyin cuta (antibiotics), wanda zai iya taimakawa wajen rage raɗaɗin alamun da kuma tallafa wa lafiyar dabbobin da suka kamu.

instruction: Fahimtar Cutar CBPP a Shanu
response: A binciken gawar saniyar da take dauke da cutar contagious bovine pleuropneumonia (CBPP), 'sequestrum' (macecciyar tsokar huhu) wani yanki ne na macecciyar tsokar huhu wanda tsokar fibrous (fibrous tissue) ta lullube. Wannan babban bincike ne da aka gano, domin yana nuna dadewar kwayoyin cuta a jiki (chronic infection) da kuma kasancewa mai dauke da cutar. Kasancewar sequestrum din yana nuna cewa saniyar ta jima da kamuwa da cutar CBPP kuma tana iya yada cutar ga sauran dabbobi, ko da kuwa tana ganin kamar lafiyarta kalau. Wannan wani muhimmin abin lura ne ga manoman shanu, kasancewar hakan na iya kawo cikas ga lafiya da amfanin garkensu baki daya.

instruction: Gane kwayoyin cutar ciki (internal parasites) a shanun Najeriya
response: Haemonchus placei, wadda aka fi sani da Barber's pole worm, ita ce babbar kwayar cutar ciki (internal parasite) dake kawo 'bottle jaw' (kumburin makogwaro) ko submandibular oedema a shanun Najeriya a lokacin damina. Wannan kwayar cutar tana yawaita a yanayi mai lema kuma za ta iya kawo manyan matsalolin lafiya a cikin shanu, don haka yana da matukar muhimmanci ka rika lura da garkenka sosai kuma ka bullo da matakan kariya masu tasiri don hana kamuwa da kwayoyin cutar.

instruction: Me yasa kabilun Rahaji suka sauya garken jajayen shanunsu da Bunaji a lokacin da suke komawa kudu?
response: Kabilun Rahaji sun sauya garken jajayen shanunsu da shanun Bunaji ne a lokacin da suke komawa kudu saboda yawan mace-mace a tsakanin jajayen dabbobin. Shanun Bunaji galibi sun fi juriya kuma sun fi dacewa da yanayin kudu, wanda ya sanya su zama mafi dacewar zabi ga sabon wurin da kabilun suka koma.

instruction: Wadanne abubuwa biyu ne nau'in shanun Rahaji BA SA iya jurewa sosai?
response: An san nau'in shanun Rahaji da rashin jure abubuwa biyu: cututtukan da ke da alaka da yawan lema a yanayi (humidity-related diseases) da kuma rashin wadataccen abinci mai gina jiki. Yawan lema a yanayi zai iya haifar da matsalolin numfashi da sauran matsalolin lafiya, yayin da abincin da ba shi da muhimman sinadirai masu gina jiki zai iya raunana lafiya da kuma karancin amfanin dabbobin gaba daya. Yana da matukar muhimmanci a samar wa shanun Rahaji muhalli mai kyakkyawar shigar iska da kuma ingantaccen abinci don tabbatar da cikakkiyar lafiyarsu da walwalarsu.

instruction: Wani zabin daban na amfani da maganin kashe kwayoyin cuta (antimicrobial) don FMD
response: Tri-Solfen wani hadin maganin kashe radadi ne na fatar jiki (topical anesthetic) ga raunuka wanda ke bayar da wani zabi da ba na maganin kashe kwayoyin cuta ba don cutar Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD). An gano yana da matukar inganci fiye da yin allurar oxytetracycline a lokacin da aka gwada shi a fili, wanda ya sa ya zama wani muhimmin zabi wajen kula da FMD a yanayin da ba a dogara da magungunan kashe kwayoyin cuta ba.

instruction: Me yasa nau'in 'small colony' (SC) na kwayar cutar Mycoplasma mycoides subsp. mycoides (Mmm) ya zama ainihin abin da aka fi mayar da hankali a kansa a fannin cutar Contagious Bovine Pleuropneumonia (CBPP)?
response: Kwayar cutar Mmm, wadda a baya aka sani da nau'in 'small colony', ita ce musamman wadda take jawo cutar CBPP wadda take ci gaba da damun Yankin Kudu da Saharar Afirka (Sub-Saharan Africa). Wannan kwayar cutar (bacterium) ita ce ke da alhakin wannan mummunar cuta da ke shafar garkunan shanu, tana jawo asarar tattalin arziki mai yawa da kuma abubuwan damuwa a kan walwalar dabbobi. Kasancewarta jigon abin da aka fi mayar da hankali a kai, kwayar cutar Mmm ita ce ainihin abin da bincike, matakan kariya, da riga-kafi ke hari don rage tasirin cutar CBPP a yankin.

instruction: Wace ce babbar alama ta asibiti don gane Contagious Bovine Pleuropneumonia (CBPP) a cikin matsanantan yanayi?
response: Babbar alama ta asibiti (hallmark clinical sign) ta cutar Contagious Bovine Pleuropneumonia (CBPP) a matsanantan yanayi ita ce tsananin matsalar numfashi, wanda aka fi sani da dyspnoea, da kuma wani yanayin tsayuwa na musamman na 'guje wa kirji/fada-fada da kafa' ('elbows-out' stance). Wannan tsayawar tana faruwa ne sakamakon yadda dabbar ke kokarin fadada kirjinta don biyan bukatun wahalar numfashin da take yi, wanda hakan ya sa ya zama babbar hanyar gane cutar.

instruction: Wace alaka girman nau'in shanun Muturu yake da shi da juriyarsu ga cutar trypanosomiasis?
response: Nau'in Muturu kananan dabbobi ne masu matukar juriya ta asali (trypanotolerance) ga cutar, wanda hakan ke nufin za su iya jure illar cutar trypanosomiasis fiye da manyan nau'in dabbobi.

instruction: Me yasa tabbatarwa ta hanyar binciken dakin gwaji (laboratory confirmation) yake da matukar muhimmanci ga cutar FMD a Afirka?
response: Alamun asibiti na cutar FMD za su iya kasancewa daga mara tsanani zuwa masu tsanani sosai, wanda ke sa gano cutar ta hanyar duba alamu kadai ya zama mai wahala. Tabbatarwa ta dakin gwaji (Laboratory confirmation) tana da matukar muhimmanci don gano cutar yadda ya kamata, kuma yana bukatar a ware a kuma gano kwayar cutar ta hanyar culture ko kuma dabarun kwayoyin halitta, kamar PCR ko ELISA. Wannan yana da matukar muhimmanci a Afirka, inda cutar FMD ta zama ruwan dare kuma za ta iya yin mummunan tasirin tattalin arziki ga kiwon dabbobi. Idan babu tabbacin dakin gwaji, kuskuren gano cutar (misdiagnosis) zai iya haifar da bayar da maganin da ba shi ba da kuma matakan kariya da ba su dace ba, wanda hakan zai iya kara yaduwar cutar.

instruction: Tabbatar da nau'o'in kwayoyin cutar virus na FMD (FMD virus serotypes)
response: Domin tabbatar da nau'o'in kwayoyin cutar virus na FMD (FMD virus serotypes), gwajin da aka amince da shi a matsayin wanda ya fi inganci (gold standard) shi ne ELISA ko PCR, musamman a kan ruwan kuraje (vesicular fluid) ko fatar da ta bare (epithelium). ELISA (Enzyme-Linked Immunosorbent Assay) da PCR (Polymerase Chain Reaction) duka manya ne kuma kafaffun hanyoyi na gano kwayar cutar FMD. A lokacin da ake amfani da wadannan gwaje-gwaje, yana da matukar muhimmanci a tara sannan a yi gwaji akan samfuran ruwan kuraje ko fatar, saboda wannan shi ne ke ba da sakamako mafi inganci. Wannan hanyar tana taimakawa wajen tabbatar da kasancewar takamaiman kwayoyin cutar FMD, wanda hakan ke da muhimmanci ga daukar matakan kariya da kuma hana cutar yaduwa gaba daya.

instruction: Mene ne 'ruwan ciki' ('water for the belly')?
response: Taruwar ruwa a ciki (Ascites), wanda galibi yake da alaka da gaza aikin zuciya ko ciwon hanta, wani yanayi ne da ruwa ke taruwa a cikin kwayar cikin dabba (abdominal cavity), wanda hakan ke ba da kamanin samun 'ruwa a ciki'.

instruction: Wane nau'in kaska ne jigon yada cutar Heartwater (Ehrlichia ruminantium) a Najeriya?
response: Amblyomma variegatum shi ne nau'in kaskar da ya fi kowacce yada cutar Heartwater, wadda aka fi sani da Cowdriosis, a Najeriya. Wannan nau'in kaskar yana yaɗuwa sosai a fadin kasar kuma wani babban mai yada cutar ne, wanda yake iya kawo mummunar rashin lafiya da mutuwa a cikin shanu da sauran dabbobi masu toka (ruminant animals).

instruction: Tsawon lokacin da cutar Lumpy Skin Disease ke dauka a jiki kafin nuna alamu a zahiri
response: Tsawon lokacin da kwayar cutar Lumpy Skin Disease ke dauka kafin nuna alamu a fili (incubation period) a filin kiwo galibi yakan dauki makonni 2 zuwa 4. Wannan yana nufin cewa bayan saniya ta dauki kwayar cutar, tana iya daukar kimanin makonni 2 zuwa 4 kafin alamun su fara bayyana. Yana da matukar muhimmanci ka lura da garkenka sosai a wannan lokacin sannan ka dauki mataki cikin gaggawa da zarar ka lura da wasu alamun cutar, kamar kurajen fata ko zazzabi.

instruction: Mene ne 'the cow don't abort' yake nufi?
response: Zubar ciki da kan sa wata babbar matsala ce a shanu, wanda a wasu lokuta ake kira da 'the cow don abort' (saniyar ta zubar da ciki) a dabi'ar magana ta gida. Wannan yana iya zama wata alamar hadari ta cutar brucellosis, wata cuta (zoonotic disease) wacce ke shafar shanu kuma tana iya yaduwa zuwa ga mutane. Ana gane Brucellosis ta hanyar matsalolin rashin haihuwa, wanda ya hada da zubar da ciki da kan sa, haihuwar mataccen da, da kuma rashin haihuwa. Idan ka lura da zubar da ciki da yawa a cikin garkenka, yana da matukar muhimmanci ka tuntubi likitan dabbobi domin duba ko akwai cutar brucellosis da kuma wasu abubuwan da za su iya jawowa.

instruction: Mene ne 'transit fever' ko 'shipping fever' (zazzabin tafiya)?
response: Cutar Bovine Respiratory Disease (BRD) galibi tana tashi ne saboda damuwar (stress) zirga-zirga, wanda hakan ake yawan kira da 'transit fever' ko 'shipping fever'. Wannan yanayin yana iya faruwa ne sakamakon tarin wasu abubuwa, wadanda suka hada da wahalar jiki na daukar shanu daga wuri zuwa wuri, canjin yanayin zafi da lema, da kuma cudanya da kwayoyin cuta a lokacin tafiyar.

instruction: Mene ne ake kira da 'chicken pox for goat/sheep' (Agana ga awaki/tumaki)?
response: Cutar Sheep and Goat Pox (SGP) ita ce cutar da kake magana a kai. Wata cutar virus ce da take shafar duka tumaki da awaki, tana kawo alamu kamar kurajen fata, zazzabi, da kuma rashin cin abinci. SGP tana da saurin yaduwa sosai kuma za ta iya yaduwa ta hanyar taba dabbar da ta kamu kai tsaye ko kuma gurbatattun kayayyaki. Idan kana zargin garkenka ya kamu da cutar, yana da matukar muhimmanci ka ware su nan take sannan ka tuntubi likitan dabbobi na yankinka domin gano cutar da kyau kuma a yi magani.

instruction: Wadanne manyan abubuwa uku ne ke kawo nakasu ga nau'in shanun Bunaji (White Fulani)?
response: Nau'in White Fulani (Bunaji) an san su da saurin girma na gaban kwatance da kuma kyakkyawar dabi'ar bayar da madara sosai, amma suna kuma fuskantar kalubale da yawa. Manyan abubuwa uku da ke kawo nakasu ga wannan nau'in su ne jinkirin isa balaga don jima'i, wanda hakan ke nufin suna daukar lokaci mai tsawo kafin su kai shekarun haihuwa, dadewa a tsakanin haihuwa (long calving interval), wanda shi ne tsawon lokacin da ke tsakanin haihuwa, da kuma kankanin lokacin shayarwa (short lactation), wanda shi ne tsawon lokacin bayar da madara bayan haihuwa. Wadannan abubuwan za su iya yin tasiri ga cikakken amfani da nagartar nau'in White Fulani a yankinku.

instruction: Wace siffa ce ta musamman ta jiki wacce kahonin shanun Kuri suka fi yi fice da ita?
response: An san shanun Kuri da kaho na musamman da suke da su, wadanda suke da kumburi kuma suna da taushi kamar soso (spongy in appearance) idan aka kalle su. Wannan dabi'a ta musamman tana bambanta su da sauran nau'ikan shanu kuma siffa ce wacce ta yi fice ga wadannan dabbobin.

instruction: Mene ne harajin 'Jangali'?
response: Harajin 'Jangali' wani tsari ne na tarihi wanda kuma a wani lokacin ana daukarsa a matsayin harajin zamani da ake karba akan kowace saniya. Wani babban nauyi ne na kudi ga yawancin manoman dabbobi, musamman a karkara inda shanu suke matsayin babbar hanyar samun kudaden shiga da rayuwa.

instruction: Wane nau'in dabba ne yafi yawa kuma yafi bazuwa a Najeriya?
response: Nau'in White Fulani, wanda aka fi sani da Bunaji, su ne nau'in shanun da suka fi yawa kuma suka fi bazuwa a Najeriya. Su nau'in shanu ne masu juriya da iya sabawa da kowane irin wuri, wadanda suka dace sosai da yanayi da kuma kasa na kasar nan daban-daban. Tare da girman jikinsu na ban al'ajabi gami da madara mai yawa, ba abin mamaki ba ne yadda ake samun su a wurare da yawa a kasar, tun daga savannas (dazuka masu bishiyoyi da ciyayi) har zuwa kan filayen ciyawa.

instruction: Mene ne 'akuya', 'bunsuru', da kuma 'biri akuya'?
response: Akuya tana nufin macen akuya, yayin da bunsuru ko biri akuya musamman yana nufin namijin akuya, (buck). Fahimtar wadannan kalmomin yana da matukar muhimmanci ga manoman Najeriya domin tsara garkunan awakinsu yadda ya kamata da kuma yanke shawarwari masu kyau game da kiwo, ciyarwa, da kuma kula da lafiya.

instruction: Gane nau'in shanu marasa tozo a rubutattun ayyukan Najeriya (Nigerian literature)
response: Nau'in dabbar da aka bayyana a matsayin 'mara tozo' ('humpless') da madaidaicin baya da faffadan goshi a cikin adabin Najeriya (Nigerian literature) ita ce Muturu ko N'Dama. Dukkanin wadannan nau'ikan dabba guda biyu an san su da sifofin jikinsu na musamman, wadanda suka ware su daga sauran nau'ikan shanu a yankin.

instruction: Me yasa aka shigo da shanun N'dama Najeriya?
response: An shigo da shanun N'dama Najeriya saboda halittarsu ta musamman na kasancewa masu juriya ga cutar tsando (trypano-tolerant), wanda ke nufin suna da kariya daga cututtukan da kudan tsando yake jawowa wadanda ke shafar yawancin shanun gida. Bugu da kari, sun fi nau'in Muturu girma, wanda hakan ya sa su zama abin fasahari ga manoman Najeriya masu neman kara yawa da amfanin dabbobinsu tare da yawan nama.

instruction: Kiyasin kason shanun da ya kamata a fitar (off-take rate) a kowace shekara don shanu a wuraren kiwo na al'umma
response: Ga shanu a wuraren kiwon al'umma, kiyasin kason dabbobin da ake sayarwa (off-take rate) a kowace shekara zai iya bambanta sosai dangane da abubuwa kamar tsananin yawan dabbobi a wajen kiwo, ruwan sama, da ingancin kasa. Duk da haka, adadin da aka fi yawan bayarwa yana tsakanin kashi 2% zuwa 10% a shekara, wanda hakan ke nufin cewa a cikin dukkan shanun gaba daya, kashi 2% zuwa 10% na iya bukatar a sayar da su don tabbatar da lafiya da kuma dorewar garken. Wannan adadin zai iya fuskantar canji sakamakon wasu abubuwa na musamman a gonarka ko a yankinka, saboda haka yana da matukar muhimmanci ka rika lura da yanayin garkenka sannan ka tsara dabarun sayarwarka yadda ya dace.

instruction: Wane ragowar sarrafa abincin gona ne a Najeriya yake matsayin babbar hanyar samun karfi (energy) a cikin abincin shanu?
response: Dusan masara (Maize bran) da dusan alkama (wheat offal) duk ragowar abubuwa ne masu amfani na sarrafa amfanin gona a Najeriya wadanda suke matsayin babbar kafa ta samar da karfi (energy) a cikin abincin shanu. Dusan masara musamman, wani ragowar abinci ne mai cike da sinadarin fiber da ake samu daga sarrafa garin masara, yayin da dusan alkama yake kasancewa ragowar abinci daga sarrafa garin alkama. Ana iya amfani da su duka biyun wajen samar da ainihin karfin (energy) da shanu suke bukata, musamman a lokutan da ake da matukar bukatar abinci ko kuma lokacin da wasu kayan abincin suka yi karanci. A lokacin da ake hada wadannan kayayyakin a cikin abincin shanu, yana da matukar muhimmanci a daidaita yawan karfin (energy) da suke bayarwa da sauran kayan abinci don tabbatar da isasshen abinci mai gina jiki.

instruction: Gane asalin kwayoyin halittar da suka samar da (parent breeds) shanun Keteku
response: Nau'in Keteku haɗaɗɗen nau'in shanu ne wanda aka tabbatar daga gicciya tsakanin nau'in Muturu da Zebu. Wannan tsarin hada nau'ika na da nufin hada kyawawan halaye na iyayen duka domin samar da 'ya'ya masu karfi kuma masu amfani sosai.

instruction: Tsarin kwararar makiyayan shanun Rahaji a Najeriya
response: Nau'in shanun Rahaji a Najeriya galibi suna yin kwararar yanayi ne, kuma a lokacin damina, ba su cika yin tattaki sosai su wuce Kaduna zuwa kudu ba. Wannan a galibi yana faruwa ne sakamakon wadataccen filin kiwo da albarkatun ruwa, wadanda suke kara habaka a arewa a wannan lokacin. Yayin da rani ya shigo, za su iya yin tattaki zuwa yankin kudu domin neman kyakkyawan yanayin kiwo.

instruction: Mene ne nau'in shanun Kuri?
response: Nau'in shanun Kuri wani nau'i ne na musamman da yake jan hankali wanda asalin sa ya fito ne daga yankin Tafkin Chadi (Lake Chad). Daya daga cikin halayyarsa ta musamman ita ce manyan kaho marasa nauyi wadanda wadannan shanun suke da su. Abin sha'awa, wadannan kahonin ba domin yin ado kawai suke ba; a gaskiya ana amfani da su ne wajen shawagi, wanda ke bai wa shanun Kuri damar yin iyo tare da tsallaka ruwa cikin sauki. Wannan daidaitawa ta ban mamaki ta sanya shanun Kuri dacewa sosai da yanayin ruwansu kuma ya taimaka matuka wajen tabbatar da rayuwarsu gami da nasara a wannan yanki.

instruction: Illolin da martanin riga-kafin Neethling ke kawowa akan amincewar masu shanu (compliance)
response: Illar kurajen fata za ta iya shafar halin da mai dabbar zai nuna kuma hakan na iya sanya rashin son yin riga-kafi, wanda zai iya kawo nakasu ga dukkanin ingancin shirye-shiryen riga-kafi. Wannan abin damuwa ne musamman a yankunan da masu shanu za su iya kasancewa masu shakkar karbar matakan riga-kafi tun farko sakamakon dalilai daban-daban, wanda ya hada da tsada, rashin samun kulawar likitan dabbobi, ko kuma jita-jita mara tushe akan amincin riga-kafin. Sakamakon haka, yana da matukar muhimmanci ga likitocin dabbobi da jami'an gona (extension agents) su magance duk wani koke-koke ko kuma illolin da za a iya fuskanta cikin gaggawa sannan su bayar da takamaiman bayanai, masu gamsarwa domin kwantar wa masu shanu hankali akan amfanin yin riga-kafi da kuma matakan da aka tanada don rage duk wani hatsari.

instruction: Mene ne 'Wuro'?
response: Iyali a karkashin gida daya ko kuma ainihin wurin da sansanin shanu yake (ruga).

instruction: Mene ne siffar musamman ta kahon nau'in shanun Kuri?
response: An san nau'in shanun Kuri da siffar kahon su ta musamman, wadda aka gane ta da manyan kahoni sosai, masu kama da fitila, da kuma kaho mai siffar saƙar zuma (honeycomb-textured). Wannan siffa ta musamman tana bambanta Kuri da sauran nau'ikan dabbobi kuma shi ne abin lura a wajen bayyanarsu.

instruction: Wane nau'in shanu ne nau'in 'Azuwarac' da ake samu a yankunan arewacin Najeriya masu iyaka?
response: Shanun 'Azuwarac' wadanda ake samu a iyakar arewacin Najeriya wani nau'i ne daga cikin jinsin shanun Sokoto Gudali.

instruction: Mene ne 'swollen head' (kumburin kai) a kaji?
response: Kumburin kai (swollen head) a kaji galibi cutar Infectious Coryza ko Mycoplasmosis ne ke kawo shi. Dukkanin wadannan cututtuka biyu za su iya haifar da matsanancin kumburi da zafi a kai, wuya, da fuska, sannan suna iya zuwa da wasu alamu kamar fitar ruwa daga idanu da hanci, tare da rashin cin abinci gaba daya. Idan ka lura da wani kumburi ko wani ruwa da ke fita wanda ba ka saba gani ba a garkenka, yana da matukar muhimmanci ka tuntubi ma'aikacin lafiyar dabbobi na gida domin gano cutar yadda ya kamata sannan a yi magani, domin wadannan cututtukan suna da saurin yaduwa kuma za su iya baza wa da sauri idan ba a yi magani ba.

instruction: Wane nau'in shanu ne ya fi nasaba da ƙananan rukunin Fulani (Fulani subgroups) a Filaton Mambilla (Mambilla Plateau)?
response: Red Bororo, wanda aka fi sani da Rahaji, shi ne nau'in dabba da ya fi kusanci da kabilun Fulani a Mambilla Plateau. Wannan nau'in dabbar ya dace sosai da yanayin yankin kuma ya zama wani muhimmin bangare na al'adar Fulani gami da tsare-tsaren kula da dabbobi tsawon shekaru aru-aru.

instruction: Mene ne ainihin launin fatar shanun Sokoto Gudali?
response: An san Sokoto Gudali da ainihin launin fatar jikinsu, wadanda suka hada da kaloli masu laushi na cream (fari mai madara-madara), hasken toka-toka, ko kuma ruwan kasa. Wadannan launuka su ne babban halin wannan nau'in shanu kuma za su iya bambanta kadan dangane da kowace dabba.

instruction: Me yasa shan ruwa yake da matukar muhimmanci ga shanu da ake ciyar da su abinci mai yawan fiber (high-fibre dry-season diets) a lokacin rani?
response: Ruwa yana da matukar muhimmanci ga shanu da ake ciyar da su abinci mai yawan fiber a lokacin rani saboda yana taka muhimmiyar rawa a tsarin juyar da abinci ta hanyar kwayoyin halitta (microbial fermentation process) wanda ke faruwa a cikin tsarin narkar da abinci a cikinsu. A lokacin wannan aiki, kwayoyin halitta (microbes) suna narkar da sinadarin fiber a cikin abincinsu, wanda ke fitar da sinadirai masu amfani da shanun za su iya sha a jikinsu. Idan shanu ba su da isasshen ruwa, wannan tsarin yana fuskantar cikas, wanda zai janyo matsalolin narkar da abinci da kuma yiwuwar cushewar kwayar ciki a sassan omasum da abomasum – wasu muhimman sassa biyu na cikinsu wadanda suke da alhakin tsotse sinadirai masu amfani da kuma ruwa. Don hana wadannan matsaloli, yana da matukar muhimmanci a tabbatar da cewa shanu suna samun ruwa mai yawa, tsaftatacce, kuma sabo a kowane lokaci, musamman a lokacin rani lokacin da shan abinci mai yawan fiber yayi yawa.

instruction: Wane irin yanayi ne nau'in shanun Rahaji suka saba da shi
response: Rahaji ta dace sosai da yanayin tsananin rani da kuma matsakaicin rani (arid and semi-arid climate conditions), wanda hakan ya sa ta zama zabin da ya dace ga manoma a busassun yankunan Najeriya. Karfinta da kuma juriyarta na rayuwa a yankunan da ke da karancin ruwan sama ya sa ta zama sanannen nau'i a tsakanin manoman dabbobi a wadannan yankunan.

instruction: Mene ne muhimmancin 'tsetse belt'?
response: 'Tsetse belt' wani yanki ne a Tsakiyar Najeriya (Middle Belt) inda kudan tsando (tsetse flies) suka yi katutu. Wannan yanki yana da muhimmanci saboda kudan tsando ne jigon yada cutar trypanosomiasis, wadda kuma aka sani da nagana, wata mummunar cuta da ke shafar shanu da sauran dabbobin gida. Yankin 'tsetse belt' yana zama babbar barazana ga harkar kiwo da kiwon dabbobi a wannan yanki, wanda hakan ya sa ya zama wajibi manoma su dauki matakan kariya da kuma hana yaduwar cutar.

instruction: Mene ne 'fara' ta fuskar lafiyar dabbobi?
response: Cutar tsutsa (Blowfly strike), wadda aka fi sani da myiasis, wani mummunan yanayi ne inda tsutsotsi (maggots) suke shiga cikin raunukan dabbobinku. Wannan yana iya yin matukar barna musamman ga tumaki, awaki, da sauran dabbobi, kasancewar zai iya haifar da mummunan radadi, kwayoyin cuta (infection), har ma da mutuwa idan ba a yi magani ba. Domin hana fara, tabbatar an wanke kuma an daure raunukan dabbobinku ba tare da bata lokaci ba, sannan a yi la'akari da amfani da maganin shafawa don kora kudan.

instruction: Ta yaya cutar Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) ta fi yaduwa a tsakanin shanu a cikin garke?
response: Cutar Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) tana yaduwa ne musamman a tsakanin shanu a cikin garke ta hanyar shakar iska (aerosol transmission) da kuma taba ruwan kurajen kai tsaye. Yaduwa ta hanyar shakar iska tana faruwa ne lokacin da dabbar da ta kamu ta yi tari, atishawa, ko fitar da numfashi, tana fitar da kwayar cutar a cikin iska, wanda kuma wasu dabbobin za su iya shakarsa. Taba ruwan kurajen kai tsaye na faruwa ne lokacin da kuraje ko mikin dabbar da ta kamu suka taba fata ko sashen jikin wata dabbar, wanda hakan ke bai wa kwayar cutar damar shiga sabon gangar jikin. Dukkan wadannan hanyoyin yaduwa biyu za su iya haifar da saurin yaduwar FMD a cikin garke, wanda ya sanya ya zama dole a aiwatar da tsauraran matakan kariya (biosecurity measures) domin hana shigowa da yaduwar cutar.

instruction: Mene ne sunan gida na kamuwa da tsutsotsi a cikin raunuka?
response: A yankinku, kamuwa da tsutsotsi a cikin raunuka galibi ana kiransa da 'Worm dey inside the wound' ko 'maggot wound.' Manoman gida da masu kula da dabbobi suna yawan amfani da wannan kalmar don kwatanta yanayin da tsutsotsi suka shiga cikin rauni, wanda a mafi yawan lokuta yakan janyo wasu rikitarwa da kwayoyin cuta.

instruction: Mene ne ECF?
response: Cutar East Coast Fever tana da matukar hadari ga bakin nau'in shanun madara (exotic dairy breeds) da aka shigo da su. Wata cuta ce da kaska ke yadawa (tick-borne disease) wadda za ta iya yin mummunan tasiri ga shanu, musamman wadanda suka fito daga yankunan da cutar ba ta gida ba ce. Idan kana shirin kawo sababbin nau'ikan dabbobi a gonarka, tabbatar ka dauki matakan da suka dace don hana yaduwar cutar ECF, kamar yin amfani da hanyoyin hana yaduwar kaska da kuma duba garkenka akai-akai.

instruction: Wace cutar shanu ce ake gane ta da 'woody tongue' (taurin harshe)?
response: Cutar Actinobacillosis, wadda kwayar cutar Actinobacillus lignieresii ke kawowa, wata babbar cuta ce a cikin shanu wadda galibi ake gane ta ta hanyar wata kyakkyawar alama ta 'woody tongue' (taurin harshe). Wannan yanayin galibi yana faruwa ne sakamakon kwayoyin cuta da suke kama harshe, yana janyo taurariwa da canza kamannin tsokar harshen, wanda zai iya janyo matukar rashin jin dadi da wahala wajen cin abinci ko shan ruwa ga dabbar. Cutar Actinobacillosis kuma za ta iya shafar wasu sassan jikin, ciki har da huhu, hanta, da gabobi, kuma galibi tana yaduwa ne ta hanyar haduwa kai tsaye da dabbobin da suka kamu ko kuma gurbataccen abinci da ruwa.

instruction: Mene ne sunan gida na post-parturient hypocalcaemia (milk fever)?
response: A Najeriya, sunan gida na post-parturient hypocalcaemia, wanda kuma aka sani da milk fever, shi ne 'The cow don fall' ko a harshen Yarbanci, 'malu wo'. Wannan yanayin yakan faru ne a lokacin da sinadarin calcium na saniya ya yi kasa sosai bayan ta haihu, wanda ke haifar da alamu kamar kasalar tsoka, rawar jiki, da kuma wahalar tsayawa. Yana da matukar muhimmanci a gane alamun sannan a nemi kulawar likitan dabbobi cikin gaggawa domin hana rikitarwa da kuma tabbatar da saniyar ta farfado.

instruction: Wace cuta mai shafar mutane da dabbobi (zoonotic disease) ce ke haifar da undulant fever ga mutane da kuma zubar da ciki a zangon karshe na ciki (third trimester) ga shanu?
response: Cutar Brucellosis, wadda kwayoyin cutar Brucella abortus ke haifarwa, cuta ce da ke shafar mutane da dabbobi (zoonotic) wadda ke kama mutane da shanu gaba daya. A jikin mutane, tana iya haifar da undulant fever (zazzabi mai koma-baya), wanda ake gane shi da zazzabi da ke yawan dawowa, gumi, da ciwon tsoka. A shanu, kwayar cutar Brucella abortus tana iya haifar da zubar da ciki a zangon karshe na ciki (third trimester), wanda hakan ke jawo asarar kudi mai yawa ga manoma. Wannan cuta a galibi tana yaduwa ne ta hanyar tabawa da tsokar dabbobin da suka kamu (infected animal tissues), kamar mabiya ko jariran da suka zube, ko kuma ta hanyar gurbatacciyar madara ko abubuwan da aka yi da madara.

instruction: Mene ne 'babban ciki' (ba ciki ba) a jikin akuya yake nunawa?
response: Kumburin ciki (Bloat), taruwar ruwa a ciki (ascites), ko mummunan ciwon tsutsar ciki, wanda aka fi sani da bottle jaw, duka suna iya zama masu haddasa cikin akuya ya bayyana a kumbure. Kumburin ciki yana faruwa ne idan cikin akuyar ya cika da iska, galibi saboda cin busasshen abinci da yawa ko shan ruwa da yawa. Taruwar ruwa a ciki (Ascites) wani yanayi ne da ruwa ke taruwa a cikin kwayar ciki (abdomen), wanda cutar hanta ko wasu matsalolin lafiya za su iya kawowa. A daya bangaren kuma, matsanancin ciwon tsutsar ciki (severe worm infestation) zai iya haifar da kumburin kasan baki da ciki saboda kasancewar tsutsotsin a cikin jikin akuyar. Yana da matukar muhimmanci a tuntubi likitan dabbobi domin gano ainihin musabbabin sannan a bayar da maganin da ake bukata.

instruction: Mene ne sunan gida na cutar Marek's Disease?
response: Cutar Marek's Disease galibi an fi saninta da sunayen gida na 'Leg paralysis disease' (cutar shanyewar kafa) ko 'wing drop disease' (cutar faduwar fiffike).

instruction: Wace hanya ce galibi cutar Bovine Tuberculosis (Tarin Fuka na Shanu) take bi wajen kama garken makiyaya?
response: Cutar Bovine Tuberculosis galibi tana harbar garkunan makiyaya ne ta hanyar numfashi, musamman ta hanyar shakar iska, a mafi yawan lokuta idan suka tattaru guri guda da daddare lokacin da dabbobin suka fi kasancewa kusa da juna. Wannan kusancin yana bai wa kwayoyin cutar (bacteria) damar yaduwa cikin sauki daga wannan dabba zuwa wancan, wanda ya sa ya zama babbar hanyar yada cutar a cikin tsarin garke.

instruction: Da me irin kwayoyin 'sit-fast' wadanda suka bambanta suke da alaka?
response: Kwayoyin 'sit-fast' lesions wadanda suka bambanta suna da alaka ne da cibiyar mutuwar tsoka ta kurajen (Necrotic centers of nodules) cutar Lumpy Skin Disease wadanda daga karshe suke barewa su fadi.

instruction: Mene ne amfanin flunixin meglumine wajen yin maganin cutar FMD?
response: Akan yawan amfani da Flunixin meglumine tare da maganin kashe kwayoyin cuta (antibiotics) don taimakawa wajen kula da cutar Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD). An bayar da rahoton cewa yana da kyakkyawan tasiri a jiki gaba daya idan aka yi amfani da shi tare da maganin kashe kwayoyin cuta (antibiotics), wanda zai iya taimakawa wajen rage raɗaɗin alamun da kuma tallafa wa lafiyar dabbobin da suka kamu.

instruction: Fahimtar Cutar CBPP a Shanu
response: A binciken gawar saniyar da take dauke da cutar contagious bovine pleuropneumonia (CBPP), 'sequestrum' (macecciyar tsokar huhu) wani yanki ne na macecciyar tsokar huhu wanda tsokar fibrous (fibrous tissue) ta lullube. Wannan babban bincike ne da aka gano, domin yana nuna dadewar kwayoyin cuta a jiki (chronic infection) da kuma kasancewa mai dauke da cutar. Kasancewar sequestrum din yana nuna cewa saniyar ta jima da kamuwa da cutar CBPP kuma tana iya yada cutar ga sauran dabbobi, ko da kuwa tana ganin kamar lafiyarta kalau. Wannan wani muhimmin abin lura ne ga manoman shanu, kasancewar hakan na iya kawo cikas ga lafiya da amfanin garkensu baki daya.
