instruction: Gane kwayoyin cutar ciki (internal parasites) a shanun Najeriya
response: Haemonchus placei, wadda aka fi sani da Barber's pole worm, ita ce babbar kwayar cutar ciki (internal parasite) dake kawo 'bottle jaw' (kumburin makogwaro) ko submandibular oedema a shanun Najeriya a lokacin damina. Wannan kwayar cutar tana yawaita a yanayi mai lema kuma za ta iya kawo manyan matsalolin lafiya a cikin shanu, don haka yana da matukar muhimmanci ka rika lura da garkenka sosai kuma ka bullo da matakan kariya masu tasiri don hana kamuwa da kwayoyin cutar.

instruction: Me yasa kabilun Rahaji suka sauya garken jajayen shanunsu da Bunaji a lokacin da suke komawa kudu?
response: Kabilun Rahaji sun sauya garken jajayen shanunsu da shanun Bunaji ne a lokacin da suke komawa kudu saboda yawan mace-mace a tsakanin jajayen dabbobin. Shanun Bunaji galibi sun fi juriya kuma sun fi dacewa da yanayin kudu, wanda ya sanya su zama mafi dacewar zabi ga sabon wurin da kabilun suka koma.

instruction: Wadanne abubuwa biyu ne nau'in shanun Rahaji BA SA iya jurewa sosai?
response: An san nau'in shanun Rahaji da rashin jure abubuwa biyu: cututtukan da ke da alaka da yawan lema a yanayi (humidity-related diseases) da kuma rashin wadataccen abinci mai gina jiki. Yawan lema a yanayi zai iya haifar da matsalolin numfashi da sauran matsalolin lafiya, yayin da abincin da ba shi da muhimman sinadirai masu gina jiki zai iya raunana lafiya da kuma karancin amfanin dabbobin gaba daya. Yana da matukar muhimmanci a samar wa shanun Rahaji muhalli mai kyakkyawar shigar iska da kuma ingantaccen abinci don tabbatar da cikakkiyar lafiyarsu da walwalarsu.

instruction: Wani zabin daban na amfani da maganin kashe kwayoyin cuta (antimicrobial) don FMD
response: Tri-Solfen wani hadin maganin kashe radadi ne na fatar jiki (topical anesthetic) ga raunuka wanda ke bayar da wani zabi da ba na maganin kashe kwayoyin cuta ba don cutar Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD). An gano yana da matukar inganci fiye da yin allurar oxytetracycline a lokacin da aka gwada shi a fili, wanda ya sa ya zama wani muhimmin zabi wajen kula da FMD a yanayin da ba a dogara da magungunan kashe kwayoyin cuta ba.

instruction: Me yasa nau'in 'small colony' (SC) na kwayar cutar Mycoplasma mycoides subsp. mycoides (Mmm) ya zama ainihin abin da aka fi mayar da hankali a kansa a fannin cutar Contagious Bovine Pleuropneumonia (CBPP)?
response: Kwayar cutar Mmm, wadda a baya aka sani da nau'in 'small colony', ita ce musamman wadda take jawo cutar CBPP wadda take ci gaba da damun Yankin Kudu da Saharar Afirka (Sub-Saharan Africa). Wannan kwayar cutar (bacterium) ita ce ke da alhakin wannan mummunar cuta da ke shafar garkunan shanu, tana jawo asarar tattalin arziki mai yawa da kuma abubuwan damuwa a kan walwalar dabbobi. Kasancewarta jigon abin da aka fi mayar da hankali a kai, kwayar cutar Mmm ita ce ainihin abin da bincike, matakan kariya, da riga-kafi ke hari don rage tasirin cutar CBPP a yankin.

instruction: Wace ce babbar alama ta asibiti don gane Contagious Bovine Pleuropneumonia (CBPP) a cikin matsanantan yanayi?
response: Babbar alama ta asibiti (hallmark clinical sign) ta cutar Contagious Bovine Pleuropneumonia (CBPP) a matsanantan yanayi ita ce tsananin matsalar numfashi, wanda aka fi sani da dyspnoea, da kuma wani yanayin tsayuwa na musamman na 'guje wa kirji/fada-fada da kafa' ('elbows-out' stance). Wannan tsayawar tana faruwa ne sakamakon yadda dabbar ke kokarin fadada kirjinta don biyan bukatun wahalar numfashin da take yi, wanda hakan ya sa ya zama babbar hanyar gane cutar.

instruction: Wace alaka girman nau'in shanun Muturu yake da shi da juriyarsu ga cutar trypanosomiasis?
response: Nau'in Muturu kananan dabbobi ne masu matukar juriya ta asali (trypanotolerance) ga cutar, wanda hakan ke nufin za su iya jure illar cutar trypanosomiasis fiye da manyan nau'in dabbobi.

instruction: Me yasa tabbatarwa ta hanyar binciken dakin gwaji (laboratory confirmation) yake da matukar muhimmanci ga cutar FMD a Afirka?
response: Alamun asibiti na cutar FMD za su iya kasancewa daga mara tsanani zuwa masu tsanani sosai, wanda ke sa gano cutar ta hanyar duba alamu kadai ya zama mai wahala. Tabbatarwa ta dakin gwaji (Laboratory confirmation) tana da matukar muhimmanci don gano cutar yadda ya kamata, kuma yana bukatar a ware a kuma gano kwayar cutar ta hanyar culture ko kuma dabarun kwayoyin halitta, kamar PCR ko ELISA. Wannan yana da matukar muhimmanci a Afirka, inda cutar FMD ta zama ruwan dare kuma za ta iya yin mummunan tasirin tattalin arziki ga kiwon dabbobi. Idan babu tabbacin dakin gwaji, kuskuren gano cutar (misdiagnosis) zai iya haifar da bayar da maganin da ba shi ba da kuma matakan kariya da ba su dace ba, wanda hakan zai iya kara yaduwar cutar.

instruction: Tabbatar da nau'o'in kwayoyin cutar virus na FMD (FMD virus serotypes)
response: Domin tabbatar da nau'o'in kwayoyin cutar virus na FMD (FMD virus serotypes), gwajin da aka amince da shi a matsayin wanda ya fi inganci (gold standard) shi ne ELISA ko PCR, musamman a kan ruwan kuraje (vesicular fluid) ko fatar da ta bare (epithelium). ELISA (Enzyme-Linked Immunosorbent Assay) da PCR (Polymerase Chain Reaction) duka manya ne kuma kafaffun hanyoyi na gano kwayar cutar FMD. A lokacin da ake amfani da wadannan gwaje-gwaje, yana da matukar muhimmanci a tara sannan a yi gwaji akan samfuran ruwan kuraje ko fatar, saboda wannan shi ne ke ba da sakamako mafi inganci. Wannan hanyar tana taimakawa wajen tabbatar da kasancewar takamaiman kwayoyin cutar FMD, wanda hakan ke da muhimmanci ga daukar matakan kariya da kuma hana cutar yaduwa gaba daya.

instruction: Mene ne 'ruwan ciki' ('water for the belly')?
response: Taruwar ruwa a ciki (Ascites), wanda galibi yake da alaka da gaza aikin zuciya ko ciwon hanta, wani yanayi ne da ruwa ke taruwa a cikin kwayar cikin dabba (abdominal cavity), wanda hakan ke ba da kamanin samun 'ruwa a ciki'.

instruction: Wane nau'in kaska ne jigon yada cutar Heartwater (Ehrlichia ruminantium) a Najeriya?
response: Amblyomma variegatum shi ne nau'in kaskar da ya fi kowacce yada cutar Heartwater, wadda aka fi sani da Cowdriosis, a Najeriya. Wannan nau'in kaskar yana yaɗuwa sosai a fadin kasar kuma wani babban mai yada cutar ne, wanda yake iya kawo mummunar rashin lafiya da mutuwa a cikin shanu da sauran dabbobi masu toka (ruminant animals).

instruction: Tsawon lokacin da cutar Lumpy Skin Disease ke dauka a jiki kafin nuna alamu a zahiri
response: Tsawon lokacin da kwayar cutar Lumpy Skin Disease ke dauka kafin nuna alamu a fili (incubation period) a filin kiwo galibi yakan dauki makonni 2 zuwa 4. Wannan yana nufin cewa bayan saniya ta dauki kwayar cutar, tana iya daukar kimanin makonni 2 zuwa 4 kafin alamun su fara bayyana. Yana da matukar muhimmanci ka lura da garkenka sosai a wannan lokacin sannan ka dauki mataki cikin gaggawa da zarar ka lura da wasu alamun cutar, kamar kurajen fata ko zazzabi.

instruction: Mene ne 'the cow don't abort' yake nufi?
response: Zubar ciki da kan sa wata babbar matsala ce a shanu, wanda a wasu lokuta ake kira da 'the cow don abort' (saniyar ta zubar da ciki) a dabi'ar magana ta gida. Wannan yana iya zama wata alamar hadari ta cutar brucellosis, wata cuta (zoonotic disease) wacce ke shafar shanu kuma tana iya yaduwa zuwa ga mutane. Ana gane Brucellosis ta hanyar matsalolin rashin haihuwa, wanda ya hada da zubar da ciki da kan sa, haihuwar mataccen da, da kuma rashin haihuwa. Idan ka lura da zubar da ciki da yawa a cikin garkenka, yana da matukar muhimmanci ka tuntubi likitan dabbobi domin duba ko akwai cutar brucellosis da kuma wasu abubuwan da za su iya jawowa.

instruction: Mene ne 'transit fever' ko 'shipping fever' (zazzabin tafiya)?
response: Cutar Bovine Respiratory Disease (BRD) galibi tana tashi ne saboda damuwar (stress) zirga-zirga, wanda hakan ake yawan kira da 'transit fever' ko 'shipping fever'. Wannan yanayin yana iya faruwa ne sakamakon tarin wasu abubuwa, wadanda suka hada da wahalar jiki na daukar shanu daga wuri zuwa wuri, canjin yanayin zafi da lema, da kuma cudanya da kwayoyin cuta a lokacin tafiyar.

instruction: Mene ne ake kira da 'chicken pox for goat/sheep' (Agana ga awaki/tumaki)?
response: Cutar Sheep and Goat Pox (SGP) ita ce cutar da kake magana a kai. Wata cutar virus ce da take shafar duka tumaki da awaki, tana kawo alamu kamar kurajen fata, zazzabi, da kuma rashin cin abinci. SGP tana da saurin yaduwa sosai kuma za ta iya yaduwa ta hanyar taba dabbar da ta kamu kai tsaye ko kuma gurbatattun kayayyaki. Idan kana zargin garkenka ya kamu da cutar, yana da matukar muhimmanci ka ware su nan take sannan ka tuntubi likitan dabbobi na yankinka domin gano cutar da kyau kuma a yi magani.

instruction: Wadanne manyan abubuwa uku ne ke kawo nakasu ga nau'in shanun Bunaji (White Fulani)?
response: Nau'in White Fulani (Bunaji) an san su da saurin girma na gaban kwatance da kuma kyakkyawar dabi'ar bayar da madara sosai, amma suna kuma fuskantar kalubale da yawa. Manyan abubuwa uku da ke kawo nakasu ga wannan nau'in su ne jinkirin isa balaga don jima'i, wanda hakan ke nufin suna daukar lokaci mai tsawo kafin su kai shekarun haihuwa, dadewa a tsakanin haihuwa (long calving interval), wanda shi ne tsawon lokacin da ke tsakanin haihuwa, da kuma kankanin lokacin shayarwa (short lactation), wanda shi ne tsawon lokacin bayar da madara bayan haihuwa. Wadannan abubuwan za su iya yin tasiri ga cikakken amfani da nagartar nau'in White Fulani a yankinku.

instruction: Wace siffa ce ta musamman ta jiki wacce kahonin shanun Kuri suka fi yi fice da ita?
response: An san shanun Kuri da kaho na musamman da suke da su, wadanda suke da kumburi kuma suna da taushi kamar soso (spongy in appearance) idan aka kalle su. Wannan dabi'a ta musamman tana bambanta su da sauran nau'ikan shanu kuma siffa ce wacce ta yi fice ga wadannan dabbobin.

instruction: Mene ne harajin 'Jangali'?
response: Harajin 'Jangali' wani tsari ne na tarihi wanda kuma a wani lokacin ana daukarsa a matsayin harajin zamani da ake karba akan kowace saniya. Wani babban nauyi ne na kudi ga yawancin manoman dabbobi, musamman a karkara inda shanu suke matsayin babbar hanyar samun kudaden shiga da rayuwa.

instruction: Wane nau'in dabba ne yafi yawa kuma yafi bazuwa a Najeriya?
response: Nau'in White Fulani, wanda aka fi sani da Bunaji, su ne nau'in shanun da suka fi yawa kuma suka fi bazuwa a Najeriya. Su nau'in shanu ne masu juriya da iya sabawa da kowane irin wuri, wadanda suka dace sosai da yanayi da kuma kasa na kasar nan daban-daban. Tare da girman jikinsu na ban al'ajabi gami da madara mai yawa, ba abin mamaki ba ne yadda ake samun su a wurare da yawa a kasar, tun daga savannas (dazuka masu bishiyoyi da ciyayi) har zuwa kan filayen ciyawa.

instruction: Mene ne 'akuya', 'bunsuru', da kuma 'biri akuya'?
response: Akuya tana nufin macen akuya, yayin da bunsuru ko biri akuya musamman yana nufin namijin akuya, (buck). Fahimtar wadannan kalmomin yana da matukar muhimmanci ga manoman Najeriya domin tsara garkunan awakinsu yadda ya kamata da kuma yanke shawarwari masu kyau game da kiwo, ciyarwa, da kuma kula da lafiya.

instruction: Gane nau'in shanu marasa tozo a rubutattun ayyukan Najeriya (Nigerian literature)
response: Nau'in dabbar da aka bayyana a matsayin 'mara tozo' ('humpless') da madaidaicin baya da faffadan goshi a cikin adabin Najeriya (Nigerian literature) ita ce Muturu ko N'Dama. Dukkanin wadannan nau'ikan dabba guda biyu an san su da sifofin jikinsu na musamman, wadanda suka ware su daga sauran nau'ikan shanu a yankin.

instruction: Me yasa aka shigo da shanun N'dama Najeriya?
response: An shigo da shanun N'dama Najeriya saboda halittarsu ta musamman na kasancewa masu juriya ga cutar tsando (trypano-tolerant), wanda ke nufin suna da kariya daga cututtukan da kudan tsando yake jawowa wadanda ke shafar yawancin shanun gida. Bugu da kari, sun fi nau'in Muturu girma, wanda hakan ya sa su zama abin fasahari ga manoman Najeriya masu neman kara yawa da amfanin dabbobinsu tare da yawan nama.

instruction: Kiyasin kason shanun da ya kamata a fitar (off-take rate) a kowace shekara don shanu a wuraren kiwo na al'umma
response: Ga shanu a wuraren kiwon al'umma, kiyasin kason dabbobin da ake sayarwa (off-take rate) a kowace shekara zai iya bambanta sosai dangane da abubuwa kamar tsananin yawan dabbobi a wajen kiwo, ruwan sama, da ingancin kasa. Duk da haka, adadin da aka fi yawan bayarwa yana tsakanin kashi 2% zuwa 10% a shekara, wanda hakan ke nufin cewa a cikin dukkan shanun gaba daya, kashi 2% zuwa 10% na iya bukatar a sayar da su don tabbatar da lafiya da kuma dorewar garken. Wannan adadin zai iya fuskantar canji sakamakon wasu abubuwa na musamman a gonarka ko a yankinka, saboda haka yana da matukar muhimmanci ka rika lura da yanayin garkenka sannan ka tsara dabarun sayarwarka yadda ya dace.

instruction: Wane ragowar sarrafa abincin gona ne a Najeriya yake matsayin babbar hanyar samun karfi (energy) a cikin abincin shanu?
response: Dusan masara (Maize bran) da dusan alkama (wheat offal) duk ragowar abubuwa ne masu amfani na sarrafa amfanin gona a Najeriya wadanda suke matsayin babbar kafa ta samar da karfi (energy) a cikin abincin shanu. Dusan masara musamman, wani ragowar abinci ne mai cike da sinadarin fiber da ake samu daga sarrafa garin masara, yayin da dusan alkama yake kasancewa ragowar abinci daga sarrafa garin alkama. Ana iya amfani da su duka biyun wajen samar da ainihin karfin (energy) da shanu suke bukata, musamman a lokutan da ake da matukar bukatar abinci ko kuma lokacin da wasu kayan abincin suka yi karanci. A lokacin da ake hada wadannan kayayyakin a cikin abincin shanu, yana da matukar muhimmanci a daidaita yawan karfin (energy) da suke bayarwa da sauran kayan abinci don tabbatar da isasshen abinci mai gina jiki.

instruction: Gane asalin kwayoyin halittar da suka samar da (parent breeds) shanun Keteku
response: Nau'in Keteku haɗaɗɗen nau'in shanu ne wanda aka tabbatar daga gicciya tsakanin nau'in Muturu da Zebu. Wannan tsarin hada nau'ika na da nufin hada kyawawan halaye na iyayen duka domin samar da 'ya'ya masu karfi kuma masu amfani sosai.

instruction: Tsarin kwararar makiyayan shanun Rahaji a Najeriya
response: Nau'in shanun Rahaji a Najeriya galibi suna yin kwararar yanayi ne, kuma a lokacin damina, ba su cika yin tattaki sosai su wuce Kaduna zuwa kudu ba. Wannan a galibi yana faruwa ne sakamakon wadataccen filin kiwo da albarkatun ruwa, wadanda suke kara habaka a arewa a wannan lokacin. Yayin da rani ya shigo, za su iya yin tattaki zuwa yankin kudu domin neman kyakkyawan yanayin kiwo.

instruction: Mene ne nau'in shanun Kuri?
response: Nau'in shanun Kuri wani nau'i ne na musamman da yake jan hankali wanda asalin sa ya fito ne daga yankin Tafkin Chadi (Lake Chad). Daya daga cikin halayyarsa ta musamman ita ce manyan kaho marasa nauyi wadanda wadannan shanun suke da su. Abin sha'awa, wadannan kahonin ba domin yin ado kawai suke ba; a gaskiya ana amfani da su ne wajen shawagi, wanda ke bai wa shanun Kuri damar yin iyo tare da tsallaka ruwa cikin sauki. Wannan daidaitawa ta ban mamaki ta sanya shanun Kuri dacewa sosai da yanayin ruwansu kuma ya taimaka matuka wajen tabbatar da rayuwarsu gami da nasara a wannan yanki.

instruction: Illolin da martanin riga-kafin Neethling ke kawowa akan amincewar masu shanu (compliance)
response: Illar kurajen fata za ta iya shafar halin da mai dabbar zai nuna kuma hakan na iya sanya rashin son yin riga-kafi, wanda zai iya kawo nakasu ga dukkanin ingancin shirye-shiryen riga-kafi. Wannan abin damuwa ne musamman a yankunan da masu shanu za su iya kasancewa masu shakkar karbar matakan riga-kafi tun farko sakamakon dalilai daban-daban, wanda ya hada da tsada, rashin samun kulawar likitan dabbobi, ko kuma jita-jita mara tushe akan amincin riga-kafin. Sakamakon haka, yana da matukar muhimmanci ga likitocin dabbobi da jami'an gona (extension agents) su magance duk wani koke-koke ko kuma illolin da za a iya fuskanta cikin gaggawa sannan su bayar da takamaiman bayanai, masu gamsarwa domin kwantar wa masu shanu hankali akan amfanin yin riga-kafi da kuma matakan da aka tanada don rage duk wani hatsari.

instruction: Mene ne 'Wuro'?
response: Iyali a karkashin gida daya ko kuma ainihin wurin da sansanin shanu yake (ruga).

instruction: Mene ne siffar musamman ta kahon nau'in shanun Kuri?
response: An san nau'in shanun Kuri da siffar kahon su ta musamman, wadda aka gane ta da manyan kahoni sosai, masu kama da fitila, da kuma kaho mai siffar saƙar zuma (honeycomb-textured). Wannan siffa ta musamman tana bambanta Kuri da sauran nau'ikan dabbobi kuma shi ne abin lura a wajen bayyanarsu.

instruction: Wane nau'in shanu ne nau'in 'Azuwarac' da ake samu a yankunan arewacin Najeriya masu iyaka?
response: Shanun 'Azuwarac' wadanda ake samu a iyakar arewacin Najeriya wani nau'i ne daga cikin jinsin shanun Sokoto Gudali.

instruction: Mene ne 'swollen head' (kumburin kai) a kaji?
response: Kumburin kai (swollen head) a kaji galibi cutar Infectious Coryza ko Mycoplasmosis ne ke kawo shi. Dukkanin wadannan cututtuka biyu za su iya haifar da matsanancin kumburi da zafi a kai, wuya, da fuska, sannan suna iya zuwa da wasu alamu kamar fitar ruwa daga idanu da hanci, tare da rashin cin abinci gaba daya. Idan ka lura da wani kumburi ko wani ruwa da ke fita wanda ba ka saba gani ba a garkenka, yana da matukar muhimmanci ka tuntubi ma'aikacin lafiyar dabbobi na gida domin gano cutar yadda ya kamata sannan a yi magani, domin wadannan cututtukan suna da saurin yaduwa kuma za su iya baza wa da sauri idan ba a yi magani ba.

instruction: Wane nau'in shanu ne ya fi nasaba da ƙananan rukunin Fulani (Fulani subgroups) a Filaton Mambilla (Mambilla Plateau)?
response: Red Bororo, wanda aka fi sani da Rahaji, shi ne nau'in dabba da ya fi kusanci da kabilun Fulani a Mambilla Plateau. Wannan nau'in dabbar ya dace sosai da yanayin yankin kuma ya zama wani muhimmin bangare na al'adar Fulani gami da tsare-tsaren kula da dabbobi tsawon shekaru aru-aru.

instruction: Mene ne ainihin launin fatar shanun Sokoto Gudali?
response: An san Sokoto Gudali da ainihin launin fatar jikinsu, wadanda suka hada da kaloli masu laushi na cream (fari mai madara-madara), hasken toka-toka, ko kuma ruwan kasa. Wadannan launuka su ne babban halin wannan nau'in shanu kuma za su iya bambanta kadan dangane da kowace dabba.

instruction: Me yasa shan ruwa yake da matukar muhimmanci ga shanu da ake ciyar da su abinci mai yawan fiber (high-fibre dry-season diets) a lokacin rani?
response: Ruwa yana da matukar muhimmanci ga shanu da ake ciyar da su abinci mai yawan fiber a lokacin rani saboda yana taka muhimmiyar rawa a tsarin juyar da abinci ta hanyar kwayoyin halitta (microbial fermentation process) wanda ke faruwa a cikin tsarin narkar da abinci a cikinsu. A lokacin wannan aiki, kwayoyin halitta (microbes) suna narkar da sinadarin fiber a cikin abincinsu, wanda ke fitar da sinadirai masu amfani da shanun za su iya sha a jikinsu. Idan shanu ba su da isasshen ruwa, wannan tsarin yana fuskantar cikas, wanda zai janyo matsalolin narkar da abinci da kuma yiwuwar cushewar kwayar ciki a sassan omasum da abomasum – wasu muhimman sassa biyu na cikinsu wadanda suke da alhakin tsotse sinadirai masu amfani da kuma ruwa. Don hana wadannan matsaloli, yana da matukar muhimmanci a tabbatar da cewa shanu suna samun ruwa mai yawa, tsaftatacce, kuma sabo a kowane lokaci, musamman a lokacin rani lokacin da shan abinci mai yawan fiber yayi yawa.

instruction: Wane irin yanayi ne nau'in shanun Rahaji suka saba da shi
response: Rahaji ta dace sosai da yanayin tsananin rani da kuma matsakaicin rani (arid and semi-arid climate conditions), wanda hakan ya sa ta zama zabin da ya dace ga manoma a busassun yankunan Najeriya. Karfinta da kuma juriyarta na rayuwa a yankunan da ke da karancin ruwan sama ya sa ta zama sanannen nau'i a tsakanin manoman dabbobi a wadannan yankunan.

instruction: Menene matsakaicin nauyin bijimin White Fulani (Bunaji)?
response: Matsakaicin nauyin bijimin White Fulani yana kusan kilogiram 500 (500 kg). Wannan nau'in dabba an san shi da girman jiki na ban sha'awa da kuma karfi, wanda hakan ya sa ya zama zabin da ya fi karbuwa wajen kiwon shanu a Najeriya. Sai dai, nauyin kowace dabba zai iya bambanta dangane da abubuwa kamar shekaru, ingancin abinci, da kuma tsarin halittarta, saboda haka wannan lissafin matsakaici ne kawai. A gaba daya, goggon bijimin White Fulani zai iya kai nauyin da ya fara daga kilogiram 400 zuwa 600, wanda a wasu lokutan wasu zababbun bijiman suke kaiwa fiye da wannan nauyin.

instruction: Gane nau'in dabbar da ba a cika samun ta ba a Najeriya
response: Nau'in Azawak ya kasance kaso 0.7% kacal na yawan garkunan shanun kasa a Najeriya kuma galibi ana samun sa ne a kan iyakar Arewa maso Yamma. Wannan nau'i na dabbar da ba a cika samun ta ba (rare breed) an san shi da halaye na musamman wanda a mafi yawan lokuta masu kiwo da masu sha'awar kiwon dabobi ke yawan neman sa.

instruction: Kaso nawa ne na garkunan shanun kasar nan suka kasance shanun Wadara?
response: Shanun Wadara suna da kankanin kaso na garkunan shanun kasar nan, wadanda suke da kusan kashi 0.066% na gaba daya. Wannan wani kaso ne kankani sosai, wanda hakan ke nuna cewa sauran nau'ikan shanu sun fi yawa a cikin garkunan shanun Najeriya.

instruction: Mene ne ma'anar tsarin Transhumance dangane da kwararar makiyaya (pastoral movement)?
response: Tsarin Transhumance na nufin kwararar dabbobi na wani dan lokaci tsakanin wasu takamaiman wurare, wanda galibi yake farawa daga yanki mai sanyi zuwa mai zafi, don neman ruwa da makiyaya. Wannan kwarara a mafi yawan lokuta tana faruwa ne daga arewa zuwa kudu, wanda hakan ke baiwa dabbobin damar kiwo a korayen ciyayi da kuma samun ruwa a lokacin rani.

instruction: Matsakaicin lokaci tsakanin haihuwa zuwa wata (calving interval) ga nau'in shanun Sokoto Gudali a karkashin tsarin kiwon semi-intensive
response: Matsakaicin lokacin dake tsakanin haihuwa zuwa wata (calving interval) wanda aka ruwaito ga nau'in shanun Sokoto Gudali, a lokacin da ake kiwonsu karkashin tsarin kiwon semi-intensive a cibiyar bincike kamar Shika, yana kusan kwanaki 360-450. Wannan tsakanin yana da matukar muhimmanci ga masu kiwo domin su tsara kuma su gudanar da tsarin haihuwar garkensu yadda ya dace.

instruction: Matsakaicin yawan madarar da mace Sokoto Gudali take bayarwa a duk lokacin da ta haihu (per lactation)
response: Matsakaicin yawan madarar da macen Sokoto Gudali take bayarwa a kowane lokacin shayarwa na haihuwa yana kusan kilogiram 1,500 (1,500 kg). An san wannan nau'in dabbar da yawan bayar da madara, wanda hakan ya sanya ta zama zabin da ya fi shahara a harkar kiwon dabbobin madara a Najeriya. Sai dai, yawan madarar yana iya bambanta dangane da abubuwa kamar abinci mai gina jiki, lafiya, da kuma tsare-tsaren kulawa.

instruction: Kaso nawa na shanun kasar nan ne na Gudali (Sokoto da Adamawa)?
response: Nau'in shanun Gudali wani muhimmin bangare ne na shanun Najeriya, musamman a yankunan Sokoto da Adamawa. A cewar bayanan da ake da su, nau'in Gudali ya kasance kusan kashi 0.32% na garkunan shanun kasar nan, wanda hakan ke nuna muhimmiyar rawar da yake takawa a masana'antar kiwon shanun kasar.

instruction: Wane nau'in shanu ne na uku wajen yawa a Najeriya, wanda ya dauki kashi 22% na garkunan shanun kasar?
response: Red Bororo, wanda aka fi sani da Rahaji, su ne nau'in shanu na uku wajen yawa a Najeriya, inda suke daukar kashi 22% na garkunan shanun. Wannan nau'in ya dace sosai da yanayin kasar kuma galibi ana kiwon sa ne domin samar da nama da madara.

instruction: Inganta tsarin garken shanu don samun hayayyafa (breeding)
response: A cikin garken da ake kulawa dashi yadda ya kamata, ya zama ruwan dare a ware kusan kashi 20-30% na yawan shanu gaba daya domin hayayyafa (breeding). Wannan adadin zai iya bambanta dangane da abubuwa kamar nau'in dabba, muradin abin da ake son samarwa (production goals), da kuma albarkatun da ake da su. Misali, idan kana kiwon nau'ikan masu daraja (high-quality breeds) kamar Boran ko Sahiwal, za ka iya sa ran ware kaso mafi yawa na shanu don hayayyafa domin ci gaba da kiyaye ingancin asalin garkensu. Koyaya, ga mafi yawan manoman Najeriya, ware kashi 25-28% don hayayyafa wani kyakkyawan farawa ne, wanda hakan zai bada damar rarraba dabbobi domin samar da madara, samar da nama, gami da maye gurbin tsofaffin shanu (herd renewal).

instruction: Mene ne ma'aunin shekarun da ya kamata a yayaye 'yan maruka (weaning age) a tsarin kiwon shanun madara (intensive dairy systems) na Najeriya?
response: Ga tsarin kiwon shanun madara (intensive dairy systems) na Najeriya, ma'aunin shekarun yayaye 'yan maruka (weaning age) galibi yakan kasance kusan watanni 3 ko makonni 12 ne. Wannan na bai wa 'yan marukan damar samun isasshen abinci da goyon baya a lokacin da suke kananan su, sannan kuma yana taimakawa wajen rage hadarin kamuwa da cututtuka tare da inganta lafiyarsu baki daya. Haka kuma, yayaye su a wannan shekarun na bai wa manoma damar sarrafa tsarin abincin karamin marakin yadda ya dace, inda ake canza masa abinci daga madara zuwa tauri gami da wasu abubuwa masu gina jiki (nutrient-rich sources).

instruction: Kiyasin kason bunkasar garkunan shanun kasa a shekara (annual growth rate)
response: Kiyasin kason bunkasar garkunan shanun kasa a Najeriya a shekara yakan kai kusan kashi 1.5%. Wannan kason bunkasa na iya canzawa dangane da wasu abubuwa kamar nau'in dabba, ingancin abinci, da kuma tsarin kula da cututtuka. A gaba daya, kason kashi 1.5% ana ganin sa a matsayin matsakaici kuma za a iya cimma shi ta hanyar ingantaccen tsarin kiwo, isasshen abinci, da kuma kyakkyawar kulawar lafiya ga shanun.

instruction: Kwatanta Yawan Madarar da Shanun Sokoto Gudali da Bunaji ke bayarwa
response: Macen saniyar Sokoto Gudali da ake bawa ingantaccen abinci akan sa ran ta bayar da kimanin kilogiram 1500 na madara a duk lokacin da ta haihu. Wannan ya yi kasa sosai idan aka kwatanta shi da nau'in Bunaji, wanda yake bayar da madara har kilogiram 2300 a duk lokacin da ta haihu. Bambancin yawan madarar da wadannan nau'ikan dabbobi biyu suke bayarwa ya nuna muhimmancin zabar daidaitaccen nau'in shanu don gonar ku, tare da yin la'akari da abubuwa kamar yanayin canjin yanayi, samun wadataccen abinci, gami da bukatun kasuwa. Idan kuna fatan samun madara mai yawan gaske, nau'in Bunaji ne ya fi dacewa da ku, amma yana da matukar muhimmanci a duba ainihin bukatun da kuma ka'idojin kula da wannan nau'in kafin a yanke shawara.

instruction: Gane nau'in dabbar da ta taƙaita a yankin Adamawa kawai (restricted to the Adamawa region) da kuma yawanta a cikin garken kasar nan
response: Adamawa Gudali wani nau'i ne na musamman da ake samun sa a yankin Adamawa a Najeriya kawai. Suna daukar kusan kashi 2% na yawan garkunan shanun kasar nan gaba daya a yankin. Wannan nau'in dabba an san shi da wasu halaye na musamman kuma wani muhimmin bangare ne na harkar kiwon dabbobin yankin.

instruction: Mene ne babban amfanin yankin 'fadama' a fannin kula da shanu?
response: Yankin 'fadama' na matukar amfani wajen samar da makiyaya a lokacin rani a wurare masu kasa-kasa (low-lying) kuma masu tara ruwa a lokacin damina (seasonally flooded wetlands). Wannan tsarin yanayi na musamman yana bai wa shanu damar kiwo a lokutan da ba a iya shiga wasu wuraren kiwon saboda ambaliyar ruwa, wanda hakan ya sanya fadama zama wani muhimmin bangare a harkar kiwon shanu ga manoman dake zaune a yankunan da ruwa ke yawan kwanciya (seasonal waterlogging).

instruction: Mene ne 'rufe shanu da daddare' (night folding) a tsarin kiwon shanun Najeriya na gargajiya?
response: Dabi'ar kulle shanu a wuri guda da daddare, wanda aka sani da wuro, wata tsohuwar hanya ce ta gargajiya da ake amfani da ita don kiyaye sata da kuma mugayen dabbobi. Wannan dabara tana taimakawa wajen ba wa dabbobinka kariya da tabbatar da lafiyarsu, musamman a yankunan da satar shanu (cattle rustling) ta zama ruwan dare.

instruction: Mene ne babban dalilin da yasa makiyaya a Najeriya suka fi son tsarin 'transhumance' (tashi daga wuri zuwa wuri) akan zama guri daya (sedentary ranching)?
response: Babban dalilin da yasa makiyayan Najeriya suka fi son tsarin transhumance (tashi daga wuri zuwa wuri) akan zama waje daya shi ne don bin yanayin da ake samun ruwa da kuma danyar makiyaya (green pasture) a fadin yankuna daban-daban (ecological zones). Wannan yana ba su damar sabawa da sauyin yanayi tare da tabbatar da samun isasshen abinci da ruwa ga dabbobinsu akai-akai.

instruction: Kason mata a cikin garken shanun Najeriya na yau da kullum
response: A cikin garken shanun Najeriya na yau da kullum, mata galibi suna daukar wani kaso mai tsoka, wanda ya kama daga kashi 60 zuwa 75% na gaba dayan garken. Wannan ya faru ne saboda dabbobi mata galibi su ne kashin bayan garken, masu samar da madara, nama, da kuma 'ya'yan kiwo (breeding stock). Gaskiyar kason zai iya bambanta dangane da abubuwa kamar nau'in dabba, dalilin kiwo, da kuma tsare-tsaren kulawa, amma kashi 60 zuwa 75% shine ma'aunin da ya dace da yawancin garkunan shanun Najeriya.

instruction: Mene ne muhimmancin 'abubuwan lashewa masu gishiri' (Kanwa) a tsarin makiyayan gargajiya?
response: Abubuwan lashewa masu gishiri, wadanda aka sani da Kanwa, suna da muhimmanci sosai a tsarin makiyayan gargajiya. Suna samar da muhimman ma'adanai wadanda galibi ake rasawa a makiyayar kasashe masu zafi ta asali (natural tropical pastures), wadanda ke da matukar muhimmanci ga lafiya da kyakkyawan yanayin dabbobi. Wadannan ma'adanai, kamar su sodium da potassium, suna da muhimmanci wajen kiyaye tsarin gudanar da ayyukan jiki yadda ya dace, wanda ya hada da tsarin aikin jijiyoyi da tsoka, kazalika da tabbatar da wadataccen ruwa a jiki (hydration). Idan ba a ba su abubuwan lashewa masu gishiri ba, dabbobin za su iya fama da karancin ma'adanai, wanda zai haifar da raguwar amfaninsu da kuma saurin kamuwa da cututtuka. A mafi yawan tsare-tsaren makiyayan gargajiya, abubuwan lashewa masu gishiri (salt licks) suna zama wani muhimmin bangare na kiwon dabbobi, kuma bai kamata a yi watsi da muhimmancinsu ba.

instruction: Mene ne ma'anar 'stocking rate' (Adadin Dabbobin da Filin Kiwo zai Dauka) a fannin burtulan kiwo (grazing reserves) na Najeriya?
response: A fannin burtulan kiwo na Najeriya, 'stocking rate' na nufin adadin dabbobin da kowane hekta (hectare) daya na filin zai iya dauka (ko isar masa makiyaya). Wannan wani muhimmin abin lura ne wajen tantance karfin daukar dabbobi na filin don tabbatar da cewa burtulan kiwon zai iya biyan bukatun dabbobin da ke wajen. Yin amfani da 'stocking rate' (adadin dabbobi) da yawa zai iya haifar da yin kiwo fiye da kima da kuma lalata filin, yayin da adadi mara yawa zai iya haifar da rashin cin gajiyar damar filin yadda ya kamata. Yana da matukar muhimmanci ka ayyana adadin 'stocking rate' (dabbobin da filin zai iya dauka) wanda ya fi dacewa ga burtulan kiwonka dangane da abubuwa kamar nau'in dabbobi, ingancin kasa, da kuma yanayi domin samun kyakkyawan yanayin kiwo kuma mai amfani.

instruction: Me yasa kiwon shanu ya yi karanci a yankin kudancin Najeriya mai yawan lema (humid south)?
response: Kiwon shanu ya yi karanci a kudancin Najeriya mai yawan lema (humid south) sakamakon tsananin kalubalen kudan tsando da kuma matsalolin cututtukan da yawan lema ke jawowa. Kudan tsando shi ne babbar kwayar cutar da ke yada trypanosomiasis, wanda aka fi sani da cutar barci (sleeping sickness), wanda zai iya halakar da yawan shanu (decimate cattle populations). Bugu da kari, yanayi mai yawan lema a kudu yana samar da yanayi mai kyau ga cututtuka daban-daban su rayu, wanda ke sa ya fi wuya a iya kula da garkunan shanu masu lafiya. Dukkanin wadannan abubuwa sun hada waje daya don sanya kiwon shanu ya zama mai wahala kuma maras fa'ida a kudu idan aka kwatanta da yankunan arewa masu busasshen yanayi.

instruction: Mene ne galibi aka fi hada karin abinci (supplementary feeding) dashi ga shanun madara a biranen Najeriya?
response: Ga shanun madara da ake kiwo a biranen Najeriya (urban dairy cows), karin abinci yana da matukar muhimmanci domin tabbatar da sun sami sinadiran da suke bukata domin bayar da madara sosai. Galibi, wannan tsarin ciyarwar yana hada da cakuden danyen auduga (cottonseed cake), dusar alkama, da kuma busasshen masarar masu sana'ar giya. Wadannan sinadiran suna samar da dumbin protein, makamashi, da kuma fiber (sinadiran dake taimakawa abinci narkewa a ciki) wanda zai iya taimakawa wajen cike gibin abinci mai gina jiki a cikin abincinsu. Tsari mai kyau na wadannan karin abincin zai iya taimakawa wajen tabbatar da lafiya da kuma karin amfanin shanunka na madara a birni.

instruction: Mene ne ainihin rawar da 'Sarkin Pawa' ke takawa a harkar kasuwancin dabbobi ta gargajiya?
response: Sarkin Pawa na taka muhimmiyar rawa a harkar kasuwancin dabbobi ta gargajiya a matsayinsa na shugaban kungiyar mahauta. Babban alhakinsa shi ne kula da ingancin nama, domin tabbatar da cewa nama mai kyau kuma amintacce ne kawai yake shiga kasuwa. Bugu da kari, su ne ke da alhakin sasanta rikice-rikicen kasuwa da kuma tabbatar da tsari a tsakanin mahauta, wanda hakan ke taimakawa wajen gina aminci a tsakanin masu saye da kuma taimakawa wajen dorewar kasuwancin dabbobin baki daya.

instruction: Ta yaya tsarin 'daurewa' (tethering) ya bambanta da 'sakin dabba ta yi kiwo' (free-ranging) a fannin kula da kananan dabbobi a Najeriya?
response: A fannin kula da kananan dabbobi a Najeriya, daurewa (tethering) da kuma sakinsu su yi kiwo (free-ranging) wasu hanyoyi ne guda biyu daban-daban na kiwo. Daure dabba yana nufin yi musu turke (tying animals to stakes) domin hana su lalata amfanin gona, wanda wata dabi'a ce da ta zama ruwan dare a yankin Kudu inda kasa take da karanci kuma amfanin gona yana da daraja sosai. Wannan tsari yana bayar da damar sarrafa motsin dabbobin da kuma rage asarar lalata amfanin gona, amma zai iya hana dabbobin samun abinci sannan ya kara hadarin kamuwa da cututtuka. A daya bangaren kuma, sakin dabbar ta yi kiwo (free-ranging), yana nufin barin dabbobin su yi ta yawo yadda suke so a cikin wani katon fili, wanda zai ba su damar samun ciyawa da motsa jiki, amma hakan zai kara janyo asarar lalata amfanin gona da kuma yaduwar cututtuka. Zabi tsakanin daure dabbar (tethering) da sakin dabbar ta yi kiwo (free-ranging) ya dogara ne a karshe akan takamaiman bukatun da yanayin da gonar take.

instruction: Wane yanki ne na kasa da ake amfani dashi wajen noma a Najeriya yake da mafi yawan shanu (highest density of cattle)?
response: Yankin Sudan Savannah (yankin da yafi karancin ruwa da bishiyoyi) shi ne yankin kasar noma a Najeriya (agro-ecological zone) da yafi kowane yanki yawan shanu. Wannan yanki yana da yanayin busasshiyar savana (dry savanna climate), mai tsawon rani (dry season) da gajeren damina (wet season), wanda hakan ya sa ya fi dacewa da kiwon shanu. Sudan Savannah ta mamaye wani babban yanki na arewacin Najeriya, ciki har da jihohi kamar Sokoto, Kebbi, da Zamfara, inda kiwon shanu ya kasance wata babbar sana'ar da take kawo kudin shiga.

instruction: Fahimtar tsarin 'Kalman' a harkar kasuwancin shanu ta gargajiya
response: Tsarin 'Kalman' wani tsari ne na bayar da bashi wajen saye da sayar da dabbobi wanda ya zama ruwan dare a kasuwannin gida. Yana bai wa manoma damar siyan shanu a kan bashi, bisa fahimtar cewa za su biya bashin da zarar sun sayar da dabbar a gaba. Wannan tsarin yana da matukar amfani musamman ga kananan manoma wadanda ba su da jarin fara siyan dabbobi, amma suna son shiga harkar kasuwancin shanu. Ta hanyar amfani da tsarin Kalman, za su iya samun shanun da suke bukata domin inganta gonarsu da kudaden shiga, sannan kuma yana bai wa masu saye hanyar samun dabbobin da suke nema.

instruction: Me yasa galibi makiyayan Najeriya suka fi son samun shanu da yawa a garke fiye da samarwa da kowace dabba takamaiman bukatarta a daidaikunta (individual animal productivity)?
response: Makiyayan Najeriya galibi sun fi son garken shanu masu yawa a matsayin wata dabara ta rage hatsarin asara a lokacin barkewar cututtuka. Wannan ya faru ne saboda babban garke yana samar da kariya (buffer) daga asarar da ka iya zuwa ta dalilin rashin lafiya ko mutuwa, wanda yake barin gaba dayan kiyasin (overall productivity) garken a matsayi na tsaka-tsaki. Bugu da kari, yawan shanu a galibi ana kallon sa a matsayin wata alamar matsayi a cikin al'umma da kuma arziki, kasancewar yana nuna karfin mai shi wajen kulawa da kuma rike adadi mai yawa na dabbobi. Wannan dabi'a ta al'ada (cultural significance) za ta iya rinjayar duk wani fa'idar da ke tattare da kowace dabba, wanda zai sa makiyaya su zabi girman garke fiye da kwazon kowace dabba guda daya.

instruction: Mene ne asalin tarihin harajin 'jangali' yake da alaka da shi a Arewacin Najeriya?
response: Asalin tarihin harajin 'jangali' yana da alaka ne da harajin shanu da ake karba a wajen makiyaya a Arewacin Najeriya.

instruction: Wace jiha ce a Najeriya aka sani da sunan 'Mahaifar Jar Akuya' (Home of the Red Goat)?
response: Jihar Sokoto ce aka fi sani da sunan 'Mahaifar Jar Akuya', wadda musamman take nufin akuyar Sokoto Red/Maradi, wani nau'in dabba da ake darajawa sakamakon kyawun jar fatarta ta musamman da kuma nama mai inganci.

instruction: Mene ne matsakaicin 'shekarun haihuwar-farko' (age-at-first-calving) ga shanun Bunaji (White Fulani) a tsarin kiwo na gargajiya?
response: Ga shanun White Fulani (Bunaji) a tsarin gargajiya, shekarun haihuwar farko galibi suna kasancewa a tsakanin shekaru 4 zuwa 5. Wannan matsakaicin shekaru ne da ya shahara sosai ga wannan nau'in, wanda aka sani da juriyarsa da kuma dacewarsa da yanayi daban-daban.

instruction: Mene ne babbar hanyar samun abincin shanu a lokacin rani a burtalin kiwon Laduga (Laduga grazing reserve)?
response: A burtalin kiwon Laduga, babbar hanyar samun abincin shanu a lokacin rani ita ce ragowar amfanin gona daga makwabtan gonaki da kuma yin ciyawar hay (hay making). Wannan wata tsohuwar al'ada ce da ta shahara a yawancin burtalolin kiwo na Najeriya, inda ake barin shanu su yi kiwo akan ragowar amfanin gona da aka bari bayan girbi. Yin ciyawar hay (Hay making) shima wani muhimmin bangare ne, kasancewar yana samar da tabbataccen busasshen abinci a lokacin rani wanda ciyayin makiyaya ke zama marasa yawa.

instruction: Mene ne ainihin adadin yawan shanun da ke barin garke ('off-take' rate) a garkunan shanun gargajiya na Najeriya?
response: Kusan kashi 7-10% a kowace shekara, wanda hakan ke nufin cewa a cikin kowane shanu 100 da kake da su a garkenka, za ka iya tsammanin sayar da ko cire kusan guda 7 zuwa 10 daga cikinsu kowace shekara. Wannan adadin zai iya bambanta dangane da wasu abubuwa kamar nau'in dabba, shekaru, da kuma yanayin lafiyar dabbar, amma dai tabbataccen tsari ne ga garkunan shanun gargajiya na Najeriya.

instruction: Matsakaicin yawan madarar da Sokoto Gudali ke bayarwa a duk lokacin da ta haihu (per lactation)
response: Matsakaicin yawan madarar da Sokoto Gudali take bayarwa a kowane lokacin shayarwa na haihuwa yana kusan 1500kg. Wannan nau'in dabbar an san ta da yawan bayar da madara kuma zabi ce da ta shahara a tsakanin manoman Najeriya. Tare da kyakkyawar kulawa da tsare-tsare, shanun Sokoto Gudali za su iya samar da madara mai yawan gaske, wanda ya sa suka zama wata muhimmiyar dukiya ga kowace gonar madara.

instruction: Wane nau'in dabba ne aka fi so don yin noma (ploughing) a kauyuka amma ake kai shi kasuwa idan ya yi girma sosai?
response: Adamawa Gudali wani shahararren nau'in dabba ne a kauyukan Najeriya, wanda ake darajawa sakamakon karfinsa da kuma juriyarsa wajen yin noma (ploughing). A mafi yawan lokuta ana amfani da su don yin aiki a yankunan karkara, amma da zarar sun yi girma, galibi ana sayar da su a kasuwa domin a yi amfani da su wajen nama. Wannan nau'in dabba mai aikata abubuwa biyu (dual-purpose) ya dace sosai da bukatun manoman Najeriya da yawa, inda yake samar da ingantaccen karfin aiki gami da kudaden shiga idan aka sayar da naman sa.

instruction: Wane nau'in dabba ne yake da karfin samar da madara mai yawa a karkashin kyakkyawan tsarin kulawa?
response: An fi kallon cewa Bunaji (White Fulani), ita ke da karfin bayar da madara mai yawa a karkashin ingantaccen tsarin kiwo fiye da Sokoto Gudali. Wannan na faruwa ne saboda mafi yawan kwayoyin halittar da ke bayar da madara (genetic potential for milk production) na Bunajin, wanda za a iya kara habaka su da kyakkyawan abinci, tsarin hayayyafa (breeding), da kyakkyawar kulawa. A karkashin ingantaccen tsarin kulawa, shanun Bunaji za su iya bayar da madara har lita 4-6 a kowace rana, wanda hakan ya sa suka zama zabin da aka fi so ga manoman madara a Najeriya.

instruction: Me yasa jurewar yanayi (climatic resilience) ya zama babban dalili na rungumar tsarin kiwon kiba (feedlot systems)?
response: Kyakkyawan tsarin wurare na rage barazanar da ke fuskantar dabbobi daga lalacewar ciyayi sakamakon canjin yanayi, wanda ke sanya tsarin kiwon kiba ya zama wani zabi mai inganci (resilient option) ga manoma. Ta hanyar samar da tabbataccen wurin samun abinci da matsuguni, wuraren kiwon kiba za su iya rage illar farari (droughts), ambaliyar ruwa, da sauran munanan yanayi (extreme weather events) da ka iya lalata tsarin makiyaya (pasture-based systems). Wannan na bai wa manoma damar tabbatar da samun isasshen abinci da ruwa ga dabbobinsu akai-akai, ko da kuwa a lokacin da ake fuskantar kalubalen yanayin da ba za a iya hasashe ba.

instruction: Mene ne matsakaicin kewayon nauyin girma (mature body weight range) na ragon Yankasa (Yankasa sheep ram)?
response: Matsakaicin nauyin ragon Yankasa a lokacin da ya girma yakan kai kusan kilogiram 25–40 (25-40 kg). Wannan wani nau'i ne mai matsakaicin jiki (compact breed), wanda ya dace da busasshen yanayin da ake samu a yankuna daban-daban na Najeriya, kuma madaidaicin girmansu ya sa sun shahara sosai ga kananan manoman dake son yin kiwon garke mai juriya da karin kiba da sauri.

instruction: Me yasa a al'adance makiyaya suke yin 'kulle dabbobi da daddare' ('night kraaling' (enclosing cattle at night))?
response: Kulle dabbobi da daddare (Night kraaling) wata al'ada ce a tsakanin makiyaya da ke biyan manyan bukatu biyu. Na farko, yana kare shanu daga mugayen dabbobi da kuma sata, wanda ka iya zama babbar barazana ga sana'arsu. Na biyu, yana taimakawa wajen tattara taki, wanda wata muhimmiyar dukiya ce ga manoma. Ta hanyar kulle shanun da daddare, makiyaya za su iya tara taki cikin sauki, wanda za a iya amfani da shi domin sanya wa amfanin gona.

instruction: Fahimtar al'adar 'Habbanae' (ko habba'nai) a tsarin kiwon dabbobin Najeriya
response: Al'adar 'Habbanae' wata muhimmiyar al'adar taimakekeniya ce a tsarin kiwon dabbobin Najeriya, inda ake ba wa wani mutum dake da bukata aron saniya (mace), galibi a lokutan kunci ko a lokacin da suke fara sabuwar gona. Wannan al'ada tana bai wa wanda aka ba wa ita damar morar 'ya'yan saniyar, wadanda zai rike a matsayin nasa, yayin da hakan ke bai wa asalin mai dabbar hanyar cike gurbi a garkensa. Galibi ana mayar wa da asalin mai ita saniyar bayan wani takamaiman lokaci, galibi idan 'ya'yan sun isa yaye. Wannan tsari yana karfafa hadin kai tsakanin al'umma, taimakon juna, da raba abin hannu (sharing of resources) a tsakanin al'ummomi, wanda ke da matukar muhimmanci ga dorewar harkar kiwon dabbobi a Najeriya.

instruction: Wace rawa 'Dilali' ke takawa a kasuwar shanun Najeriya?
response: A kasuwar shanun Najeriya, 'Dilali' yana taka muhimmiyar rawa a matsayin dillali ko wakili mai karbar kason aiki. Babban aikinsu shi ne cinikin farashi tsakanin mai saye da mai sayarwa, galibi a madadin daya ko duka bangarorin biyu domin saukaka mu'amalar ciniki. Wannan aikin yana taimakawa wajen tabbatar da cewa dukkan bangarorin biyu sun amince da farashi guda daya wanda ya fi dacewa da su, wanda hakan zai iya zama mai fa'ida ga mai sayarwa wanda ba lallai ne ya san farashin kasuwa ba gami da mai sayen da ke son samun ragi. Kwarewar Dilalin da kuma fahimtar da yake da ita akan kasuwar tana taimakawa wajen hana samun matsala sannan a tabbatar an yi ciniki a cikin gaggawa da aminci.

instruction: Matsakaicin karin kiba na kullum ga bijimin White Fulani a tsarin ciyarwa na musamman mai gina jiki (high-plane nutrition diet)
response: Ga bijimin White Fulani a karkashin tsarin abinci na musamman, kana iya tsammanin karin kiba da zai kai kusan kilogiram 0.5 zuwa 0.8 a kowace rana. Wannan bayani ne na gaba daya sannan karin kiba na ainihi yana iya bambanta dangane da wasu abubuwa kamar shekaru, ingancin nau'in dabbar, da kuma lafiyar dabbar gaba daya. Domin cimma matsakaicin girma wanda ya dace, tabbatar kana ciyar da bijimin abinci wanda ya kunshi dukkan sinadirai masu gina jiki (balanced diet) wadanda yake bukata, ciki har da isasshen protein, makamashi (energy), da muhimman bitamin (vitamins) gami da ma'adanai (minerals).

instruction: Me yasa 'loda (ta hanyar amfani da wuta)' ('fire-branding') yake kara karanci a tsarin kiwon shanu na Najeriya na zamani?
response: Loda (fire-branding) na ci gaba da karanci a tsarin kiwon shanu na zamani a Najeriya saboda tana lalata fata, wanda ke rage darajarta a masana'antar fata (leather industry). Wannan wata babbar matsala ce ga manoman shanu, kasancewar fata wata muhimmiyar dukiya ce ta bangaren kiwon shanu, kuma duk wata barna da za a yi mata za ta iya haifar da mummunar asarar kudi. Sakamakon haka, yawancin manoma suna komawa zuwa ga wasu hanyoyin banbance shanu da gudanar da su, kamar amfani da lambar kunne (ear tagging) ko sanya kananan na'urori (microchipping), wadanda suka fi sauki da jin kai kuma ba sa bata ingancin fatar.

instruction: Matsakaicin kewayon nauyin girma na saniyar Bunaji (White Fulani) da kuma bijimi
response: Matsakaicin kewayon nauyin girma na White Fulani, wanda kuma aka fi sani da Bunaji, yana da matukar yawa. A bangaren shanu (mata), ana iya tsammanin nauyi daga kilogiram 250 zuwa 380, yayin da bijimai galibi suke yin nauyin da ya kai tsakanin kilogiram 325 da 665. Wannan ya sa White Fulani ya kasance wani nau'i mai karfi kuma abin sha'awa, wanda ya dace da yanayin Najeriya da kuma dabi'ar kiwo.

instruction: Kewayon nauyin da ya dace na babbar akuyar Red Sokoto (Maradi)
response: Kewayon ainihin nauyin babbar akuyar Red Sokoto (Maradi) yawanci yakan kasance 20–30 kg, tare da raguwar kiba wanda yakan faru kusan kashi 18% a lokacin rani.

instruction: Kimanin nauyin shanun Najeriya ba tare da ma'auni ba
response: Manoman Najeriya galibi suna amfani da ma'aunin kirji don kiyasta nauyin shanu ba tare da ma'auni na zahiri ba (scale). Wannan yana bukatar nade igiya ko kewayar madauri a mafi fadin kirjin dabbar, daidai bayan kafafunta na gaba. Ana auna tsawon madaurin (circumference), sannan kuma bisa la'akari da nau'in dabba da shekarunta, za a iya gane kimanin nauyinta ta amfani da wasu tsare-tsare (formula) ko jadawalin da aka riga aka fitar (chart). Wannan tsari ana yawan amfani da shi a kiwon shanun Najeriya sakamakon saukinta da kuma ingancinta.

instruction: Matsakaicin nauyin 'yan marukan White Fulani wajen haihuwa
response: Matsakaicin nauyin 'yan marukan shanun White Fulani galibi yana kasancewa a tsakanin kilogiram 18.2 da 24.2 ne. Wannan tazarar tana iya bambanta dangane da abubuwa kamar abincin da mahaifiyarsu ke ci da kuma cikakkiyar lafiyarta, gami da tsawon lokacin da marakin ya yi a ciki kafin haihuwa.

instruction: Mene ne al'amarin 'bunkasa mai ramako' (compensatory growth) a cikin shanun Najeriya?
response: Bunkasa mai ramako (compensatory growth) a cikin shanun Najeriya yana nufin saurin karin kiba da ake samu a lokacin damina bayan wani lokaci na rashin isasshen abinci a lokacin rani. Wannan al'amari yana faruwa ne a lokacin da shanu suka sami damar samun ciyayi da abinci mai gina jiki da yawa a lokacin damina, wanda hakan zai ba su damar mayar da kiban da suka rasa cikin kankanin lokaci kuma su wuce yanayin karin kibar da suke samu a baya. Wannan bunkasar gaggawa (growth spurt) wani yanayi ne na asali (natural response) na samun ingantattun yanayin abinci mai gina jiki wanda zai iya zama babban ci gaba ga manoman shanu a Najeriya, kasancewar yana ba su damar murmurewa daga lokutan fari ko wasu kalubalen rashin isasshen abinci mai gina jiki.

instruction: Mene ne 'resting one leg' ko 'carry leg' (dage kafa daya)?
response: Dage kafa daya wanda aka fi sani da 'carry leg', wata kalma ce da ke kwatanta gurgunta mai nasaba da nauyi (weight-bearing lameness) a jikin shanu. Ana gane ta ne idan saniya ta fi karkata nauyinta a kan wata kafa daya fiye da daya, galibi hakan na faruwa ne sakamakon radadi ko ciwo (pain or discomfort) a wancan kafar. Wannan zai iya samuwa sakamakon wasu abubuwa kamar miki a kofato (hoof abscesses), ciwon kofato (laminitis), ko kuma ciwon gabobi. Idan ka lura cewa saniya tana yawan dage kafa daya, yana da matukar muhimmanci a binciko asalin abin da ke kawo matsalar sannan a ba da maganin da ya dace don rage radadin tare da hana matsalolin da za su iya tasowa.

instruction: Mene ne muhimmancin 'Burtali' ('Stock Routes' (Gidan Sannu)) a tsarin aikin noma na Najeriya?
response: 'Burtali' ko Gidan Sannu takamaiman hanyoyi ne da aka ware domin dabbobi su bi, wanda ke taka muhimmiyar rawa wajen hana rikice-rikice tsakanin manoma da makiyaya. Ta hanyar samar da fili wanda aka ware a matsayin hanyar da makiyaya za su bi da shanunsu, wadannan burtalin suna taimakawa wajen rage barazanar shiga gonaki kuma yana rage rikice-rikice tsakanin manoma da makiyaya. An bullo da wannan tsari a sassa daban-daban na Najeriya a matsayin wata hanyar bunkasa zaman lafiya da fahimtar juna a tsakanin wadannan kungiyoyin biyu, da kuma tallafa wa ci gaban dorewar bangaren noma na kasar nan.

instruction: Wace hukuma ce a Najeriya take da alhakin inganta jinsin kwayoyin halittar (genetic improvement) na nau'o'in shanu na gida?
response: NAPRI (Cibiyar Binciken Samar da Dabbobi ta Kasa ko National Animal Production Research Institute), tana taka muhimmiyar rawa a Najeriya wajen inganta jinsin kwayoyin halitta na nau'o'in dabbobi na gida. Ayyukansu sun fi mayar da hankali ne akan inganta amfani da kuma juriyar wadannan dabbobi domin cika bukatun manoman Najeriya. Ta hanyar habakawa tare da rarraba ingantattun 'yan hayayyafa, NAPRI tana taimakawa wajen bunkasa nagarta da ribar tsare-tsaren kiwon dabbobin gida.

instruction: Kewayon matsakaicin nauyin (mature body weight range) saniyar Sokoto Gudali da bijimi
response: Ga shanun Sokoto Gudali, kewayon matsakaicin nauyinsu (mature body weight range) yakan fara ne daga kilogiram 240 zuwa 355 ga saniyar (mata), yayin da bijimi (maza) galibi sukan yi nauyi daga kilogiram 495 zuwa 660.

instruction: Menene matsakaicin nauyin saniyar (mace) Sokoto Gudali?
response: Matsakaicin nauyin saniyar (mace) Sokoto Gudali yana kusan kilogiram 330 (330 kg). Wannan nau'in an san su da girmansu na gaban kwatance da kuma yawan samar da madara, wanda hakan ya sa suka zama zabin da aka fi so a fannin kiwon dabbobin madara a Najeriya. Sai dai, kowane nauyi na dabba zai iya bambanta dangane da abubuwa kamar abinci mai gina jiki, kwayoyin halitta, da cikakkiyar lafiya, don haka yana da kyau ka rika auna dabbobinka akai-akai don kula da girmansu (growth) da ci gabansu (development).

instruction: Yawanci ainihin nauyin babbar akuyar West African Dwarf (WAD) ya kai nawa?
response: Ainihin nauyin jikin babbar akuyar West African Dwarf (WAD) yana tsakanin 15–25 kg.

instruction: Kaso nawa na dukkanin naman da ake ci a Najeriya ake samu daga naman sa (beef)?
response: Naman sa ya dauki wani muhimmin kaso na naman da ake ci a Najeriya, inda kusan kashi 45% (45 percent) na dukkanin naman da ake ci yake fitowa daga naman sa. Hakan ya faru ne saboda yawan shanun kasar da kuma dabi'ar yawan amfani da naman sa (beef) a gidajen Najeriya da yawa.

instruction: Kwatanta yawan madarar da shanun Bunaji (White Fulani) da Sokoto Gudali suke bayarwa a NAPRI
response: Shanun Sokoto Gudali sun fi shanun White Fulani bayar da madara mai yawa a NAPRI. Wannan zai iya faruwa ne sakamakon yanayin jinsin halittar (genetic predisposition) wadannan dabbobin da kuma kyakkyawan tsarin kiwo (management practices) a cibiyar bincike. A ka'ida, nau'ikan shanun Gudali an san su da karfin samar da madara mai yawa, wanda hakan ya sanya su zama zabin da ya fi shahara a tsakanin manoman madara a Najeriya. Sai dai, yana da matukar muhimmanci a sani cewa nagartar (performance) kowace dabba zata iya bambanta matuka, sannan abubuwa kamar isasshen abinci, lafiya, da kuma hayayyafa, duk suna iya tasiri akan yawan madarar (milk yield).

instruction: Mene ne matsakaicin nauyin babban bijimin (male) Sokoto Gudali?
response: Matsakaicin nauyin babban bijimin Sokoto Gudali ya kai kimanin kilogiram 450 (450 kg). Wannan nau'i ne da aka sani da girmansa mai ban mamaki da kuma karfin gina jiki (robust build), wanda ya sa ya zama wani zabi mai farin jini wajen samar da naman sa a Najeriya. Duk da haka, yana da kyau a lura cewa kowace dabba nauyinta zai iya bambanta dangane da wasu abubuwa kamar abinci mai gina jiki (nutrition), yadda ake kula da ita (management), da kwayoyin halittarta (genetics).

instruction: Ta yaya 'gauraya' (co-mingling) shanu yake janyo barkewar cutar BRD a lokacin isowa gona?
response: Cakuda shanu daga sassa daban-daban yana sa su kamu da kwayoyin cuta a daidai lokacin da garkuwar jikinsu (immune systems) ta yi rauni. Wannan yana janyo damuwa matuka a lokacin da suka iso, saboda gajiyar tafiya da kuma canjin yanayin gari yana kara wa garkuwar jikinsu rauni, wanda hakan zai sanya su cikin hadarin kamuwa da cututtukan numfashi (respiratory diseases) kamar BRD.

instruction: Wadanne asarori ne a boye da cutar BRD ke yi wa mutane (hidden costs)?
response: Boyayyun asarar (hidden costs) cutar Bovine Respiratory Disease (BRD) sun hada da raguwar karin kiba da kuma bukatar karin lokaci kafin su kai matakin kasuwa. Wannan yana iya jawo karin kudin da ake kashewa wajen abinci (feed costs) da kuma bata tsawon lokaci kafin a sayar da dabbar, wanda a karshe yake kawo cikas ga ribar gonar ku baki daya (overall profitability).

instruction: Wace cibiya ce ta yi nasarar gano karin madara ta hanyar gicciya/hada-halitta (crossbreeding) shanun White Fulani da na Holstein?
response: An san cibiyar NAPRI-Shika dake Zaria, da samun nasarar gano karin madara (increased milk production) ta hanyar gicciya/hada-halitta (crossbreeding) shanun White Fulani da na Holstein. Wannan kokari na gicciya kwayoyin halitta (crossbreeding) ya zama wata gagarumar nasara a harkar kiwon dabbobi na Najeriya, yana nuna yiwuwar inganta yawan madara ta hanyar zabin kwayoyin halitta na musamman da kuma gudanar da bincike.

instruction: Wadanne sinadirai uku masu muhimmanci ne suka fi shafar samar da madara da nama a yankuna masu karancin ruwan sama (semi-arid areas)?
response: A yankuna masu karancin ruwan sama, sinadirai guda uku da suka fi kowanne tasiri (critical nutrients) wajen samar da madara da nama sune sinadaran protein, makamashi (energy), da kuma ma'adanai (minerals). Sinadarin protein yana da matukar muhimmanci ga girman tsoka (muscle growth) da kuma gyaran tsoka a cikin shanu, yayin da makamashi (energy) daga abubuwa kamar busasshiyar ciyawa (hay) da hatsi ke taimakawa wajen saurin karin kiba da samar da madara. Ma'adanai kamar sinadarin calcium da phosphorus suna da matukar amfani wajen karfin kashi da lafiyar shanu gaba daya. Tabbatar da samun isassun wadannan sinadiran yana da matukar muhimmanci domin kara yawan madara da nama a yankuna masu karancin ruwan sama.

instruction: Ta yaya 'kiwon a gida ko turke' (zero-grazing) ya bambanta da 'kiwon fita a fili' (extensive grazing)?
response: Kiwon tsare (Zero-grazing) ya kunshi killace dabbobi ne a waje guda a rika kawo musu abinci (forage), wanda zai iya taimakawa wajen inganta kyan abincin da kuma rage asararsa, amma kuma zai iya jawo karin kudin aiki da kuma bukatar karin wasu gine-gine. A daya bangaren kuma, kiwon fita waje (extensive grazing) ya dogara ne akan barin dabbobin su nemo abincin kansu a filin kiwo, wanda zai iya zama da sauki a farashi (cost-effective) kuma yana bin tsarin al'ada (natural), amma kuma hakan na iya jawo cin abinci fiye da kima (overgrazing) da kuma asarar amfanin ciyawar idan ba a kula da ita da kyau ba.

instruction: Fahimtar Abubuwa Guda Uku Da Shanun White Fulani Ke Yi (Triple-Purpose)
response: Shanun Bunaji (White Fulani) hakika wata dabba ce mai fa'idoji daban-daban, wadda aka fi sani da dabbar 'triple-purpose'. Wannan yana nufin cewa tana gabatar da manyan ayyuka guda uku, wadanda suka hada da: bayar da madara, naman sa, da kuma karfin yin aiki. A matsayinta na saniyar madara, White Fulani suna samar da madarar da ke cike da abubuwan gina jiki kuma ta dace da amfanin dan adam. Baya ga madara, ana kuma kiwon su don samun namansu mai inganci wanda ake yawan bukatarsa a kasuwanni daban-daban. Bugu da kari, karfinsu da kuma juriyarsu sun sa suka dace da ayyuka (draught purposes), kamar yin noma da jigilar kaya masu nauyi, wanda hakan ya sa suka zama wata muhimmiyar dukiya ga manoma a Najeriya.

instruction: Kaso nawa na dukkanin garkunan shanun Najeriya ne White Fulani suka wakilta?
response: Nau'in shanun White Fulani yana da rinjaye sosai a cikin shanun Najeriya, wadanda suka kunshi kimanin kashi 50% na gaba daya garkunan kasar. Haka zalika, an san su da girman jiki na ban mamaki, juriya, da kuma madararsu mai inganci, wanda hakan ya sa suke matsayin wani muhimmin bangare a masana'antar shanu na kasar.

instruction: Wuraren kiwon kiba (feedlots) na al'umma a Yankin Kudu da Saharar Afirka (SSA) vs na masu zaman kansu
response: Wuraren kiwon kiba na al'umma a Yankin Kudu da Saharar Afirka suna yin aiki daban da na kashin-kai inda ake gudanar da su daga bangaren al'umma domin bunkasa juriyar canjin yanayi da kuma tabbatar da wadataccen abinci ga kananan manoma. Wannan tsarin yana ba da damar yanke shawara na hadin gwiwa gami da raba abubuwan more rayuwa, wanda hakan na da fa'ida sosai musamman ga kananan manoma wadanda ba su da halin saka hannun jari a manyan wuraren kiwon kiba da kansu. Ta hanyar hada karfi da karfe (pooling their resources), masu wuraren kiwon kiba na al'umma za su iya samun damar jure wa canjin yanayi tare da kara musu kwarin gwiwar habaka kayayyakin gonakin su (overall productivity), wanda a karshe hakan zai taimaka wajen samun isasshen abinci a cikin al'ummominsu.

instruction: Ta yaya rarrabuwa (classification) na WOAH List A yake shafar kasuwanci?
response: Shiga cikin rukunin WOAH List A yana haifar da haramcin kasuwanci cikin gaggawa (immediate trade bans) da kuma mummunar illa ga zamantakewa da tattalin arzikin (severe socio-economic consequences) kasar da abin ya shafa, domin yana nuna cewa kasar na fuskantar wani babban hatsari na cuta mai yaduwa (high-risk disease status) wanda yake barazana ga lafiyar dabbobi a duniya baki daya. Wannan rarrabuwa yana iya yin mummunan tasiri ga masana'antar fitar da dabbobi (livestock export industry) na kasar, wanda zai iya janyo hasarar tattalin arziki mai tsoka kuma zai iya shafar lamurran abinci (food security).

instruction: Adadin yawan madarar da saniyar White Fulani ke bayarwa a lokacin shayarwa (per lactation) guda nawa ne?
response: Adadin madarar da saniyar White Fulani ke bayarwa galibi yana kai kimanin 2,300 kg a lokacin shayarwa guda (per lactation). Wannan yawan abin a yaba ne, wanda hakan ya sa saniyar White Fulani ta zama babbar zabi a fannin kiwon madara a Najeriya. Abubuwa kamar abinci mai gina jiki, lafiya, da jinsin dabbar (breeding) suna iya tasiri ga yawan madarar da kowace saniya za ta bayar (individual yields), amma galibi kiyasin abin da aka fi samu na wannan nau'in shine adadin 2,300 kg.

instruction: Mene ne ainihin manufar (production type) nau'in shanun White Fulani a Najeriya?
response: Ainihin manufar nau'in shanun White Fulani a Najeriya ita ce amfaninsu wajen bayar da abubuwa guda biyu (dual-purpose breed), wanda ke nufin ana kiwon su domin samar da madara da nama. Wannan nau'in dabbobin ya dace sosai da yanayin (climate) Najeriya kuma galibi ana amfani da su a kananan gonaki (small-scale farming operations) saboda karfinsu da kudurcinsu na sabawa da yanayin gari (adaptability).

instruction: Matsakaicin girman garken shanu da Adisa da Badmos suka ruwaito a shekarar (2009)
response: Bisa rahoton Adisa da Badmos (2009), matsakaicin girman garken shanu (average cattle herd size) ya kasance shanu guda 41 (41 cattle). Wannan bayani yana da matukar amfani wajen fahimtar kiyasin yawan shanun da aka saba kiwo a Najeriya, da kuma tsare-tsare (planning) gami da ayyukan gudanarwa (management purposes) a yankinku.

instruction: Kimanin adadin nauyin kewayon rayayyen (live body weight) manyan (mature) bijiman White Fulani (Bunaji)?
response: Manyan bijiman White Fulani ko Bunaji galibi suna yin nauyin da ke tsakanin kilogiram 350 zuwa 500, wanda ke sanya su zama masu kwarjini da kuma karfi sosai. Wannan kewayon nauyin dabbar kyakkyawar alama ce ta cikakkiyar lafiyarsu (overall health) da kuma kudurcinsu domin asalin hayayyafa (breeding purposes). Yana da kyau a san cewa nauyin (weights) kowace dabba zai iya bambanta dangane da abubuwa kamar abinci (nutrition), yanayin halitta (genetics), da kuma tsarin kula da dabbar baki daya (overall management practices).

instruction: Mene ne 'cin furen bishiya' ('browsing') idan aka kwatanta da 'kiwon fili' ('grazing') wajen kiwon awakin Najeriya?
response: A kiwon awakin Najeriya, 'cin ganyen bishiya' ('browsing') na nufin cin ganyayyakin bishiyoyi (shrubs and tree leaves) a maimakon ciyawa kadai. Wannan ya bambanta da 'kiwon fili' (grazing), wanda ke nufin cin ciyawa (grasses) da wasu kananan tsiro na kasa (herbaceous plants). Awakin da ke cin furen bishiya (Browsing goats) suna yawan jin dadin kiwo a wuraren da ake yawan samun ganyayyaki, inda suke da damar samun nau'ikan ganyayyaki (diverse range of leaves) da fure kala-kala (twigs). Wannan dabi'ar cin abinci ta zama ruwan dare a kiwon awaki a Najeriya, musamman a wuraren da filayen ciyawa suka yi karanci.
